articleTitle: Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: lasers; electro-optics; nonlinear optics; frequency comb generation; holography; photonic microfluidics; terahertz sensing and imaging; optical elements; interferometry applications; ultrashort pulse characterization; optical materials; WDM; sensors; photonic band gap; solid state lighting; microwave photonics; microstructured fibers; and laser applications

articleTitle: External-pump-free widely tunable wavelength converter using a double-ring fiber laser incorporating a semiconductor optical amplifier
abstract: Polarization-insensitive widely tunable wavelength conversion has been demonstrated using broad-band orthogonal pumps four-wave mixing without any external-pump. A 3-dB conversion range over 40 nm is obtained with smaller than 0.5-dB polarization sensitivity.

articleTitle: Iodine-stabilized 1520 nm diode laser for optical fiber communication
abstract: We present our work on the frequency stabilization of a 1520 nm distributed feedback diode laser by locking its second harmonic generation to the hyperfine transitions of the iodine.

articleTitle: Four-point monitoring of photoconductance for laser remote sensing
abstract: We present a new detector for measuring changes in optical irradiance in the presence of speckle or interference which provides robust voltage signals in discrete or array geometries.

articleTitle: A frequency-agile ring-cavity THz-wave parametric oscillator pumped by a 200-Hz Q-sw Nd:YAG laser
abstract: We developed a THz-wave parametric oscillator (TPO) with a ring-cavity configuration pumped by a 200-Hz repetition-rate Q-sw Nd:YAG laser. Three mirrors were used to form the TPO cavity, which contained an MgO:LiNbO/sub 3/ nonlinear optical crystal. THz-wave pulses synchronized with the pump repetition rate were generated, and a tunable range from 1.3 to 2.3 THz was obtained.

articleTitle: Modifying the spectrum of terahertz pulses using a novel four-electrode photoconductive switch
abstract: We present a novel four-electrode photoconductive switch which allows us to modify the photocurrent and the THz emission spectrum. These effects result from an appropriately chosen inhomogeneous electric field applied across the non-uniform carrier distribution.

articleTitle: Mid-IR optical limiter based on type-II quantum wells
abstract: We show that strong optically-induced intervalence band transitions in type-II QWs lead to reverse saturable absorption, and propose to use it for optical limiting over a large dynamic range.

articleTitle: Broadband, lossless DCF utilizing single pump Raman amplification
abstract: Broadband, flat-gain Raman amplification using single pump is reported in an asymmetrical twin-core fiber. Designed fiber also has a very high negative dispersion coefficient and thus serves as a lossless dispersion-compensating module over 35-nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: Design, fabrication, and characterization of THz Bragg reflectors
abstract: We have designed, fabricated and measured the first THz Bragg reflectors based on periodic air slots formed on Si wafers. For three air slots, we have achieved a peak reflectivity as high as 91%.

articleTitle: Noise reduction in THz systems using THz interferometry
abstract: We compare a broadband THz interferometer to standard THz time-domain spectroscopy (TDS), demonstrating improvement in characterization of thin samples. Destructive interference reduces the noise effects due to THz pulse emission and detection, and system drift.

articleTitle: All fiber CPA system based on air-guiding photonic bandgap fiber compressor
abstract: We report on an all fiber CPA system based on a step-index fiber stretcher and an air-guiding photonic crystal fiber compressor. The peak power out of the compressor fiber is as high as 0.82 MW.

articleTitle: All ceramic composite with layer by layer and clad-core structure by advanced ceramic technology
abstract: Ceramic composite laser gain media having layer by layer and clad-core structure were fabricated successfully for the first time by advanced ceramic processing. Advanced ceramic technology provides to direct formation of composite having complex structure.

articleTitle: Ultra broadband mirror using sub-wavelength grating
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, a very broadband (/spl Delta//spl lambda///spl lambda/>35%), high reflective (R>98.5%) grating structure. This structure is scalable to far infrared wavelengths and can be used to create low-voltage and widely tunable optical filters.

articleTitle: Attosecond physics: time-resolved atomic inner-shell spectroscopy
abstract: Ultrashort high harmonic extreme-ultraviolet pulses are applied for taking snapshots of the relaxation of atomic inner-shell vacancies. A novel gating mechanism utilizes the momentum exchange between electron wave packets and a laser field.

articleTitle: Ultrafast polariton beating in metallic photonic crystal slabs
abstract: We investigate the dephasing time of particle plasmons coupled to dielectric waveguide modes and observe a prolonged plasmon dephasing and temporal beats when changing the coupling strength between the waveguide modes and the plasmon resonance.

articleTitle: Soliton-induced waveguides in a photorefractive organic glass
abstract: We observe guidance of a probe beam at 980 nm by a soliton beam at 780 nm in an organic photorefractive monolithic glass, owing to the orientationally enhanced photorefractive nonlinearity of the material. We demonstrate both planar waveguides induced by soliton stripes and circular waveguides induced by two-dimensional solitons.

articleTitle: A femtosecond laser-activated silicon reflection switch for electron-beam bunch length measurements
abstract: We report an experimental study of the reflection of s- and p-polarized subpicosecond THz-radiation pulses from silicon. We propose silicon reflection switches for electron bunch length measurement via THz wake field diagnostics.

articleTitle: Simultaneous enhancement of second and third harmonic generation in one-dimensional semiconductor photonic band gap
abstract: Enhanced second and third harmonics were observed simultaneously in a one-dimensional ZnSe/ZnMgS photonic band gap structure. This enhancement comes from the phase matching and a high density of states near the photonic band edge.

articleTitle: Ferroelastically-induced quasi-phase-matching structures in RbTiOAsO/sub 4/ crystals
abstract: We report a novel ferroelastically-induced quasi-phase-matching structure in RbTiOAsO/sub 4/ crystals, which surpasses the current limit of the 3 /spl mu/m period and 3 mm thickness.

articleTitle: Self-stabilized carrier envelope offset phase with difference frequency generation
abstract: Femtosecond pulse train with self-stabilized carrier envelope offset phase is generated near the center of the gain band of Ti:sapphire at full repetition rate of oscillators by using difference frequency generation.

articleTitle: Small-form-pluggable PON burst-mode transceiver
abstract: The study is addressed on PON module characteristics, burst mode driving capability, phenomena measurement and verified the critical parameters defined in current draft. The feasibility of 10 km EPQN/GPON application has also been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Colloidal photonic crystal mirrors for high-resolving-power Fabry-Perots
abstract: An open-structure Fabry-Perot resonator with a quality factor of 2400 was fabricated for the first time with colloidal photonic crystal mirrors, demonstrating that colloidal self-assembly can offer new means for creating high resolving power optical devices.

articleTitle: All-fiber devices based on sol-gel coated tapered fibers
abstract: Low-loss porous silica films were deposited onto tapered fibers in minutes. By periodically varying the film's porosity with a CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2 </sub> laser, we demonstrated a new type of thermally-stable structural long-period grating

articleTitle: Development of NOx sensor system by using a mid-IR coherent light source for exhaust emission monitoring
abstract: Rapid NO/sub 2/ detection by mid-infrared coherent light source based on difference frequency generation that used a fiber laser as pumping source was demonstrated. High resolution spectroscopic measurements of NO/sub 2/ are reported.

articleTitle: Direct laser writing of three-dimensional photonic crystal templates for photonic bandgaps at telecommunication wavelengths
abstract: Using direct laser writing, for the first time photonic crystal templates with fundamental stop bands at telecommunication wavelengths are realized. Their measured optical properties agree well with detailed simulations, revealing their excellent optical quality

articleTitle: Measuring the nonlinear coefficient of a fiber span using optical and RF clock tone monitoring
abstract: We demonstrate a technique for measuring the nonlinear-coefficient of a fiber spool/span using the optical and RF clock tones. We measure the variation in these tones induced by SPM and relate them to the nonlinear-coefficient.

articleTitle: Optimum design of silicon doping for emission enhancement of InGaN/GaN quantum well light-emitting devices
abstract: InGaN/GaN quantum well samples of various silicon doping conditions, including doping layers and concentrations, are compared in nano-structures and emission characteristics for design optimization. The best performance of barrier-doped samples originates from stronger carrier localization.

articleTitle: Observation of Purcell effect in photonic crystal nanocavity at room temperature
abstract: Vely fast spontaneous emission decay was observed in a GaInASP photonic clystal nanocavity at mom temperature. Even considering nonradiative effects and carrier dynamics, a >I6 fold enhancement of spontaneous rate by PurceU effect is estimated. 0 2004 Optical Society ofAmerica

articleTitle: Room-temperature operation of GaInAsSb-AlGaAsSb quantum well lasers in the 2.2 to 3 /spl mu/m wavelength range
abstract: GaInAsSb-AlGaAsSb type-I quantum well laser diodes with compressively strained active regions were fabricated. The ridge waveguide lasers show room-temperature continuous wave operation in the wavelength range from 2.2 /spl mu/m to 3 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: As-grown low-loss germanosilicate layers by PECVD
abstract: Systematic characterization of low-loss PECVD grown germanosilicate layers is reported. Addition of germane, decreased N-H bond concentration drastically leading to the lowest reported propagation loss values in germanosilicate planar waveguides, eliminating high temperature annealing requirement.

articleTitle: Low power, high-contrast, ultrafast O-CDMA nonlinear waveform discrimination at 10 GHz
abstract: We demonstrate ultrafast O-CDMA nonlinear waveform discrimination at 10 GHz with less than 1 mW coupled into a nonlinear PPLN waveguide and greater than 20 dB contrast ratio between coded and uncoded waveforms

articleTitle: Two decades of photonic analog-to-digital converters
abstract: For over two decades, researchers have developed a number of optically based techniques for addressing the increasing demands for analog-to-digital converters that operate at high sampling rates with a large numbers of effective bits

articleTitle: Multilevel 2D and 3D photonic devices fabricated in glass by a femtosecond oscillator
abstract: Layered x-couplers and three-dimensional devices are fabricated in glass using femtosecond pulses from an extended cavity oscillator. Mode analysis confirms the devices are single-mode. A determination of waveguide loss is performed by Fabry-Perot measurement.

articleTitle: Thulium sensitization of praseodymium mid-infrared transitions in potassium lead chloride laser crystals
abstract: Energy transfer is reported from Tm/sup 3+/ to Pr/sup 3+/ in co-doped KPb/sub 2/Cl/sub 5/ laser crystals. Pumping Tm/sup 3+/ with 800 nm laser diodes results in broad emission of mid-infrared fluorescence between 4000 and 5500 nm.

articleTitle: Gas sensing with a 9 /spl mu/m thermoelectrically-cooled quasi-cw distributed feedback quantum cascade laser
abstract: A compact trace gas sensor based on a thermoelectrically cooled quasi CW quantum cascade laser is reported. Direct absorption of SO/sub 2/ was used for laser characterization. 2f wavelength modulation spectroscopy was applied to ammonia monitoring.

articleTitle: Above-bandgap Franz-Keldysh effect: a new method for ultrafast electric field measurements in semiconductors
abstract: We present a new technique for electric field measurements in semiconductors with femtosecond time resolution. The method relies on the integration over electric field induced Franz-Keldysh oscillations with broadband laser pulses above the bandgap.

articleTitle: Thulium sensitized neodymium for mid-IR laser development
abstract: The energy transfer properties between Tm/sup 3+/ and Nd/sup 3+/ in KPb/sub 2/Cl/sub 5/ are explored. The efficiency of the energy transfer from the Tm /sup 3/H/sub 4/ to the Nd/sup 4/I/sub 11/2/was evaluated for sensitization of a new mid-IR laser system.

articleTitle: Grating-coupled surface emitting quantum cascade semiconductor optical pre-amplifier
abstract: A grating-coupled surface-emitting mid-IR optical pre-amplifier was fabricated from a quantum cascade laser wafer and demonstrated >15-dB small signal gain with ASE power <-44 dBm. The Bragg grating served as output-coupler, ASE-filter, and wavelength division multiplexer.

articleTitle: An analog of free carrier plasma component of carrier induced refractive index in quantum dot lasers
abstract: The carrier-induced refractive index in quantum dot (QD) structures due to optical transitions from QD levels to continuum states is considered. The /spl alpha/-factor due to this contribution into the total refractive index is /spl sim/1.

articleTitle: 589 nm generation by sum-frequency mixing of mode-locked 1064 nm and 1319 nm pulses in periodically poled KTP
abstract: All-solid-state 589 nm coherent source was achieved by sum-frequency mixing in periodically poled KTP of mode-locked pulses at 1064 and 1319 nm. Even for single-pass pumping of 5-mm-long-crystal, conversion efficiency was reached to 14%.

articleTitle: All-optical 2R regeneration based on multi wave mixing in optical fibre
abstract: The authors investigate the possibility of amplification and signal reshaping through a multi-wave-mixing effect inside a particular dispersion shifted fibre. The higher order mixing products exhibit a Bessel-like transfer function useful for significant noise compression

articleTitle: Quasi-end-fired laser operation from waveguided DFB plastic dye lasers for fiber-top tunable laser
abstract: A novel pumping scheme quasi-end-firing (QEF) was proposed and demonstrated for waveguided DFB tunable fiber-top dye laser. QEF-DFB laser array has been fabricated and the QEFed-DFB laser operation was confirmed for first time.

articleTitle: Observation of two-photon above-threshold ionization of rare gases by XUV harmonic photons
abstract: We have observed two-photon above-threshold ionization in Ar, Xe and He by the fifth harmonic (25 eV photon energy) of a KrF laser.

articleTitle: High resolution absolute temperature mapping in diode-end-pumped Yb:YAG and heat transfer measurements
abstract: We report 60-/spl mu/m resolution, direct and absolute temperature measurements in a diode-end-pumped Yb:YAG crystal. For the first time to our knowledge, the heat transfer coefficient has been measured with different types of thermal contact.

articleTitle: A new selective mode excitation method for a multimode fiber with larger alignment tolerance
abstract: A selective mode excitation method for a multimode fiber is proposed and demonstrated experimentally. An improved bandwidth with larger alignment tolerance than the offset launching method can be obtained by using a tilted launching scheme.

articleTitle: Generation of a dark hollow beam inside a cavity
abstract: A new method is introduced to generate a hollow beam inside a cavity. Using a matrix eigenvalue method, the laser resonator with optical diffraction element is theoretically analyzed and simulated. A hollow beam of good quality is realized experimentally.

articleTitle: Pulsed terahertz emission from indium nitride thin films
abstract: We report for the first time femtosecond optically excited terahertz pulse emission from indium nitride (InN). MBE-grown InN is a novel electronic material. The THz emission from InN is strong compared to previously investigated semiconductors

articleTitle: Compact intracavity pumped continuous-wave singly resonant PPLN OPO
abstract: A compact intracavity pumped continuous-wave singly resonant PPLN OPO has been developed. The idler output power is more than 200 mW in the tunable range of 2.3-3.9 /spl mu/m and the maximum power exceeds 900 mW at 3.4 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Fiber-optic laser-sensor for online and in-situ monitoring of volcano gases
abstract: An evanescent-field fiber-sensor is used to monitor the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2 </sub> concentration directly within a fumerole with a time resolution better than minutes. This device facilitates long-term measurements and offers great potential as precursor for volcanic activity

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked surface-emitting semiconductor laser with 1.7 W output power in 5.9-ps pulses
abstract: We present an optically pumped passively mode-locked vertical external-cavity surface-emitting laser (VECSEL) generating 1.7 W of average output power in 5.9-ps with a 2.5-GHz repetition rate at a wavelength of 959 nm.

articleTitle: Tunable THz-wave generation using dual-wavelength optical-pulse source based on diode lasers
abstract: We report generation of automatically synchronized dual-wavelength optical pulses using the combination of a gain-switched diode laser and four-wave mixing. Difference frequency generation from 1.2 to 2.1 terahertz (THz)-wave was also demonstrated using PPLN.

articleTitle: Transmission of wavelength references via a commercial transparent optical network over 534 km
abstract: Wavelength references at 1550 nm were transmitted over a 16-channel 534 km DWDM network carrying live traffic as part of the EU CREW project. No degradation of the reference wavelength was observed down to the 10/sup -8/ level.

articleTitle: Measuring ultrashort pulses in space and time
abstract: We measure the complete electric field of an ultrashort pulse train vs. time and all spatial coordinates without an independent reference pulse, by combining Fourier-synthesis digital holography with frequency-resolved optical gating.

articleTitle: Solgel route to erbium-doped microlasers and Raman microlasers on-a-chip
abstract: Ultra-high-Q microresonators are fabricated on silicon chips by the solgel technique. Using wafer-based processing and selective reflow, we create toroid-shaped Er-doped microlasers directly from Er-doped solgel layers and Raman microlasers from undoped silica solgel layers.

articleTitle: Self-starting passive harmonic mode-locked femtosecond Yb/sup 3+/-doped fiber laser at 1030 nm
abstract: We demonstrate the first self-starting passively harmonic mode-locked femtosecond Yb/sup 3+/-doped fiber laser with up to 585 MHz scalable repetition rate and >45 dB of supermode suppression. 400 mW average power, /spl sim/240 fs pulses is achieved after amplification. Pulse-to-pulse jitter is characterized by optical cross correlation.

articleTitle: Fabrication of micromirrors with pyramidal shape using anisotropic etching of silicon with KOH
abstract: We report in this work the fabrication and optical characterization of micromirrors with inversed pyramidal shape (pits). The pyramids are etched on silicon using an anisotropic etchant and then gold coated to form a mirror.

articleTitle: Attosecond science and technology
abstract: Electron wave packets formed by atomic tunnel ionization and controlled by strong laser fields create attosecond (electron and optical) pulses. Electrons formed by attosecond pulses, deflected by a strong laser field, measure the optical pulse duration.

articleTitle: Localization and delocalization in disordered nonlinear fiber arrays
abstract: We experimentally investigate the nonlinear field evolution in a disordered two-dimensional array of mutually interacting optical fibers. The diffusive propagation of linear fields is nonlinearly modified resulting in power controlled localization and delocalization.

articleTitle: Tuning of powerful THz pulses by changing the tilt angle of the pump pulse front
abstract: We demonstrate tuning of subpicosecond THz pulses in LiNbO/sub 3/ across the 1.0-4.4 THz range with energies up to 400 pJ and quantum conversion efficiency of 3%. Tunability from 8.5-11.5 THz is predicted in GaP.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser using broadband erbium-doped bismuth oxide gain fiber
abstract: A stable, femtosecond laser incorporating erbium-doped bismuth oxide fiber for high gain and broad bandwidth and an ultra-broadband oxidized saturable Bragg reflector for self-starting produces 78 fs pulses.

articleTitle: Highly efficient cw Yb-doped ceramic lasers
abstract: We have been developing highly transparent ceramics for solid-state lasers. The LD-pumped cw Yb-doped ceramic lasers were demonstrated with highly efficient. The low-temperature absorption spectra of the ceramic materials were measured.

articleTitle: Enhanced frequency response in buried ridge quantum well intermixed SGDBR laser modulators
abstract: We have studied the effects of various proton implant profiles on the performance of buried-ridge-stripe electro-absorption modulators monolithically integrated with SG-DBR lasers. Two implant profiles weie performed adjacent to the buried ridge, enhancing the bandwidth. 0 2003 Optic,d Society of Amenca

articleTitle: Simultaneous guided and vertical laser emission in 2D photonic crystals
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate simultaneous guided and vertical laser emission at room temperature in an optically pumped two dimensional InP-based deep etched photonic crystal.

articleTitle: UV-light-gating two-color photorefractivity in Mg-doped near-stoichiometric LiNbO/sub 3/
abstract: We investigate the recording and optical fixing dynamics of UV-light-gating two-color photorefractive holograms recorded in a near-stoichiometric LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> crystal doped with Mg above threshold. We found that shallow and multiple deep centers leading to the formation of complementary gratings are responsible for the two-color photorefractive effect

articleTitle: Partially incoherent optical vortices in self-focusing nonlinear media
abstract: We predict theoretically and observe experimentally stable propagation of spatially localized single- and double-charge optical vortices created in a self-focusing nonlinear medium by self-trapping of partially incoherent light carrying a phase dislocation.

articleTitle: Prospects for ultrafast optical switching based on quantum dot semiconductor optical amplifiers in nonlinear interferometers
abstract: It is shown that interferometers containing quantum-dot semiconductor optical amplifiers can be effective for ultrafast cross-phase modulation and digital signal processing with low dependence on the specific random data pattern.

articleTitle: Control of seeding of Raman forward scattering and injection of electrons in a self-modulated laser wakefield accelerator by a copropagating prepulse
abstract: Optically controlled seeding of Raman forward scattering and electron injection in a self-modulated laser wakefield accelerator is achieved by introducing a copropagating prepulse with proper timing. Seeding mechanisms are identified from the experimental data.

articleTitle: Characterization of signal quality using data stream optical autocorrelation
abstract: Optical performance monitoring using data stream autocorrelation is analyzed in simulations and experiments for impairments of interest in practical optical networks. Sensitivity to OSNR is demonstrated over a wide range of accumulated dispersion.

articleTitle: A phase locked, fiber laser-based frequency comb: Limit on optical linewidth
abstract: A phase-locked fiber laser-based frequency comb is presented. Despite the broad linewidth of the measured carrier-envelope offset frequency, the linewidth of a single line near the center of the frequency comb is /spl les/ 6 kHz.

articleTitle: Polarization and temperature-tolerant wavelength-locked WDM source with external ASE injection
abstract: We propose a novel optical source for WDM transmission using two polarization-multiplexed low-cost Fabry-Perot LDs with external ASE injection. The proposed source shows high power, low noise and the polarization and temperature tolerance.

articleTitle: Optical switching applications of ZnSe/MgF/sub 2/ photonic band gap structures based on thermal nonlinearities
abstract: We studied a ZnSe/MgF/sub 2/ multilayer in order to modulate its optical reflectance at a fixed wavelength, 628 nm. An electrically induced temperature increase is responsible for changes in the refractive index of the layers. As a result the reflected signal is decreased.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a fourth order polarimeter using quadratic nonlinear detection
abstract: We demonstrate a device that measures the fourth order polarization coherency matrix using a quadratic nonlinear detector. The device is shown to distinguish different PMD states in pulse trains with the same SOP.

articleTitle: Recent advances in AlGaN-based deep-UV LEDs
abstract: We will overview the challenges and performance of AlGaN-based multi-quantum well LEDs in the 275-290 nm range. Recent progress in materials and device development has enabled output powers of > 1 mW at 290 nm.

articleTitle: Local observation of the absolute phase of a microwave field
abstract: We describe a new single-atom nonlinear optics experiment based on self-interference between the positive and negative frequency components of a microwave field, where absolute-phase at an atom's position can be measured in the atomic population.

articleTitle: A folded low-coherence interferometer for high-accuracy measurement of group refractive index
abstract: A new low-coherence interferometer for measurement of group refractive index without knowledge of the geometrical thickness of the sample is developed. The interferometer is a folded-type so that one interferometer behaves like two interferometers.

articleTitle: Mid-IR distributed feedback interband cascade lasers
abstract: We report mid-IR distributed feedback interband cascade lasers operating in continuous-wave mode at temperatures up to 175 K with single longitudinal mode emission and side mode suppression ratio greater than 30 dB.

articleTitle: Single frequency tunable Sb-based vertical cavity surface emitting lasers emitting at 2.3/spl mu/m
abstract: VCSELs exhibit singlc-frcqueucy operation and wide mode-hope-free tuning range, particularly well adapted for trace gas spectroscopy application, especially in the 2-2.5pm atmospheric trausparcncy window (CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>...)

articleTitle: 4 /spl times/ 160 Gbit/s WDM transmission by a cascade of semiconductor LOAs
abstract: The highest bit rate amplification and transmission using semiconductor based linear optical amplifiers as repeaters is successfully demonstrated. We achieved error free operation for four wavelengths of polarization-bit-interleaved 160 Gbit/s signals.

articleTitle: Fast wavelength-swept fiber laser using electro-optic polarization controller
abstract: Fast wavelength-swept fiber laser is experimentally demonstrated using electro-optic waveguide polarization controller. Intra-cavity fiber Sagnac loop and saturable absorber filter are used to achieve fast and continuous sweeping of the single-wavelength fiber laser.

articleTitle: Wavelength aware receiver for enhanced 2D OCDMA
abstract: We present a novel receiver for 2D OCDMA which utilizes the wavelength information of codes, to provide higher number of simultaneous users than the regular receiver. Maximal spectral efficiency is doubled, for carrier-hopping prime codes

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of refractive index scaling in photonic bandgap fibers
abstract: We report on the experimental observation of the bandgap shift in D/sub 2/O-filled hollow core photonic crystal fibers. Our results confirm a simple scaling law for bandgaps in fibers with different low-index media.

articleTitle: Si/sub 3/N/sub 4/ strip loaded waveguide electro-optic phase modulator in epitaxial BaTiO/sub 3/ thin film
abstract: We demonstrate a strip loaded waveguide electro-optic phase modulator in epitaxial barium titanium (BaTiO/sub 3/) thin film. Low waveguide propagation losses and low half-wave voltage length product are achieved.

articleTitle: High temperature continuous-wave operation of terahertz quantum cascade lasers
abstract: We report continuous-wave operation of a quantum-cascade laser at 3.2 THz (/spl lambda/ /spl sim/ 94 /spl mu/m) up to a heat-sink temperature of 93 K. Optical powers of /spl sim/1.5 mW at 10 K and /spl sim/400 /spl mu/W at 78 K are observed.

articleTitle: Integrated optics ring-resonator chemical sensor for detection of air contamination
abstract: We report a silicon nitride-based ring resonator chemical sensor with sensing polymer coating. It's sensitivity to isopropanol in air is at least 50 ppm - well under the permissible exposure level of 400 ppm.

articleTitle: Multiple quantum wells for mode-locking
abstract: Mode-locking at wavelengths ranging from 750 nm to 1100 nm is achieved with proper adjustment of multiple-quantum-well composition. In flashlamp Nd:YAG laser with multiple-quantum-wells 25 ps pulses are reported.

articleTitle: Chirped photonic crystal waveguides
abstract: We propose chirped photonic crystal waveguides, in which some structured parameters are smoothly changed along the waveguide. We experimentally observed light localization and theoretically expected a group delay for such waveguides.

articleTitle: High power quantum cascade lasers: A room temperature reality
abstract: Summary form only given. Mid- and far-infrared diode laser sources have been used in spectroscopic applications for a number of years. Historically, however, the application of these devices has been hindered by low output power and the need for cryogenic refrigeration. The quantum cascade laser, being an unipolar device, does not suffer from the same nonradiative mechanisms that have limited most mid- and far-infrared laser sources. Despite some intrinsic inefficiency due to a shorter carrier lifetime and higher optical losses than near-infrared bipolar diodes, this technology is now capable of both room temperature and high power operation over a significant portion of the mid- and far-infrared spectral region. With potential for multiwatt arrays, many more, especially remote, applications have started to become feasible. This talk will go through some of the development cycle at the Center for Quantum Devices that has led to the demonstration of high-power, continuous-wave quantum cascade laser diodes. While the focus will be mostly on continuous operation, quasi-cw operation will also be given as an alternative for even higher average power delivery. In conclusion, the current limitations to diode performance will be discussed, as well as possible near- and long-term solutions.

articleTitle: Transport properties of a quantum dot based optically gated field-effect transistor
abstract: We demonstrate an optically modulated field-effect transistor. Such a device has a possible application as a fast, flexible, and efficient single-photon detector.

articleTitle: Three dimensional optical profilometry using multicore optical fiber
abstract: The multicore optical fiber was used for the measurement of three-dimensional object shapes by two-dimensional Fourier transform profilometry for the first time. The fiber alignment requirement for polarization control was solved by using multicore fiber.

articleTitle: Relaxation oscillation noise suppression in fibre DFB lasers using a semiconductor optical amplifier
abstract: We report the experimental results of a simple, all optical technique to reduce the relative intensity noise peak of a fibre distributed feedback laser. A noise reduction of 30 dB is achieved.

articleTitle: Efficient energy transfer sensitisation of Yb/sup 3+/ emission by Nd/sup 3+/ in ceramic sesquioxide laser materials
abstract: Very efficient sensitisation of Yb/sup 3+/ emission by Nd/sup 3+/ in sesquioxide transparent ceramics produced by the solid-state mixing method is demonstrated by optical spectroscopy and emission decay.

articleTitle: High cw power density with narrow diode lasers
abstract: An axisymmetric method for spatial, wavelength and polarization multiplexing of narrow diode lasers is proposed. An effectively circular focal spot with cw power density of several hundred kW/mm is possible using non-imaging catadioptric optics.

articleTitle: Ultrafast conductivity in amorphous semiconductors by time-resolved THz spectroscopy
abstract: We present studies of photoconductivity on picosecond time scales in amorphous silicon (a-Si:H) and related materials using time-resolved THz techniques. We find a strongly non-Drude response with a power-law frequency dependence characteristic of disordered systems.

articleTitle: Widely tunable CW Nd-doped Y/sub 2/O/sub 3/ ceramic laser
abstract: We report the first demonstration of a widely tunable operation in a highly doped Nd:Y/sub 2/O/sub 3/ ceramic laser with a broad bandwidth. A range of tunability from 1070 nm to 1082 nm is obtained under present experimental conditions.

articleTitle: High resolution terahertz time-domain spectroscopy
abstract: Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy is applied to measure crystal orientation dependant absorption of benzoic acid at frequencies below 5 THz. A high frequency resolution is achieved for the system with a chromium coated GaP electro-optic detector.

articleTitle: Experimental results and numerical simulation of mode partition noise suppression in multiwavelength modelocked semiconductor lasers
abstract: We report experimental data and a simple numerical model which accurately explain multiwavelength modelocked semiconductor laser behavior with and without a saturable absorber used for mode partition noise suppression.

articleTitle: Study on cyclic errors in a distance measurement using a frequency comb generated by a mode-locked laser
abstract: Effect of frequency selectivity in a distance measurement using a frequency comb is investigated. Cyclic errors are tailored in a frequency-selection method using all-passive components, which realizes compactness and robustness to the laser instability.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional holographic reconstruction of nonlinear wavepackets using a temporal gate
abstract: The paper describes an improved version of an optical gating technique. The potentiality in recovering the spatio-temporal intensity distribution of ultrashort wavepackets is discussed. It is shown that the technique enables the preservation of the spatial phase information (suitably described by the second harmonic generated holography) of the WP. Possible improvements of the technique was also discussed.

articleTitle: Electrically tuned photonic crystal/ liquid crystal laser
abstract: The emission wavelength of ultra-small photonic crystal laser is electrically controlled with an applied gate voltage. High quality factor porous-cavity laser design enables strong interaction between strong optical fields and infiltrated liquid crystals.

articleTitle: High-power uncooled 975-nm Bragg grating stabilized thick-quantum-well lasers
abstract: Coherence-collapse operation of a Bragg grating stabilized thick-quantum-well laser diode yields 975-nm wavelength emission with >40 dB side-mode-suppression ratio, 1% power variation, and fiber-output power as high as 293 mW at 15/spl deg/C and 167 mW at 115/spl deg/C.

articleTitle: Laser threshold reduction in a spintronic device
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a threshold reduction of a semiconductor laser by optically pumping with spin-polarized electrons. Calculations show that a threshold reduction by 50% is possible even for electrically pumped lasers.

articleTitle: Low threshold room temperature GaAs quantum cascade lasers with Al/sub 0.45/Ga/sub 0.55/As waveguide
abstract: Significant improvements in the threshold current density of GaAs quantum cascade lasers are obtained by using waveguide with Al/sub 0.45/Ga/sub 0.55/As cladding layers.

articleTitle: Starch solutions based SHG-FROG pulse characterisation in a nonlinear microscope
abstract: We report the use of a starch solution as a non-linear medium allowing simple, broadband, polarization insensitive SHG-FROG characterisation of ultrashort pulses at the sample plane using high-NA objectives in a nonlinear microscope.

articleTitle: Nuclear reactions triggered by relativistic electron jets
abstract: Laser generated, highly collimated multi-MeV electron jets were used to induce nuclear reactions in high-Z materials like /sup 197/Au, /sup 181/Ta and in /sup 129/I. Applications of laser-induced nuclear reactions are presented.

articleTitle: A thermal-curing induced long-period fiber grating on corrugated metal fixture
abstract: We demonstrate a new method for fabricating long-period fiber gratings by gluing an unetched fiber onto a cormgated metal fixture. Dynamic range as large as 25dB is achieved for a temperature change of 100°C. 02003 Optical Society ofAmerica

articleTitle: Compact ultrashort-pulse lasers
abstract: Options for broad-bandwidth solid-state gain media and compact resonator design configurations will be described for diode-pumped lasers that can be modelocked at low pump-power thresholds.

articleTitle: 40 Gb/s reconfigurable optical CDMA laser encoder using direct modulated monolithic mode-locked lasers
abstract: A novel optical-CDMA laser encoder is proposed using a monolithic multi-cavity mode-locked laser for switchable code generation. Simulations show that pseudorandom-like 40 Gb/s pulses can be generated showing good orthogonality.

articleTitle: Passive stabilisation of an SBR-mode-locked Nd:KGW laser by nonlinear absorption in indium phosphide
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time to our knowledge, that passive stabilisation using inverse saturable absorption in indium phosphide expands the parameter range for stable continuous wave mode-locking in a diode-pumped passively mode-locked Nd:KGW laser.

articleTitle: Difference frequency generation in quasi-phase matched diffusion bonded ZnSe plates
abstract: We present what we believe to be the first results on tunable mid-infrared generation obtained in diffusion bonded ZnSe slabs by difference frequency mixing of OPO output waves.

articleTitle: Cavity ringdown technique in fibers
abstract: Bending losses in silica-based single-mode fiber cavities have been measured with the cavity ringdown technique and compared with a theoretical model for the first time. Good agreement has been found between experimentally derived fiber parameters and literature data.

articleTitle: Efficient single-mode supercontinuum generation in submicron-diameter silica-air fibre waveguides
Monolithic, passively Q-switched, diode side-pumped Nd:YAG laser with thermal compensation
abstract: A novel monolithic, passively Q-switched, diode side-pumped Nd:YAG laser is demonstrated, producing 3 ns 5 mJ pulses, up to 100 Hz. The saturable absorber (Cr/sup 4+/:YAG) was optically contacted directly onto Nd:YAG slab.

articleTitle: Interferometric displacement measurement by use of time-shared two-wavelength laser diode
abstract: A displacement sensor that uses both two-wavelength interferometry and a novel two-wavelength laser source is proposed. This system accurately measures displacement to within range of several hundred /spl mu/m and resolution to within /spl sim/3 /spl mu/m, respectively.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical loop mirror with highly birefringent polarization-maintaining photonic crystal fiber for walk-off free wavelength conversion over 150 nm
abstract: We report wavelength-conversion in a nonlinear optical loop mirror consisting of polarization-maintaining photonic crystal fiber. The large birefringence allowed cross-phase modulation to occur between orthogonal polarized signal and control separated in wavelength over 150 nm.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional photonic crystals at visible wavelengths
abstract: Photonic crystal slabs are experimentally demonstrated at visible wavelengths. These consist of freestanding silicon nitride membranes, patterned with square lattices of holes. Measured transmission spectra are in good agreement with finite difference time domain calculations.

articleTitle: Raman spectroscopy of oxide glasses for advanced Raman gain applications
abstract: Polarization resolved Raman spectra from 6-1500 cm/sup -1/ show that in tellurium oxide glasses a flat Raman gain down to low wavenumbers with intensity more than ten times that of fused silica can be achieved.

articleTitle: Diode-pumped mode-locked Yb/sup 3+/:Y/sub 2/O/sub 3/ ceramic laser
abstract: The first mode-locked ceramic laser based on Yb/sup 3+/:Y/sub 2/O/sub 3/ ceramics is presented. <420-mW, >430-fs pulses are generated at two center wavelengths of 1076 nm and 1037 nm.

articleTitle: Highly efficient in-plane type filtering device in two-dimensional photonic crystal slab
abstract: We propose an in-plane type filtering device based on two-dimensional photonic crystal slab, which has high drop efficiency and less sensitivity to structural fluctuations. Excellent device performance is demonstrated by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Self-deflection and all-optical beam steering in CdZnTe
abstract: We report on the experimental observation of large self-deflection of optical beams and all-optical beam steering. We have observed optically-induced index changes in excess of 0.08, resulting in up to 27 resolvable spots of deflection.

articleTitle: Scaling laws of femtosecond laser induced breakdown in dielectric films
abstract: Measured pulse duration and band-gap scaling of the laser breakdown threshold in oxide dielectrics is explained by multiphoton and impact ionization, and relaxation. Formation of self-trapped excitons on a sub-ps time scale is observed.

articleTitle: High-power laser beam control by PTR Bragg gratings
abstract: Volume Bragg gratings (VBG) with efficiency exceeding 95% recorded in a novel patented material, which is a photo-thermo-refractive (PTR) glass, and used for high-power laser beam control. Exceptionally narrow spectral and/or angular selectivity are used for angular magnification in laser scanners, spectral beam combining, and spectral stabilization of semiconductor lasers.

articleTitle: Three and four-photon absorption of a multiphoton absorbing fluorescent probe
abstract: The utility of multiphoton excitation processes has been the subject of increased attention due to their potential applications in biophotonics, biology, and medicine through three-dimensional fluorescence imaging and photodynamic therapy. Evidence of this are the multiple applications of two-photon absorption (2PA) in fluorescence spectroscopy and 3D imaging over the last several years because of its large effective Stoke's Shift and high spatial resolution.[l,2] However, because the irradiation penetration depth of 2PA is limited in medical and biological applications due to the unwanted absorption and scattering when two red photons are used, the scientific communib recently started to explore higher order absorption processes at longer wavelengths such as three- (3PA) and four-photon absorption (IPA) that minimize the scattered light losses, and reduce the unwanted linear absorption in the living organism transparency window.

articleTitle: Self-focusing effects in femtosecond laser-induced damage in solids
abstract: We show that nonlinear propagation phenomena can alter the laser-induced breakdown threshold in bulk materials. These effects play a critical role in the resulting damage morphology and explain previously discrepant damage measurements.

articleTitle: Rewriting 3D storage using fs laser induced modification of spherical Ag nanoparticles in glass
abstract: Ag nanoparticles with gradient of filling factor in glass layer is demonstrated as promising material for rewriting 3D storage and spectral data coding using multicolour fs laser irradiation.

articleTitle: Hg/sub 1-x/Cd/sub x/Ga/sub 2/S/sub 4/ crystals as new materials for mid-infrared parametric oscillators pumped by Nd:YAG lasers
abstract: High-quality Hg/sub 1-x/Cd/sub x/Ga/sub 2/S/sub 4/ crystals were grown. Their main optical and thermophysical properties were investigated. Efficient Nd:YAG pumped optical parametric oscillators were demonstrated using these crystals which appear promising for powerful tunable generation in the mid-infrared.

articleTitle: Generation of TW 10-fs blue pulses by compensation of pulse front distortion in broadband frequency doubling
abstract: Pulse front distortion has been compensated by using modified broadband frequency doubling (BFD) with a repetition rate of 1 kHz. TW pulses will be generated with a 10-Hz Ti:sapphire system by this technique.

articleTitle: A new concept for micro-mechanically tunable long wavelength VCSELs
abstract: We present an electrically pumped micro-mechanically tunable long wavelength VCSEL based on a new two-chip concept with a tuning range of around 40 nm and a maximum cw output power at room temperature of 0.5 mW.

articleTitle: Reducing effect of atmospheric refractive index fluctuations in beam propagation
abstract: Propagation using higher order Hermite-Gaussian modes in some cases is less sensitive to refractive index fluctuations than the lowest order Gaussian laser beam.

articleTitle: Optical trapping and fluorescence detection of polystyrene beads in an all-optical-fiber platform
abstract: We report the fabrication of an all-fiber, planar-design optical tweezers system used for trapping, excitation and fluorescence detection. The system is capable of detecting fluorescence from a single chemically treated, 6 mum polystyrene bead

articleTitle: Wideband gas sensing using long path THz spectroscopy
abstract: Using a THz white cell configuration to realize long path length terahertz propagation, trace gas detection has been demonstrated in methyl chloride. This is achieved by observing free-induction decay pulses in the time domain.

articleTitle: Optical waveguides fabricated by electron-beam irradiation of Ge-doped flame-hydrolysis silica
abstract: The refractive index distribution and birefringence of electron-beam directly-written waveguides in flame-hydrolysis silica have been characterized by means of micro-reflectivity and mode characterization. These results allow the detail design and fabrication of complex optical devices using this fabrication technique

articleTitle: Ultrastable optical clock with neutral atoms in an engineered light shift trap
abstract: We report on the Doppler-free spectroscopy of the 5s/sup 2/ /sup 1/S/sub 0/ (F=9/2) 5s5p /sup 3/P/sub 0/ (F-9/2) clock transition of /sup 87/Sr atoms trapped in a one-dimensional optical lattice and discuss its prospects as a future optical standard.

articleTitle: Raman-tweezers spectroscopic method for rapid identification of microorganisms in liquid medium
abstract: A Raman-tweezers spectroscopic method has been developed for rapid detection and identification of single biological agents based on vibrational spectroscopy and multivariate analyses.

articleTitle: Interferometric characterization of transmission diffraction gratings with non-flat substrate surfaces
abstract: We demonstrate a side-diffraction interferometric method for characterization of transmission diffraction gratings enabling simultaneous measurement of the local chirp and substrate thickness variation.

articleTitle: Efficient Tm:silica fiber laser pumped Ho:YAG lasers
abstract: Ho:YAG lasers employing standing-wave and ring cavity configurations have yielded 6.4 W of multi-axial-mode output and 3.7 W of single-axial-mode output at 2.1 /spl mu/m respectively for <9.6 W of incident pump power at /spl sim/1.9 /spl mu/m from a cladding-pumped Tm:silica fiber laser.

articleTitle: Photonics in optically-induced lattices
abstract: We overview our results on nonlinear photonics in optically-induced oneand two-dimensional lattices, including Bragg scattering, Bloch-wave interaction, formation of gap and vortex solitons.

articleTitle: Wavelength-agile noncollinear optical parametric oscillators with periodically poled KTiOPO/sub 4/
abstract: Spectral and spatial properties of the output beams are investigated in noncollinear periodically poled KTiOPO/sub 4/ OPO. Noncollinear idler-resonant counterpropagating ring parametric oscillators for simple and continuous tunability are realized in a single cavity.

articleTitle: Dispersion of the nonlinear refractive index and the two-photon absorption coefficient in the silicate glass SF-59
abstract: We present results on the characterization of the nonlinear refractive index and the two-photon absorption coefficient of the silicate glass SF-59 using a picosecond z-scan technique over the 550-1600 nm wavelength range.

articleTitle: External-refractive-index-insensitive long period grating inscribed on a polarization maintaining fiber
abstract: Core mode coupling to inner cladding mode by long period fiber gratings written in polarization maintaining fiber is reported. Their characteristics such as insensitivity to external refractive index and dependence to input polarizations are shown.

articleTitle: Motivations and challenges for high energy petawatt lasers at the National Ignition Facility
abstract: Potential applications of future multi-kilojoule short pulse laser systems and enabling research and development efforts for such lasers at the Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory will be reviewed.

articleTitle: Programmable terahertz waveforms generated via optical rectification of shaped ultrafast laser pulses
abstract: We have demonstrated the use of optical pulse-shaping technique in conjunction with difference frequency generation in a nonlinear optoelectronic crystal for the generation of computer-designed electromagnetic waveforms at terahertz frequency.

articleTitle: Quasi-phase-matched second harmonic generation using 42/spl deg/ rotated Y-cut near-stoichiometric lithium tantalate
abstract: We have periodically poled 42/spl deg/ rotated Y-cut near-stoichiometric lithium tantalate crystals. These crystals enable QPM in surface-normal configurations for scaling to large apertures. Initial SHG results are consistent with theoretical expectations.

articleTitle: Characterization of protons and deuterons from intense 35 fs laser heated water droplet plasma
abstract: Deeply modulated MeV ion spectra are obtained from water droplet targets irradiated by intense (/spl sim/ 10/sup 19/ W/cm/sup 2/) laser pulses. Multi electron-temperature plasma, which has been verified experimentally, can account for the spectral modulations.

articleTitle: Reduced photorefraction in hafnium-doped single-domain and periodically-poled lithium niobate crystals
abstract: Measurements of photo-induced birefringence n single domain and periodically poled lithium niobate (LN) crystals containing different non-photorefractive impurities are presented. We find that doping by HfO/sub 2/ is very effective in reducing the photorefraction.

articleTitle: Semiconductor-based carrier-envelope phase detector
abstract: We study the carrier-envelope phase sensitivity of the inversion in a two-band semiconductor and the influence of rapid dephasing of higher-lying states. The application of this effect for constructing a solid-state phase detector is investigated.

articleTitle: Long-wave infrared chemical sensing based on orientation-patterned GaAs
abstract: This study employs orientation-patterned GaAs as part of a broadly tunable, continuous-wave, difference frequency generation (DFG) source for ultra-trace gas detection applications. The DFG source forms the basis of a long-wave (8-12 /spl mu/m) infrared cavity ring-down spectrometer. The combined high sensitivity of cavity ring-down spectroscopy coupled with the broad tunability of the DFG source allows both identification and quantification of a broad range of species.

articleTitle: Quantum optics of single quantum dots and single impurities
abstract: We present our investigations on triggered single-photon and photon pair emission from single quantum dots (QDs), QDs in microcavities, and individual nitrogen-bound excitons in a ZnSe quantum well structure.

articleTitle: Electro-optic Bragg grating couplers for fast reconfigurable optical waveguide interconnects
abstract: We present an array of electro-optic Bragg gratings to couple optical signals among transceivers through on-chip polymeric waveguides for optical interconnect applications. These integrated couplers provide a promising solution to facilitate dynamically reconfigurable optical interconnects architecture for intra-chip, chip-to-chip and board-to-board data communications. The demonstrated switching speed is 75 /spl mu/s.

articleTitle: 1 MW peak-, 20 W average-power, sub-nanosecond pulse amplifier
abstract: We describe the amplification of sub-nanosecond pulses with peak powers reaching 1 MW using a three-pass diode laser pumped Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4 </sub> amplifier seeded with the output of a passively Q-switched 1 micron microchip laser

articleTitle: Light-induced direct-write patterning of inverted domains in lithium niobate
abstract: We developed a technique to directly write ferroelectric domain patterns, with feature sizes down to 2 /spl mu/m, into lithium niobate crystals using a diffraction limited visible light spot. Local temperature measurements exclude a pure temperature effect.

articleTitle: Photoacoustic gas spectroscopy using a tunable solid state laser emitting around 2.4 /spl mu/m
abstract: We present the first trace-gas measurements using a novel Cr/sup 2+/:ZnSe laser source emitting in the 2.4 /spl mu/m wavelength region. The detection limits are in the sub-ppmV to few ppmV range. Examples of measurements of ambient air are presented.

articleTitle: Ultraviolet microcavity lasing behaviors of oriented ZnO nanowires grown by hydrothermal oxidation
abstract: Observation of polarized supernarrow spectral emissions (/spl sim/0.7 nm) near 378 nm with low lasing threshold, ultrafast lifetime, stable and regular longitudinal-modes from highly aligned ZnO nanowhiskers can be well explained by the microcavity laser model.

articleTitle: Classification of modes in multi-moded photonic crystal microcavities
abstract: Resonant modes in multi-moded photonic crystal cavities are experimentally characterized and we obtain excellent agreement between these observations and predictions based on a combination of finite-difference time-domain simulations, group theory, and Green's functions.

articleTitle: Waveguide laser written by a diode-pumped femtosecond oscillator
Degradation diagnosis of ultra-high-molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) by terahertz-time-domain spectroscopy
abstract: We present that degradation of ultra-high-molecular-weight-polyethylene induces drastic absorption-increase ranging continuously over the THz region. This demonstrates the possibility that THz-TDS is applied to quality-control of ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene, which is widely utilized in medical implants.

articleTitle: High-power 2.1-/spl mu/m GaSb-based laser diode arrays
abstract: High-power 2.1 /spl mu/m GaInAsSb/AlGaAsSb single-spatial mode laser diode arrays are described. Continuous wave output powers of 1.4 W have been achieved with a 64-element array.

articleTitle: Single frequency solid state laser operated with multi-beam waist mode under tightly focused axial pumping
abstract: Single frequency losing is achieved even above 15 times of threshold at the 1/3-degenerate resonator configuration in a tight-focused Nd:YVO/sub 4/ laser. It results from almost uniformly spatial hole-burning due to excitation of multi-beam waist mode.

articleTitle: Diode-pumped femtosecond laser oscillator with cavity dumping
abstract: A diode pumped tunable Yb:glass femtosecond laser oscillator with electro-optical cavity dumping generates pulses with energies sufficient for various scientific and industrial applications. This laser forms a potential compact laser source for micromachining.

articleTitle: Strategy for reducing the out-of-plane radiation loss in photonic crystal waveguides on high-index substrates
abstract: Two-dimensional photonic crystal linear defect waveguides on semiconductor substrates are studied numerically. We predict that the vertical radiation loss can be reduced by using asymmetric photonic crystal claddings.

articleTitle: Polycrystalline low index contrast opals: Towards novel multimodal spectroscopy of diffusive sources of light
abstract: It is shown that polycrystalline low index contrast opals with submillimeter domains provide spatio-spectral diversity of scattering images that can be used for measuring the wavelengths of diffusive sources of light with nanometer accuracy.

articleTitle: Directly diode-pumped oscillators and regenerative amplifiers for ultra-short pulse generation
abstract: We present a review of new ytterbium doped crystals (Yb:GdCOB, Yb:BOYS and Yb:SYS) used to develop sub-100-fs diode-pumped oscillators at around 1 /spl mu/m and a regenerative amplifier producing 380-fs, up to 100-/spl mu/j at 350-Hz.

articleTitle: Performance of a 10 Gb/s optical code division multiple access channel in the presence of an interferer
abstract: Bit error rate performance of a spectrally phase encoded optical code division multiple access system at 10 Gb/s that employs a nonlinear fiber threshold discriminator is measured in the presence of an interferer

articleTitle: Exploring the deterministic nature of femtosecond laser-induced optical breakdown and applications to nanomachining
abstract: The limits of nanoscale machining with sub-picosecond pulsed lasers are systematically characterized. We propose that the minimum scale is ultimately limited by the valence electron density, thus enabling highly reproducible machining at the nanometer scale.

articleTitle: Laser machining using temporally controlled ultrafast pulses
abstract: Summary form only given. This presentation describes a micromachining technique using temporally controlled amplified ultrafast laser pulses. The temporal control is achieved by modulating frequency components of the spatially dispersed ultrafast pulses. User-defined pulse bursts are synthesized, for which the pulse-to-pulse separation time, pulse energy, and pulse width are individually controlled. These pulse bursts are then focused on metal, semiconductor, and dielectric samples and the machining characteristics are noted. The experimental results show that there is a distinct effect of the pulse separation ranging from sub-picosecond to tens of picoseconds on the machining characteristics. The results of machining using ultrafast pulse bursts are correlated with the time scales of physical phenomena occurring during ultrafast laser matter interaction, including non-linear optical absorption, energy transfer, and the explosive type of phase transformation. Time-resolved experimental investigations of these processes are also performed to provide a better understanding of ultrafast laser machining using the pulse bursts.

articleTitle: Development of thick volume holographic gratings for narrowband spectral filter applications
abstract: We have written volume holographic gratings in MEMPLEX photopolymer substrate of thickness >5 mm. Spectral acceptance of <1 /spl Aring/ coupled with high diffraction efficiencies around 500 nm demonstrate these holograms to be ideal for narrowband spectral filtering applications.

articleTitle: GaNAs/GaAsSb type II active regions for 1.3-1.5 /spl mu/m operation
abstract: We investigated a new active material consisting of GaNAs/GaAsSb type II quantum wells on GaAs for 1.3-1.5 /spl mu/m wavelength operation. Absorption spectra of two samples with different compositions were measured, showing good agreement with simulation.

articleTitle: The role of the native oxide on silicon in femtosecond laser damage threshold studies at grazing incidence
abstract: Femtosecond laser ablation studies of silicon with and without the native oxide on the surface were conducted in an ultrahigh vacuum environment. SEM results show a clear difference in the laser intensity threshold for ablation.

articleTitle: Growth and laser operation of an Yb-doped epitaxial tungstate crystal Yb:KY(WO/sub 4/)/sub 2//KY(WO/sub 4/)/sub 2/
abstract: High quality epitaxial double tungstate crystals were grown and continuous-wave laser operation at 1030 nm was demonstrated for the first time with a 25-/spl mu/m-thin Yb:KYW layer on a KYW substrate.

articleTitle: Femtosecond waveform transfer from 800 nm to 400 nm wavelength by type II second harmonic generation
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time a pulse shape frequency transfer scheme using type II second harmonic generation (SHG). Our technique allows general control of both the intensity and phase profiles of the output waveform.

articleTitle: Damage thresholds and nonlinear optical performance of GaP
abstract: Damage threshold and nonlinear optical performance of bulk gallium phosphide (GaP) is reported. Damage threshold as a function of both wavelength and pulse width are investigated. Nonlinear optical performance in the infrared is also presented.

articleTitle: 35 GHz passive mode-locking of InGaAs/GaAs quantum dot lasers at 1.3 /spl mu/m with Fourier-limited pulses
abstract: We report 35 GHz passive mode-locking and 20 GHz hybrid mode-locking of quantum dot (QD) lasers at 13 /spl mu/m. Our investigations show ultrafast absorber recovery times and for the first time transform-limited mode-locked pulses.

articleTitle: Highly efficient site-selective laser emission in the 900 nm range in Nd:strontium lanthanum aluminate
abstract: Efficient quasi-three-level-laser emission in 900 nm range is obtained for Nd/sup 3+/ in strontium lanthanum aluminate. The dependence of laser emission on crystal composition and pump wavelength is correlated with the spectroscopic and structural properties.

articleTitle: Tunable dual wavelength NRZ-to-RZ data format conversion using a non-dc-biased Fabry-Perot laser diode with external pseudo-random-binary-sequence seeding
abstract: The conversion of a NRZ-format data stream into a wavelength-tunable RZ-format pulse code by externally seeding a purely sinusoidal-modulated Fabry-Perot laser diode with an optical pseudo-random-binary-sequence data is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Femtosecond pulse encoding and self phase-reconstruction by time-ordered recording/readout in a periodic diffractive optics (TORPEDO)
abstract: A new scheme for pulse recording, time-reversed playback, and self-phase reconstruction in a diffractive device was proposed. Self pulse recompression of a femtosecond pulse train has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Controlling and recording attosecond atomic transients
abstract: The interaction of controlled few-cycle light fields with atoms allows the reproducible generation of isolated sub-fs electron and X-ray photon wavepackets. These tools can be used to record atomic excitation and relaxation processes in the time domain with a resolution within the Bohr orbit time (/spl sim/ 150 as).

articleTitle: Modulation-dependent frequency shifts in CPT-based atomic clocks
abstract: When frequency modulation is used to detect coherent population trapping resonances, shifts proportional to the modulation parameters and the laser detuning from the excited state are observed. These shifts limit the stability of CPT-based atomic clocks.

articleTitle: 1-D photonic crystal waveguide micro-cavity for ultra sensitive nano-particle detection
abstract: We demonstrate a Si micron-size photonic device for the detection of low concentrations of metal nano-particles used as analyte labels. A density of less than 2 particles per area of the sensing region was detectible

articleTitle: Compact semiconductor-based chirped-pulse amplification laser system
abstract: A compact chirped pulse amplification laser was developed based on fiber pigtailed semiconductor gain elements and chirped fiber Bragg gratings. The shoebox sized system produced 10 pJ, 1 MHz pulsetrains, amplified to 7 nJ with inclusion of EDFA.

articleTitle: Double pumped OPO generates signal that matches the pump temporal characteristics
abstract: We have demonstrated that a nanosecond OPO, can be made to closely follow the temporal width and shape of its pump beam. This is an advancement toward efficient sum frequency generation.

articleTitle: A simple post-processing technique to improve the retrieval accuracy of second-order nonlinearity profiles
abstract: An iterative process known as the Fienup algorithm is applied to correct and improve the accuracy of the second-order optical nonlinearity profile of thin films. This post-processing technique is simple, fast and provides perfect agreement with experimental data.

articleTitle: Modulational instability induced by loss dispersion in optical fiber
abstract: We obtain a closed-form expression of modulational-instability gain in an optical fiber with arbitrary loss/gain and group-velocity dispersions. It reveals that instability is induced by the loss dispersion even in the normal group-velocity dispersion regime.

articleTitle: First demonstration of magnetic resonators in the mid-IR
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate, for the first time, mid-IR resonant magnetic structures with properties consistent with negative permeability. This result is an important step toward the achievement of a negative refractive index in the IR.

articleTitle: Novel fibre Bragg grating design using multiobjective evolutionary algorithms
abstract: A multiobjective evolutionary algorithm was used to design a FBG for optical clock signal extraction, yielding a population of filters that are optimal with respect to three or four different spectral criteria.

articleTitle: Adaptive optics in ultra-intense laser chains: the mid-field issue
abstract: We will investigate issues that have to be considered in using adaptive optics in ultra-intense femtosecond laser systems. Solutions will be presented.

articleTitle: Subpicosecond magneto-optical sampling with Cd/sub 1-x/Mn/sub x/Te
abstract: We demonstrate a magneto-optical sampling technique using a novel Cd/sub 0.45/Mn/sub 0.55/Te transducer. Our MO sampling is characterized by subpicosecond time resolution and complements electro-optical sampling, allowing complete (current and voltage) characterization of ultrafast electrical devices.

articleTitle: Wavelength tunability of femtosecond Yb fiber lasers
abstract: We mode-locked Yb fiber lasers can generate 100-fs pulses in the range of 1020-1070 nm. The tuning provides good solutions for medical/biological applications and seed in high-power ultrashort pulse fiber amplifiers.

articleTitle: Fabrication and laser performance of polycrystal and single crystal Nd:YAG by advanced ceramic processing
abstract: We report the first demonstration of polycrystalline, Nd-doped YAG ceramics with almost perfect pore-free structure and Nd-doped single crystal by advanced ceramic processing. We obtain optical slope efficiencies of 57% with these microchip ceramics lasers.

articleTitle: Self-referencing spectral interferometry for the characterization of attosecond electromagnetic pulses
abstract: We propose a method for complete characterization of attosecond pulses produced by high harmonic generation, based on self-referencing spectral shearing interferometry measured directly in the XUV with a shear created by two pump pulses.

articleTitle: Generation of high power 1535 nm light from a short cavity cladding pumped Er:Yb phosphate fiber laser
abstract: More than 3.5 W power at 1535 nm is efficiently generated from a cladding pumped Er:Yb codoped 14 cm-long phosphate fiber laser. The short cavity length shows potential capability for watt level single frequency output.

articleTitle: Novel IR-sensitive photorefractive polymer composite
abstract: We demonstrate the first recording of photorefractive gratings in polymer thin-films at a wavelength of 1550 nm. Our results open the window for the application of polymeric photorefractive devices in optical communication.

articleTitle: Efficient broadband second harmonic generation in periodically-poled potassium niobate
abstract: Efficient broad-band SHG was demonstrated by simultaneous matching of group-velocity and phase-velocity in a 10.5 mm long periodically-poled potassium niobate. The QPM bandwidth was 38 nm, which is broad enough for 100 fs pulse doubling.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave mid-infrared difference-frequency generation in lithium-based semiconductors (LiInS/sub 2/ and LiInSe/sub 2/)
abstract: Continuous-wave (cw) difference-frequency generation (DFG) in the infrared (5-11 /spl mu/m) using LiInS/sub 2/ and LiInSe/sub 2/ crystals is reported: Type II (eoe) critically phase-matched DFG processes have been experimentally investigated. Spectral and angular tuning and conversion efficiencies are discussed.

articleTitle: 20-MeV temperature electron jets
abstract: We present the generation of electron jets of a temperature of about 20 MeV. The electron jets are highly collimated to a divergence of less than 10 millirad.

articleTitle: Induced second order nonlinearities at the ferroelectric domain walls in periodically poled KTiOPO/sub 4/
abstract: The magnitude and spatial distribution of second order nonlinearities induced by a static electric field in ferroelectric domain wall regions are characterized for periodically-poled KTiOPO/sub 4/. The nonlinearities can be employed for characterizing quasi-phasematched structures.

articleTitle: Self-stabilization of carrier-envelope phase of an OPA verified by with a photonic crystal fiber
abstract: Self-stabilization was verified for the carrier-envelope phase of idler pulses from a noncollinear OPA by spectral interference between supercontinuum (SC) and its second harmonic. SC is obtained by transmission of the idler through a photonic-crystal fiber.

articleTitle: Novel multisectional bending polymeric waveguide polarizer
abstract: Based on coherent-coupling effect, a novel multisectional bending waveguide polarizer is demonstrated. The polarizer consists of a polymer waveguide with a birefringent polyimide buried in it. The simulated polarization extinction ratio is 42.6 dB/mm.

articleTitle: Impact of polydispersity on optical quality of colloidal photonic crystals
abstract: We investigate the impact of the non-uniformity of the particle size on the lattice quality and the optical properties of colloidal photonic crystals. Size variations exceeding /spl sim/2% result in disordered lattices with degraded optical properties.

articleTitle: Fabrication of periodically-poled Zn-doped LiNbO/sub 3/ for adhered ridge waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate periodical poling in adhered Zn-doped LiNbO/sub 3/ with an insulating layer and achieved an efficient quasi-phase-matched difference-frequency-generation device that has an adhered ridge waveguide structure.

articleTitle: High resolution molecular spectroscopy in the mid-infrared by a free running pulsed doubly resonant optical parametric oscillator
abstract: We present what we believe to be the first demonstration of high resolution molecular spectroscopy in the mid-infrared by a free running pulsed optical parametric oscillator. Absorption spectroscopy of N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2 </sub>O is demonstrated as an application

articleTitle: External injection of a gain switched integrated dual laser source for the generation of widely tunable picosecond pulses with large SMSR
abstract: By using external injection into a gain-switched source containing two FP lasers we have developed a pulse source that is wavelength tunable over 65 nm, with SMSR > 60 dB across the tuning range.

articleTitle: Vacuum ultraviolet argon excimer laser at 126 nm produced by an ultrashort high-intensity laser
abstract: We have observed intense Ar/sub 2/* emission at 126 nm with a small signal gain of 5%/cm by use of an Ar-filled hollow fiber to guide the high intensity laser propagation in a high-pressure argon.

articleTitle: Enhanced frequency response in buried ridge quantum well intermixed SGDBR laser modulators
abstract: We have studied the effects of various proton implant profiles on the performance of buried-ridge-stripe electro-absorption modulators monolithically integrated with SG-DBR lasers. Two implant profiles were performed adjacent to the buried ridge, enhancing the bandwidth.

articleTitle: Generation and wavelength conversion of conversion of laser light in photonic crystal fibres
abstract: Through radically enhanced control of the guided modes, PCF is giving rise to a new generation of high performance all-fibre devices, including gas-Raman cells, supercontinuum sources, nonlinear wavelength converters and ultra-high power cladding-pumped lasers.

articleTitle: High power fiber lasers and amplifiers
abstract: Recent developments in the field of high-power fiber laser systems are reviewed. Basic limitations have been overcome by applying novel fiber-designs and experimental strategies, leading to significant power-scaling of continuous-wave and pulsed-fiber lasers and amplifiers.

articleTitle: X-ray diffraction with sub-picosecond time resolution
abstract: Microplasmas generated by femtosecond laser pulses emit short bursts of multi-keV X-rays. X-ray diffraction of these pulses can be used to probe ultrafast changes in the atomic configuration of the material caused by pulsed laser excitation.

articleTitle: Development of a coherent laser transceiver for the NASA CO/sub 2/ laser absorption spectrometer instrument
abstract: We describe the development of a coherent laser transceiver designed to measure planetary boundary layer CO/sub 2/ from an airborne platform to a concentration precision of 1 ppmv, using the technique of laser absorption spectrometry.

articleTitle: Ultraviolet laser diodes
abstract: Summary form only given. We have demonstrated ultraviolet laser diodes with emission wavelengths down to 348 nm under continuous wave operation, 343 nm pulsed. Lifetimes of 100 hours at 1 mW at wavelengths of 368-372 nm have been achieved.

articleTitle: Fiber optic instrumentation systems for the oil and gas industry
abstract: Fiber optic instrumentation systems are attractive for permanent downhole sensing due to their high reliability and multi-parameter/multiplexing capabilities, and are now being installed in the field. An overview of such systems will be presented.

articleTitle: Signal processing with semiconductor optical amplifiers
abstract: Summary form only given. Semiconductor optical amplifiers offer a wide range of optical processing functions including WDM signal amplification, optical gating, all-optical signal processing like wavelength conversion, regeneration, demultiplexing, logic functions. This tutorial will review the progress of SOA-based functions exploiting both linear and nonlinear operation.

articleTitle: Quasi-phase-matching in nonlinear optics: Principles and practice
abstract: Spatial modulation of a nonlinear optical process provides a versatile means for achieving phase-matching of the generated waves. This tutorial will introduce the general principles of this quasi-phase-matching technique and illustrate its benefits in a range of nonlinear optical materials and devices.

articleTitle: Gas sensing using air-guiding photonic bandgap fibers
abstract: We report on experimental studies of gas sensing using air-guiding photonic bandgap fibers. The photonic bandgap fibers have at one end been spliced to standard single mode fibers for ease of use and improved stability

articleTitle: Self phase modulation induced spectral broadening in silicon waveguides
abstract: We have investigated spectral broadening as a mean to generate multiple wavelengths on a silicon chip. A 2/spl times/ broadening at 22 W//spl mu/m/sup 2/ of peak pulse power is demonstrated and a 7/spl times/ is predicted at 70 W/cm/sup 2/.

articleTitle: Control of light emission by 3D photonic crystal
abstract: 3D photonic crystals with light-emitters and point-defects are fabricated and investigated. It is experimentally shown that light-emission is suppressed at the complete crystal parts, while cavity modes are successfully observed at the defect parts.

articleTitle: Optical parametric oscillation in quasi-phase-matched GaAs
abstract: We demonstrate a GaAs based OPO. The singly resonant, pulsed OPO utilized an all-epitaxially-grown orientation-patterned GaAs (OP-GaAs) crystal. By tuning either near-IR pump wavelength or OP-GaAs temperature, we achieved broad tunability between 2 and 10 microns.

articleTitle: Vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser active regions for enhanced performance with optical pumping
abstract: We have developed an improved active region design for optically pumped vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers. We have reduced device thresholds by over 50% and raised maximum lasing temperatures to 79 /spl deg/C while attaining 76% pump efficiencies.

articleTitle: Active mode locking of broadband quantum cascade lasers
abstract: Active mode-locking in broadband quantum cascade lasers with a repetition rate of about 14.3 GHz has been achieved through the modulation of the laser bias current.

articleTitle: Sub-85 fs mode-locked erbium fiber oscillator with tunable repetition rate
abstract: We present a sub-85 fs mode-locked erbium fiber oscillator with an average output power of 14 mW. The pulse repetition rate is tunable between 55.3 MHz and 56.4 MHz enabling improved applications in precision metrology at 1.55 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: 40 Gb/s transmission over 140 m 62.5 /spl mu/m multimode fiber using polarization controlled launch
abstract: Launch polarizations excite different modes in commercial-grade multi-mode fiber. By controlling input polarization and monitoring output eye-diagram, 40 Gb/s transmission over 140 m 62.5/125 /spl mu/m fiber is demonstrated using return-to-zero format with readily available single-mode transceivers.

articleTitle: Direct frequency comb generation from a prismless Ti:sapphire laser
