abstract: We describe a self-referenced optical frequency comb generator based on an octave spanning, prismless Ti:sapphire laser. Current versions operate at 80 MHz and 150 MHz. System scaling to GHz repetition rates is possible

articleTitle: Two-dimensional endoscopic MEMS scanner for high resolution optical coherence tomography
abstract: High resolution OCT is demonstrated with a novel two-dimensional MEMS scanner employing comb-drive actuation. Imaging is demonstrated with a Cr/sup 4+/:forsterite laser and high-speed scanning to achieve /spl sim/5 /spl mu/m axial resolution at up to 20 frames/sec.

articleTitle: 1.3 kW Yb-doped fiber laser with excellent beam quality
Femtosecond irradiation induced refractive-index changes and channel waveguiding in bulk Ti/sup 3+/:sapphire
abstract: Femtosecond writing of refractive-index changes in sapphire is demonstrated by doping the crystal with an appropriate ion (here: Ti/sup 3+/) that reduces the threshold of the process. Passive and active buried channel waveguiding is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Parallel-plate THz transmitter
abstract: Direct THz excitation of a parallel plate waveguide is demonstrated. The transmitter yields a THz signal with and without an applied bias, and is the next step toward a guided wave TEM-mode THz bandwidth device.

articleTitle: Single-mode operation of terahertz quantum cascade lasers with distributed feedback resonators
abstract: Single-mode operation at 4.4 THz is obtained from distributed-feedback quantum-cascade lasers with complex-coupling metallic gratings. The emission shows a stable side-mode suppression of more than 20 dB at all injection currents and operating temperatures.

articleTitle: 200-mW, narrow-linewidth 1064.2-nm Yb-doped fiber laser
abstract: A single-frequency fiber laser at 1064.2 nm is demonstrated with >200-mW output. Homodyne measurements yield 3-kHz FWHM linewidth. Wavelength tuning by more than 0.2 nm was demonstrated to cover the entire emission spectrum of Nd:YAG.

articleTitle: 60 W, 10 GHz 4.5 ps pulse source at 1.5 /spl mu/m
abstract: We demonstrate high power amplification of 4.5 ps pulses from a compact gain-switched laser diode. Average powers of 60 W are obtained after amplification in a double-clad Er/Yb co-doped fiber amplifier with pulse peak powers of 1.33 kW at laser repetition rates of 10 GHz.

articleTitle: Crosstalk reduction in wavelength division multiplexed analog links through polarization modulation
abstract: The crosstalk produced by polarization modulation and amplitude modulation for a 25 km, 200 GHz spaced, wavelength division multiplexed analog link is compared. Polarization modulation results in an improvement of up to 35 dB

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of a 2.5 Gbps incoherent 2D OCDMA system
abstract: We demonstrate error-free operation of 4 simultaneous users in a fast frequency-hopping time-spreading OCDMA system at 2.5 Gbps. Effective power penalty was < 0.5 dB. Ultrafast all optical sampling gate was used to eliminate multiple access interference

articleTitle: Frequency comb linewidth of an actively mode-locked fiber laser
abstract: We have measured the linewidth of frequency comb lines from a mode-locked fiber laser. The effective linewidth is 12 kHz over 5 ms, and the intrinsic linewidth is estimated to be less than 3 kHz

articleTitle: Wavelength demultiplexer using arrayed waveguides with linearly varying refractive index distribution
abstract: A novel wavelength demultiplexer using straight arrayed waveguide with linearly varying refractive index distribution has been investigated. Fabrication of devices is achieved and simple wavelength separation yielded successfully result.

articleTitle: Dual-frequency laser at 1.53 /spl mu/m for generating high-purity optically carried microwave signals up to 20 GHz
abstract: We report on a dual-frequency Er:Yb:glass laser at 1.53 /spl mu/m. The frequency difference can be tuned from 100 MHz to 20 GHz, and phase-locked to a microwave reference in order to achieve low phase noise (-130 dBc/Hz).

articleTitle: Non-uniform spectral encoding for enhanced multi-user performance in optical CDMA networks
abstract: We propose a novel non-uniform spectral coding scheme in an optical-CDMA system that utilizes spectral phase encoded time-spreading (SPECTS). The new method achieves lower multi-user-interference and twice network capacity for Gaussian spectral shape optical pulses.

articleTitle: Spherical beam holograms for spectroscopic applications: Modeling and implementation
abstract: A new approach for analyzing spherical beam holograms is presented and tested. This method describes the diffraction effect in spherical beam holograms and its application in spectroscopy. The theoretical results are verified by experiments.

articleTitle: 900 mW continuous wave operation of AlInGaP tapered lasers and superluminescent diodes at 640 nm
abstract: 900 mW of continuous-wave power has been achieved in AlInGaP tapered lasers at 640 nm. Good beam quality and high device efficiency are obtained. Superluminescent diodes show strongly increased spectral width while retaining the good beam properties.

articleTitle: Planar-waveguide integrated spectral comparator
abstract: A spectral comparator based on integrated planar holographic Bragg grating reflectors (HBRs) is demonstrated. The silica-on-silicon planar waveguide device projects input signal spectra onto two complementary spectral output channels providing spectral identification.

articleTitle: 10-GHz passively mode-locked surface-emitting semiconductor laser with 1.4 W output power
Requirements for solid-state lighting
abstract: Summary form only given. White light-emitting diodes (LED) became a commercial reality almost three decades after the demonstration of the first monochromatic LED. The LED's potential for energy savings and the promise of reduced maintenance costs are the two main features that caught the attention of the community interested in general illumination. So far, LEDs have proved their usefulness and have started to displace traditional light sources, such as the incandescent lamp, in certain niche applications where monochromatic light is required. However, LEDs have yet to demonstrate their capabilities in general lighting applications. At present, researchers and manufacturers around the world are aggressively working toward developing a light source that could replace traditional light sources, such as incandescent and fluorescent lamps, in general lighting applications. For LEDs to directly compete with any of these technologies for a given application, they have to meet the characteristics of the target light sources in all areas. As an example, although amber LEDs have demonstrated luminous efficacies greater than 100 Im/W, they cannot compete with fluorescent lamps in office lighting applications because luminous efficacy is not the only parameter that makes a fluorescent lamp suitable for this application. A lighting specifier considers several parameters prior to selecting a light source for a given application. The parameters usually considered include light output, color (color appearance and color rendering properties), lamp life, and cost (initial and life cycle cost). The importance of any of these parameters varies widely depending on the application. For example, in a residential lighting application, cost, color, and light output are the most important parameters. That is why the incandescent lamp has been so popular in this application. Alternatively, in commercial office lighting applications, the linear fluorescent lamp became the most popular light source because light output, color, and lamp life are the most important parameters in this application. Presently, the community interested in developing solid-state light sources is targeting high luminous efficacy, greater than 200 Im/W, and high color rendering index (CRI), greater than 90, for high-brightness white LEDs. As described above, these parameters alone may not make LED light sources readily acceptable for general illumination applications. Therefore, the goal of this tutorial paper is to introduce the relevant lighting parameters to those interested in developing solid-state light sources and help them understand the needs of the lighting community.

articleTitle: Performance of high-rate high-sensitivity optical communications with forward error correction coding
abstract: High-sensitivity optical communications with coding is investigated experimentally to explore performance limits in the low photon-per-bit regime. Receiver sensitivities of 11 and 16 photons-per-bit at bit-error-rate are demonstrated for OOK and DPSK at 1OGbps

articleTitle: Dynamic DMD-driven optoelectronics tweezers for microscopic particle manipulation
abstract: We demonstrate dynamic manipulation of microscopic particles using a DMD-produced projection image in an optoelectronics tweezers system. Single-particle trapping and movement (up to 40 /spl mu/m/sec) via optically-induced dielectrophoresis were observed.

articleTitle: Variable coherence tomography
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a new optical technique that uses light with variable spatial coherence for determining the stmcture of a scattering medium. This tomographic technique requires recording the intensity scattered in only one direction. 2004 Optical Society of America

articleTitle: High power linearly polarized fiber laser
abstract: We report on a linearly polarized (extinction ratio ~17 dB) large-mode-area fiber laser with an output power above 300 W and diffraction-limited beam quality. The PANDA-design is applied to induce the birefringence in the fiber

articleTitle: Extended large-mode-area single-mode microstructured fiber laser
abstract: We report on a real single-mode microstructured ytterbium-doped air-clad fiber with a mode-field-diameter as high as 45 mum and a pump light absorption of 16 dB/m. This fiber exhibits a significantly reduced nonlinearity

articleTitle: Recording of fiber Bragg gratings with femtosecond pulses using a "point by point" technique
abstract: We report on the realization of fiber Bragg gratings with tightly focused femtosecond pulses using a non-interferometric method. For a 2.1 /spl mu/m period, 2.1 mm long grating, a reflectivity of 9.2% was measured.

articleTitle: Nonlinear effects on the carrier-envelope phase
abstract: Calculations, using Maxwells equations, of nonlinear effects on the carrier-envelope phase of ultrashort pulses propagating in sapphire show that the slope with respect to intensity changes signs due to the finite response time of n/sub 2/.

articleTitle: Tunable all-optical wavelength conversion and wavelength multicasting using orthogonally-polarized fiber FWM
abstract: We demonstrate novel tunable all-optical wavelength conversion and wavelength multicasting using orthogonally-polarized fiber FWM in highly-nonlinear fiber. Less then 0.5 dB power penalty with >25 nm tuning range 3-to-3-multicasting is shown for a 10 Gb/s NRZ system.

articleTitle: Faraday rotation in semiconductors for photonic integration
abstract: Magnetically doped Fe:InP is demonstrated to provide 45/spl deg/ rotation at 1550 nm with only 1.66 dB insertion loss. Enhanced Faraday rotation in Fe:InGaAsP resonators and high-index contrast waveguides is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Wideband-tunable highly pure 40 GHz picosecond soliton train generation by short comb-like profiled fiber
abstract: We demonstrated generation of low-noise 40 GHz CS-RZ 3 ps pulse train with wideband tunability of wider than 20 nm through adiabatic soliton compression in 1.8 km-long comb-like profiled fiber.

articleTitle: Dynamical signatures of self phase-locking in a triply resonant parametric oscillator
abstract: We report on dynamical signatures of signal/idler self phase-locking in a cw frequency divide-by-three optical parametric oscillator subject to two competing /spl chi//sup (2)/ nonlinear processes, confirming the theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: 850 nm single-mode transmission with a mode filter
abstract: A novel transmission scheme for use of inexpensive 850 nm transmitters for conventional single-mode fibers is proposed with a mode filter that rejects high-order-mode power and makes the fiber link single-moded to eliminate inter-modal dispersion.

articleTitle: Three meter long efficient germania-based core fiber Raman laser
abstract: Raman amplification in fiber with germania-based core and silica cladding was investigated for the first time. Only 3 m long efficient Raman laser with output power of 10 W based on this fiber was developed.

articleTitle: Analysis and optimization of a multiwavelength distributed Fabry-Perot fiber laser
abstract: Modeling of multi-wavelength lasers made in erbium-ytterbium co-doped fiber gain medium is performed. Numerical simulations are compared with experimental results. Optimization of the structure in terms of spectral uniformity and output power is addressed.

articleTitle: Ultra-low phase noise optical pulses generated by coupled opto-electronic oscillator
abstract: Ah EDFA-based coupled opto-electronic oscillator (COEO) can generate ultra-low noise optical pulses and microwave signals. The phase noise of the COEO is lower than -135 dBc/Hz at 10 kHz away from a 10 GHz carrier.

articleTitle: A curved-waveguide dual-cavity semiconductor tunable-shape optical filter
abstract: We present properties of a novel active optical filter consisting of grating and phase shifter sections. The filter's spectral shape and group delay are current controllable, making it nseful for variable optical delay-line applications.

articleTitle: Holographic blind signal separation
abstract: A holographic optoelectronic system descrambles linearly mixed random signals. Channel separation is typically 40 dB having 40 kHz signal bandwidth. The system can be extended to handle microwave communications signals having bandwidth approaching 1 GHz.

articleTitle: Design and performance measurement of the mercury laser altimeter
abstract: We report the design and test results of the mercury laser altimeter on the MESSENGER mission to be launched in July-August 2004. The altimeter will provide planet surface topography measurements via laser pulse time-of-flight.

articleTitle: Multiwavelength NRZ-to-RZ conversion with timing-jitter suppression
abstract: We demonstrate a novel, polarization-insensitive scheme for multiwavelength NRZ-to-RZ conversion at 10 Gb/s rate with significant timing jitter suppression. It utilizes an electroabsorption-modulator based optoelectronic oscillator for high quality clock recovery.

articleTitle: Full dispersion compensation in real-time optical coherence tomography with a phase/frequency modulator
abstract: The dispersion of a real-time optical coherent tomography system including a phase modulator was compensated up to the third order. The axial resolution was fully recovered experimentally, which matches very well with theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Slope-matched dispersion-compensating photonic crystal fibre
abstract: We report the first experimental realisation of a dispersion-compensating photonic crystal fibre. With a dispersion of -1211 ps/nm/!un, the fibre compensates 75 times its length of conventional telecoms fibre, and is 85% slope-matched.

articleTitle: Compensation of nonlinear phase jitter in DPSK modulated optical communications systems
abstract: A nonlinear phase jitter compensator is demonstrated in a DPSK optical communication system. The compensator emulates a negative nonlinear refractive index, correcting phase impairments caused by the combination of ASE noise and the Kerr effect.

articleTitle: Tunable external cavity laser with a stationary MEMS grating
abstract: A tunable external cavity laser is demonstrated which uses a deformable MEMS grating as the tuning element. Unlike conventional systems, it has no mechanical motion except for the deformation of the MEMS grating surface

articleTitle: Alpha parameter in quantum-dot amplifier under optical and electrical carrier modulation
abstract: Alpha parameter of a long-wavelength quantum-dot amplifier near 1.3 /spl mu/m is measured to be below one even with saturated gain. A simple model explains difference in apparent alpha parameter under optical and electrical carrier modulation.

articleTitle: Theoretical design and optimization analysis of AC coupled fiber optic burst mode receiver
abstract: A generalized theoretical analysis of an AC coupled fiber optic burst mode receiver for DC balanced transmission is presented. An overall optimization is performed for an optical burst switching network based on tunable laser transmitters

articleTitle: 38 GHz optical single-sideband modulation by using guided-wave electrooptic modulators with periodic polarization-reversal
abstract: Millimeter-wave optical single-sideband modulation by using guided-wave electrooptic modulators with periodic polarization-reversal was experimentally demonstrated. A sideband suppression ratio over 27 dB was obtained at 38 GHz modulation. It leads to the applications to the radio-on-fiber systems.

articleTitle: Microwave arbitrary waveform generation via open-loop, reflective geometry Fourier transform pulse shaper
abstract: We report efficient microwave arbitrary waveform generation by using an open-loop, reflective geometry Fourier transform pulse shaper via dispersively-stretched optical pulse shaping. Application of this technique to ultra-wide bandwidth radio frequency (RF) communication is also discussed.

articleTitle: Power summation and bandwidth narrowing in coherently-coupled fiber laser array
abstract: Coherent beam combining of many fiber lasers realizes both power scaling and spectral narrowing by complex-resonator effect. 85% addition efficiency with only a few longitudinal-modes is obtained in an array of eight 10-nm-bandwidth lasers.

articleTitle: Increased spurious-free dynamic range for an all-Raman 105 km link using phase modulation and balanced detection
abstract: The increased analog performance of a 105 km dispersion-managed, Raman-amplified link is demonstrated using phase modulation and balanced detection. Results are compared to amplitude modulation over the same link.

articleTitle: High--power ultrashort pulses output from a modelocked two-section quantum-dot laser
abstract: We demonstrate modelocking in a two-section quantum-dot lam that produces output power up tu 45mW at 1260nm. The pulse duration could be varied from 2ps down to 400fs at a 21GHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Spatially-indirect photo- and electro-luminescence in the 1.3 /spl mu/m range at room temperature
abstract: We have observed strong spatially-indirect photo- and electro-luminescence in type II InGaAsP/InGaAlAs MQW structures in the 1.3 /spl mu/m range at room temperature.

articleTitle: Absolute frequency measurements with a stabilized near-infrared optical frequency comb from a Cr:forsterite laser
abstract: A Cr:forsterite laser-based frequency comb is stabilized simultaneously to two NIST frequency references. Several optical frequency reference frequencies are then measured from 1315 nm - 1620 nm, including methane lines near 1330 nm.

articleTitle: 150 mW high-power angled-stripe superluminescent diode at 1550 nm
abstract: A 1550 nm superluminescent diode is realized with greater than 150 mW output power at 15/spl deg/C with a spectral bandwidth of 40 nm and spectral modulation of less than 2 dB.

articleTitle: Tunable narrow linewidth high power erbium:ytterbium co-doped fiber laser
abstract: We present a narrow linewidth cladding-pumped erbium:ytterbium co-doped large-core fiber laser with output power up to 70 W at 1560 nm, and tunable from 1550 to 1602 nm using a narrow-band fiber Bragg grating.

articleTitle: Pulse shaper in a loop: demonstration of cascadable all-optical code translation for ultrafast O-CDMA networks
abstract: We demonstrate repetitive M-ary spectral phase pulse shaping at 10 GHz by placing a pulse shaper in a closed loop. Our results show the feasibility of cascadable all-optical code translation for ultrafast O-CDMA networks.

articleTitle: A low-loss GaInNAs SESAM mode-locking a 1.3-/spl mu/m solid-state laser
abstract: We demonstrate a GaInNAs semiconductor saturable absorber mirror (SESAM) self-starting and passively mode-locking a sub-10-ps Nd:YLF laser at 1.3 /spl mu/m. The SESAM's low saturation fluence and negligible nonsaturable losses support stable mode locking.

articleTitle: Linewidth-enhancement factors of InGaAs and InGaAsN single-quantum-well diode lasers
abstract: Gain, loss and /spl alpha/-factor were measured in broad stripe 1.23 /spl mu/m InGaAs and 1.29 /spl mu/m InGaAsN single-QW lasers. Experiment shows that both differential gain with respect to current and /spl alpha/-factor tend to decrease in dilute-nitride devices compared with InGaAs-active lasers.

articleTitle: MEMS based wavelength selective optical switching for integrated photonic circuits
abstract: MEMS-enabled wavelength selective switching by controlling resonance in high-index-contrast optical ring resonators is demonstrated. Fabrication and design considerations for the MEMS switches are explored. Experimental optical switching results are reported.

articleTitle: Resonantly pumped double clad erbium-doped fiber laser
abstract: An erbium-doped double clad fiber laser in-band pumped by a 1535-nm broad area laser is demonstrated. This technique promises scalability to extremely high powers due to the low quantum defect.

articleTitle: Time domain terahertz detection of flaws within space shuttle sprayed on foam insulation
abstract: We demonstrate the detection of voids and disbonds intentionally incorporated within the sprayed on foam insulation of a space shuttle external tank mock-up segment using time domain terahertz (a.k.a. T-Ray) imaging.

articleTitle: A 2 cm-long fiber Fabry-Perot mode-locked laser incorporating carbon nanotubes
abstract: We demonstrate passive mode-locking of short-cavity (/spl sim/2 cm) fiber Fabry-Perot laser by incorporating carbon nanotubes as a saturable absorber. Stable pulses are generated with pulsewidth as short as 0.68 ps and repetition rate as high as 5.18 GHz.

articleTitle: Clean similariton generation from an initial pulse optimized by the backward propagation method
abstract: We investigate the optimum initial pulse to generate a clean similariton. Through the backward propagation method, we show that a chirp-free Gaussian pulse is suitable and its parameters are uniquely determined by fiber parameters.

articleTitle: Ultracompact optical isolator with a silicon high index contrast waveguide
abstract: An ultracompact optical isolator with a silicon high index contrast waveguide is proposed. The device length required for the nonreciprocal operation is only 236 mum at 1.55 mum

articleTitle: High repetition rate femtosecond thin disk Yb:KYW regenerative amplifier without CPA
abstract: We report of an Yb:KYW thin disk amplifier system to provide ultra short pulses with high energies at high repetition rates. Without using chirped pulse amplification, 100 /spl mu/J, 750 fs pulses were generated at repetition rates of up to 45 kHz.

articleTitle: Corner-cut square microcavity coupled waveguide crossing
abstract: We propose corner-cut square microcavity coupled waveguide crossing for single- and higher-order wavelength-selective interconnects. Numerical simulations reveal that corner-cut square microcavities have nearly singlemode spectrum and reduce waveguide crosstalk at resonances.

articleTitle: Mode-hop free sweep tuning of a MEMS tuned cavity semiconductor laser
abstract: Continuous mode-hop free scanning from 1520 to 1570 nm using a compact, environmentally robust MEMS-tuned external cavity semiconductor laser at a rate of 0.4 Hz gives monotonic scans with frequency jitter below 2 MHz

articleTitle: T-rays identify defects in insulating-materials
abstract: THz radiation has been used to uncover small defects in samples of space shuttle foam. This nondestructive method could help NASA to examine the insulating foam that is applied to each shuttle's fuel tank prior to launch.

articleTitle: Dispersion tolerant, 40 Gbit/s duobinary transmission over 800 km without in-line dispersion management
abstract: We show that by combining mid-link spectral-inversion with the duobinary data modulation format, a robust, highly dispersion tolerant 40-Gbit/s transmission system is created

articleTitle: On Raman gain in silicon waveguides: limitations from two-photon-absorption generated carriers
abstract: We show experimentally that free carriers generated by two-photon-absorption in silicon-on-insulator (SOI) waveguides limit the available pump power for stimulated Raman scattering and lead to net optical loss.

articleTitle: Multimode-pumped monolithic amplifier arrays based in erbium-doped phosphate glass
abstract: We demonstrate a monolithic optical amplifier array based on high gain per unit length erbium-doped phosphate glass. Two cores from one 8-cm long chip are cascaded to deliver 22-dB internal gain across the C-band.

articleTitle: High-power Er:YAG laser for coherent laser radar
abstract: We report the development of a high-power Er:YAG laser with high pulse energy for coherent laser radar wind sensing. The 1.645 /spl mu/m Er:YAG laser produced a Q-switched pulse energy of 16 mJ with diffraction-limited beam quality.

articleTitle: Brillouin based OTDR with measurement range of 85 km using combined EDFA and Raman amplification
abstract: We report the enhanced performance of an 85 km single-ended distributed Brillouin based temperature sensor using EDFA and Raman amplification. A temperature resolution of 3degC and spatial resolution of 20 m was achieved

articleTitle: Room temperature operation of quantum cascade lasers in the InAs/AlSb system
Spectroscopy and room-temperature continuous-wave lasing from a new gain material Cr/sup 2+/:ZnS/sub x/Se/sub 1-x/
abstract: We report development, spectroscopic and laser investigation of a novel mid-infrared Cr:ZnS/sub 0.42/Se/sub 0.58/ active medium, exhibiting similar to Cr:ZnS and Cr:ZnSe spectroscopic properties except for the broader emission, making it promising for tuning and mode-locking purposes.

articleTitle: Drastic enhancement of optical non-linearity in InAs quantum dot embedded in photonic crystal waveguide for all-optical switch application
abstract: InAs quantum dots, embedded in a photonic crystal (PC) waveguide, exhibited 13 dB larger extinction ratio in transmittance than that embedded in a conventional waveguide, suggesting ultra-low power operation of the proposed PC-based symmetric-Mach-Zehnder-type all-optical switch.

articleTitle: Miniature supercontinuum laser sources
abstract: We demonstrate several miniature continuum laser sources by combining compact Q-switched lasers with specially designed photonic crystal fibers. A continuum spanning two octaves is obtained with a 1-Watt diode pump.

articleTitle: An interferometric sensor for integration with Si CMOS signal processing circuitry: "Sensor on a chip"
abstract: A scheme for integrating interferometric sensors with Si CMOS circuitry is presented. An integrated biological/chemical sensor provides a low cost, noninvasive alternative to traditional sensor technologies

articleTitle: Passively Q-switched thulium-doped silica fiber laser
abstract: A thulium-doped fiber laser generated pulses with 12 /spl mu/J energy and 16 ns duration at 1822 nm, when passively Q-switched by a Cr/sup 2+/:ZnSe crystal saturable absorber. The repetition rate varied between 2-20 kHz.

articleTitle: Optical generation of a highly stable millimeter wave by heterodyning of two phase-locked diode lasers with an optical comb generator
abstract: An optically-generated high-stable millimeter-wave synthesizer was realized for a local oscillator of a large mm/sub-mm phased-array telescope. The spectral purity of mm signal was evaluated up to 100 GHz.

articleTitle: All optical 160 to 10 Gbit/s demultiplexing using co-propagating optical clock
abstract: All optical demultiplexing of a 160 Gbit/s optical time domain multiplexed signal using a co-propagating 10 GHz optical clock as control signal into a nonlinear optical loop mirror is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Self-similar pulses as a route to low-repetition-rate femtosecond fiber lasers
abstract: Investigations of mode-locked Yb fiber lasers with low repetition rates show that self-similar pulse evolution offers substantially improved performance over stretched-pulse operation.

articleTitle: 2-bit per symbol modulation/demodulation by DPSK over inverse-RZ optical pulses
abstract: We successfully demonstrated superimposing DPSK over inverse-RZ using SOA-XGM for 2-bit per symbol modulation/demodulation at 20-Gbit/s to simply double spectral efficiency. Error free operation less than 10/sup -12/ was achieved for both RZ and DPSK signals.

articleTitle: Temperature tuned external cavity diode laser with micromachined silicon etalons
abstract: A tunable external cavity diode laser employing micromachined thermally tuned silicon etalons and laser-welding manufacturing is presented. Integral wavelength locking and an efficient calibration method are described. Accurate, stable wavelength and power are discussed.

articleTitle: Investigation of ultrashort switching windows in a hybrid-integrated Mach-Zehnder interferometer
abstract: We examine switching windows of a hybrid-integrated Mach-Zehnder interferometer. Fitted autocorrelation traces indicate an exponential rise-time that broadens the pedestal when the window approaches switching pulsewidth. A 1.80 ps FWHM window, with 13.5 dB extinction is observed.

articleTitle: Time-domain analysis of guided propagation on near-field optical antennas
abstract: A direct observation of the electromagnetic wave propagation on optical antennas is reported. The propagation mode and its effects on apertureless near-field optical microscopy are studied with terahertz time-domain spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Nanomotion measurement by phase conjugate interferometry
abstract: A new interferometer design for measuring nanometer-level motion is presented. Experiments show that this new design enables motion measurement at much longer distances than the current state of the art with no loss in accuracy.

articleTitle: Rotational SRS in hydrogen gas filled hollow-core PCF with 3 nJ threshold and 92% conversion efficiency
abstract: Rotational SRS at pulse energies of 3 nJ and quantum efficiency 92% is generated in /spl sim/35 m of hydrogen-filled HC-PCF using a 1064 nm pump laser. This threshold is some 10,000 times lower than previously reported.

articleTitle: Waveguiding in photonic crystals consisting of dielectric pillars near 1550 nm
abstract: An experimental demonstration of bandgap guiding, at wavelengths in the infrared near 1550 nm, is presented for photonic crystal waveguides created using dielectric pillars. An adiabatic taper is implemented to increase coupling efficiency.

articleTitle: Measurement of fifth- and seventh-order susceptibilities of glasses using two-beam coupling
abstract: Two-beam coupling is used to determine higher-order nonlinearities of several glasses with a range of absorption edges. We observe evidence of fifth-order and present the first observation of seventh-order susceptibilities in glasses.

articleTitle: Investigation of mini-stop bands in wide photonic crystal waveguides with a low in-plane index contrast
abstract: The mini-stop bands of wide photonic crystal waveguides in a slab system with a low in-plane index contrast are investigated both experimentally and theoretically. Their performance as high suppression filters is discussed.

articleTitle: Creation of a hollow laser beam using self-phase modulation in a nematic liquid crystal
abstract: We present a simple method to convert a Gaussian laser beam into an annular beam with sub-millimeter diameter and a width of a few tens of microns using a homeotropically oriented nematic liquid crystal.

articleTitle: Effects of wavelength and doping concentration on silicon damage threshold
abstract: Our damage experiment shows threshold fluence does not decrease with increasing doping concentration and its dependence on wavelength is weak, with photon energies above or below bandgap. Our results indicate impact ionization is the dominating mechanism.

articleTitle: Light-induced absorption under continuous-wave ultraviolet laser in Mn-doped near-stoichiometric LiNbO/sub 3/ crystals
abstract: Light-induced absorption under illumination of continuous-wave ultraviolet laser in Mn-doped near-stoichiometric LiNbO/sub 3/ crystals was investigated for tailoring two-color nonvolatile holography. Dependences of probe wavelength, pumping intensity, crystal composition, and temperature on the light-induced absorption were presented.

articleTitle: Three and four-photon absorption of a multiphoton absorbing fluorescent probe
abstract: We report the four-photon-excited fluorescence emission of (7-benzothiazol-2-yl-9,-didecylfluoren-2-yl)-diphenylamine in hexane and its four-photon absorption cross-section /spl sigma/' = 8/spl middot/10/sup -109/ cm/sup 8/ s/sup 3/ /spl middot/photon/sup -3/ for the transition S/sub 0/ to S/sub 1/, when excited at 1600 nm. This value is 10/sup 11/ times larger than that of naphthalene.

articleTitle: Confining collateral damage to less than 10 nm during femtosecond laser machining
abstract: We have ablated holes in pre-thinned Si foils using an ultrafast laser. High resolution imaging of the edges of these holes reveal collateral damage limited to within 10 nanometers.

articleTitle: Optical properties of flux-grown Ce-doped KTP and its application to second harmonic generation
abstract: Transmittance and damage threshold in cerium-doped KTP were measured with dependence on cerium concentration. These optical properties were remarkably improved by cerium doping and conversion efficiency in second harmonic generation was reached to 70%.

articleTitle: A bidirectional transmission of 32 channels /spl times/ 10 Gbit/s over a metropolitan network using linear optical amplifiers as bidirectional inline amplifiers
abstract: Linear optical amplifiers, despite their directivities in gains and noise figures, have yielded high performances as bidirectional inline amplifiers in a bidirectional transmission of 16 channels /spl times/ 10 Gbit/s per direction over a metropolitan network.

articleTitle: Multi-cascade non-degenerated optical parametric chirped-pulse amplifier based on KD*P crystals
abstract: A chirp pulse at 910 nm was amplified from 1 nJ to 100 mJ by an optical parametric amplifier Computations show that adding two more parametric amplifiers (100 mm and 300 mm diameter) will result in a multipetawatt power.

articleTitle: Rapid-scanning miniature endoscope for real-time forward-imaging optical coherence tomography coherence tomography
abstract: We developed a 2.4-mm diameter PZT-actuated endoscope capable of rapid lateral scanning at 1.2 kHz. A new lateral-priority image acquisition sequence enabled by the endoscope was demonstrated to achieve forward OCT imaging in real time.

articleTitle: Nonlinear image processor with a filter over /spl pi//2
abstract: It is found experimentally for a nonlinear image processor that phase objects are contrast enhanced and edge detection of amplitude objects is obtained when the self-induced filter produces phase shifts larger than /spl pi//2.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked, picosecond pulse vertical cavity surface emitting diode laser at 15 GHz repetition rates
abstract: We report a passively mode-locked vertical-cavity surface emitting laser diode (980 nm) at up to 15 GHz repetition rate with pulse duration of 15 psec, which incorporates a reverse-biased InGaAs multiple quantum well saturable absorber.

articleTitle: Inspection of C-4 mail bomb by terahertz spectroscopy
abstract: We examined applicability of THz-time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) to detection of explosives. Explosives C-4, used in almost all mail-bomb terrorisms, show five characteristic THz-bands. We confirm innovative adaptation of THz techniques for counterterrorism of mail-bombs.

articleTitle: Self-phase-locked frequency-by-two divider OPO with a residual fractional frequency instability of 8/spl middot/10/sup -18/
abstract: We directly measure the phase difference between the subharmonic waves of a self-phase-locked frequency by-2-divider OPO using a phase-sensitive detector scheme. The relative frequency instability of frequency division by 2 is measured to be 8/spl middot/10/sup -18/.

articleTitle: Detection and analysis of fs-CARS response from bacterial spore marker dipicolinic acid (DPA)
abstract: Ultrafast coherent anti-Stokes Raman (CARS) emission from multiple, simultaneously-excited Raman lines in DPA was observed. Implications for the use of this technique towards sensitive, specific detection of molecules and bacterial spores will be discussed

articleTitle: Volume holographic profilometry surface reconstruction with the Viterbi algorithm
abstract: We describe image blur in volume holographic profilometry as inter-symbol interference and apply the Viterbi algorithm to clean up the image and reconstruct the surface with high accuracy. We also demonstrate the use of surface constraints to reduce computational complexity.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of photonic crystal spectral diversity filters for biosensing
abstract: We present a systematic method for designing spectral diversity filters using 2D and 3D photonic crystals. These filters convert an incoherent input beam with uniform spectral content over the input dimension into a desired nonuniform spatial-spectral pattern. Such spectral diversity filters can be used for designing compact spectrometers that can be used for the detection of Raman signatures in biosensors.

articleTitle: 600 mJ Q-switched diode-pumped Tm:Ho:LuLF master-oscillator-power-amplifiers (MOPA) at 2.05 /spl mu/m
abstract: 115-mJ Q-switched laser pulses with the pulsewidth of about 150 ns were generated by a Tm:Ho:LuLF laser oscillator and 626-mJ laser pulses were demonstrated by Tm:Ho:LuLF master-oscillator-power-amplifiers (MOPA) consisting of one oscillator and two amplifiers.

articleTitle: Nonlinear switching in a symmetrical Sagnac interferometer including a quarter-wave plate
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally that nonlinear switching can be obtained from a fiber Sagnac interferometer including a symmetrical coupler, highly-twisted fiber and a quarter-wave plate. Experimental results confirm previously reported theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Moderately localized discrete quadratic solitons in periodically poled lithium niobate waveguide arrays
abstract: We report the first observation of moderately localized quadratic discrete solitons in one-dimensional PPLN waveguide arrays. Measured field profiles for both discrete diffraction and solitons versus wave-vector mismatch agree with theory.

articleTitle: Narrowband tuning of an injection-seeded pulsed optical parametric oscillator with a self-adaptive optical cavity
abstract: A novel self-adaptive optical cavity with a phase-conjugate reflector is used for injection-seeded narrowband tuning of a pulsed optical parametric oscillator, eliminating the need for damage-prone intracavity tuning elements or active cavity control.

articleTitle: Phase-sensitive electric-field-induced second-harmonic microscopic probe of electronic materials
abstract: We demonstrate an electric-field-induced second-harmonic microscope that measures both amplitude and phase of imaged second-harmonic light with sub-micron spatial resolution, thus providing complete characterization of dc field variations near metal-semiconductor junctions.

articleTitle: Consolidation and homogeneity of sol-gel Er-doped waveguide amplifiers
abstract: This work presents evidence that extensive heat treatment on sol-gel waveguide amplifiers drastically reduces the levels of erbium ion inversion. Furthermore, porosity measurements are presented which indicate the optimum annealing conditions for glass consolidation.

articleTitle: 3-/spl mu/m-band high output erbium-doped fiber lasers
abstract: CW and Q-switched fiber lasers emitting in 3-/spl mu/m band have been developed using Er-doped ZBLAN double-clad fibers. CW output power of 3 W and pulse energy of 0.55 mJ are achieved.

articleTitle: Experimental results of the performance of an erbium-doped fiber sensor
abstract: We present experimental results demonstrating the performance of an erbium-doped silica fiber as a remote temperature sensor. The sensor uses the change of the fluorescence intensity-ratio of two spectral-bands as a function of temperature.

articleTitle: Spectral and spatial phase distorsions induced by mosaic gratings compressor of petawatt laser
abstract: In petawatt lasers segmented mosaic gratings are studied to recompress pulses. Alignments of the mosaic elements are crucial. We discuss theoretical model of phase shift and tolerances on alignment are presented.

articleTitle: High performance MOVPE grown quantum cascade lasers
abstract: We report MOVPE-grown quantum cascade lasers operating at /spl lambda/ = 9 /spl mu/m. Threshold current densities as low as 840 Acm/sup -2/ at 12 K, and 3.5 kAcm/sup -2/ at room temperature are measured, comparable with state-of-the-art MBE grown devices.

articleTitle: 700-W single transverse mode Yb-doped fiber laser
abstract: We demonstrate 700-W fundamental mode beam from Yb-doped fiber laser operating at 1092 nm. Coiling 20-/spl mu/m diameter and 0.06 NA core fiber into 15-cm diameter spool eliminates higher-order modes through distributed mode filtering.

articleTitle: Wide tuning and multi-wavelength SHG from 2D /spl chi//sup (2)/ nonlinear photonic crystal of tetragonal lattice structure
abstract: Multi-pairs of SHG were observed in 2D-QPM nonlinear photonic crystal with a spectral tuning range over 150 nm by 1.55 /spl mu/m pump OPO. These observations are ascribed to the G/sub mn/(/spl Phi/) dispersion in the tetragonal QPM structure.

articleTitle: Measurements of energetic electrons and protons produced by a petawatt scale laser
abstract: The work reports on the measurement of energetic electrons produced by focusing the Vulcan petawatt pulse onto the edge of a supersonic gas jet. During the experiment, the laser consistently produced 650 fs duration pulses delivering /spl sim/ 180 J on target and generating intensities greater than 3 /spl times/ 10/sup 20/ W/cm/sup -2/. Ion acceleration from the interaction of the laser pulse with a underdense plasma using a laser power 1000 times the critical power is also performed for the occurrence of relativistic self-focusing. Strong correlation between maximum ion energy vs. plasma density is found which is also confirmed by simulations.

articleTitle: Quantum interference in semiconductors controlled by carrier-envelope phase
abstract: We demonstrate that the carrier-envelope phase of ultrashort pulses can be used to control injected photocurrents via quantum interference in low-temperature-grown gallium arsenide (GaAs).

articleTitle: Generation of 5 W of 532 nm by QPM SHG for 1000 hrs in near-stoichiometric lithium tantalate
abstract: Using periodically poled near-stoichiometric lithium tantalate, 5 W of 532 nm light was continuously produced for 1000 hours at room temperature.

articleTitle: Compact 10-GHz Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ laser with 0.5 W average output power and 125 fs rms timing jitter
abstract: We demonstrate a very compact, passively mode-locked diode-pumped 10-GHz Nd:GdVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser with 125 fs rms timing jitter. The maximum achievable average output power is 0.5 W with a minimum pulse duration of 12 ps

articleTitle: All-optical poling of tellurite glasses doped with heavy metal oxides
abstract: We investigated second harmonic generation by all optical poling process in TeO/sub 2/-based glasses doped with heavy metal oxides. We demonstrated a direct relationship between the second and third order nonlinearities within the TeO/sub 2/-Tl/sub 2/O system.

articleTitle: Cavity-enhanced-spectroscopy using room-temperature quantum cascade lasers
abstract: Cavity enhanced spectroscopic techniques employing quantum cascade lasers typically require liquid nitrogen cooling to obtain high powers. However, here we demonstrate for the first time pulsed-cavity enhanced spectroscopy using a room temperature QC laser.

articleTitle: Observation of optical near-field energy transfer in closely spaced ZnO/ZnMgO multiple-quantum-well nanorods for nanophotonic devices
abstract: We observed an anti-correlation feature in the photoluminescence intensity distribution of ZnO/ZnMgO multiple-quantum-well nanorods. This is attributed to the optical near-field energy transfer between resonant energy levels in closely spaced pairs of ZnO/ZnMgO multiple-quantum-well nanorods.

articleTitle: CW optical parametric oscillator pumped by a distributed feedback fiber laser
Millisecond THz imaging based on two-dimensional EO sampling using a high speed CMOS camera
abstract: We have developed a novel THz imaging system based on two-dimensional EO sampling using a high-speed CMOS camera. A high SNR THz imaging in millisecond regime is achieved by dynamic subtraction and laser-intensity normalization.

articleTitle: Intra-cavity coherent addition of Gaussian laser beam distributions
abstract: A novel method for efficient coherent addition of separate Gaussian laser beam distributions, with an intra-cavity interferometric coupler, is presented. Experimental results reveal 92% combining efficiency and a nearly Gaussian output beam.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of a reconfigurable photonic bandgap waveguide device with MEMS features
abstract: We report on our efforts to develop a semiconductor based photonic bandgap device with MEMS features that is designed to reconfigure the photonic crystal structure into different types of waveguide devices such as switches, modulators, etc.

articleTitle: Characteristics of nano-scale composites by THz spectroscopy
abstract: We have conducted visible pump-THz probe experiments on single wall carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) deposited on quartz substrates. Our results suggest that the nanotubes exhibit localized transport due to Lorentz-type photo-induced localized states.

articleTitle: Compact self-started femtosecond Cr:forsterite laser for non-linear optical microscopy
abstract: We demonstrated a compact, prismless, self-started Cr:forsterite laser generating 300 mW of 85-fs pulses around 1226 nm. Based on a fiber pump laser, this compact laser system is a promising clinical source for portable nonlinear scanning microscope.

articleTitle: Coupled microcavity in photonic wire Bragg grating
abstract: We present single and coupled-microcavity structures linked by first order photonic wire Bragg grating reflectors. Measurements show a strong resonance peak for a single microcavity and simulation of three coupled microcavities shows localised cavity modes

articleTitle: A chip-based micro-cavity optical parametric oscillator (/spl mu/OPO)
abstract: We report a micro-scale optical parametric oscillator (/spl mu/OPO). Oscillations are observed at record low threshold values (170 micro-Watts) with highly ideal (97%) signal-to-idler photon emission. High conversion efficiencies (36%) are achieved.

articleTitle: Photo-EMF studies of doped CdTe crystals using low-power IR-laser
abstract: The low-power IR-laser induced holographic current, using symmetric and titled experimental geometries with two-dimensional electrodes array was realized for CdTe:V(Ti) crystals. Photo-EMF studies were carried out, using the photogeneration of impurity electrons.

articleTitle: Pulsed laser deposition of thick multilayer garnet films for cladding-pumped planar waveguide laser devices
abstract: We report progress in the pulsed laser deposition of thick multilayer Nd/sup 3+/-doped garnet films to be used as high-numerical-aperture cladding-pumped planar waveguide laser devices.

articleTitle: Two-photon induced orientation in azoaromatic compounds: demonstration of three-dimensional optical storage
abstract: Two-photon induced birefringence associated with the molecular reorientation caused by two-photon induced isomerization was obtained using femtosecond pulses in azoaromatic polymers. This process allowed three-dimensional optical data storage.

articleTitle: Optical properties of free-standing InP semiconductor nanowires
abstract: Growth and optical properties of InP nanowires will be presented. These wires (30 to 100 nm in diameter and longer than 5000 nm) were obtained by the vapor-liquid-solid growth in a chemical beam epitaxy reactor.

articleTitle: 23 kHz eye-safe intra-cavity OPO laser
abstract: An eye-safe intra-cavity OPO laser has been developed with efficiency of 7.2%, a power output of 7.2 watts at 16 kHz, a beam quality with M/sup 2/<1.1, and a repetition rate up to 23 kilohertz.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked 50-GHz Er:Yb:glass laser
abstract: We demonstrate a compact, stable, fundamental-mode-locked Er:Yb:glass laser with 50 GHz repetition rate. It can serve as pulse generator in future high-speed RZ transmission systems or as a multi-wavelength source locked to the ITU grid.

articleTitle: Ultrahigh resolution optical coherence tomography for in vivo endoscopic imaging of the rabbit
abstract: Ultrahigh resolution endoscopic OCT using a broadband Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+ </sup>:forsterite laser light source is demonstrated in vivo in the rabbit. Imaging of the esophagus was performed with <4 mum axial resolution in tissue and correlated with histology

articleTitle: High power AlInGaP broad area lasers and laser bars in the visible range from 635 nm to 670 nm
abstract: We present visible high power AlInGaP lasers and laser bars from 635 nm to 670 nm. At room temperature we achieved 5.3 W of cw power at 642 nm from a 10 mm bar with an overall efficiency of 17%.

articleTitle: Pulse shaping and compression in nonlinear periodic structures with unbalanced Kerr coefficients
abstract: We validate our model with experimental results in a periodic structure consisting of one linear and one resonant nonlinear materials. We show a maximum of 28% pulse compression in both transmitted and reflected pulses.

articleTitle: Hierarchichal WDM wavebanding implementation exploiting the free spectral range of arrayed waveguide gratings
abstract: We present a novel multiplexing approach for two stage multiplexed, or hierarchical, WDM networks, consisting on the definition of wavelength bands using the periodical response of an arrayed waveguide grating. The approach is advantageous in terms of node design cost reduction, simplified operation and easy upgradability. An experiment demonstrates the feasibility of the proposed node architecture.

articleTitle: Carrier heating in a terahertz optical asymmetric demultiplexer
abstract: We report interferometric switching experiments with an InGaAs semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA). Measured switching windows reveal ultrafast refractive index changes attributed to carrier heating. This conclusion is supported by calculations using a phenomenological model.

articleTitle: A rapid method for detection of recombinant proteins in single Pichia yeast cell with optical Raman-tweezers spectroscopy
abstract: Optical Raman-tweezers spectroscopy was used to detect recombinant proteins (somatolactin) produced in single Pichia yeast cells, in which the gene of zebrafish somatolactin /spl beta/ has been inserted and expressed in the transgenic cells.

articleTitle: Lateral band-structure engineering in micromachined semiconductors
abstract: We demonstrate that micromachining multiple quantum wells produces lateral (in-plane) modifications to the semiconductor band structure that are accurately modeled by finite-element analysis combined with an eight-level band-structure calculation.

articleTitle: Atom interferometric method for eliminating Doppler effects in precision measurements
abstract: We present a method to reduce the residual Doppler effect by almost two orders of magnitude in our optical frequency standard. The approach combines atom interferometry and launching of microkelvin neutral atoms.

articleTitle: Novel single point access fluid flow measurement technique based on two photon absorption fluorescence microscopy
abstract: We present a novel method for the analysis of fluid flows using two photon absorption fluorescence imaging. Results are presented showing the ability of this technique to obtain quantitative parameters describing the fluid flow

articleTitle: Spatial and temporal coherence characterization of a smoothed laser beam
abstract: We present a new method for measuring coherence characteristics of the speckles obtained with a smoothed laser. This technique allows us to measure both spatial transverse and temporal characteristics, of hot spots by spatial autocorrelation.

articleTitle: Eyesafe, 1.55 /spl mu/m, 1 /spl mu/s pulse energy source for space-based remote sensing using optical parametric amplifiers in PPLN
abstract: We describe a 100 mJ//spl mu/s Nd:YAG master oscillator power amplifier system pumping optical parametric amplifiers in PPLN. These waveguide and bulk amplifiers yield 2-mJ, 1.55 /spl mu/m, single frequency, /spl mu/s-radiation for remote wind sensing.

articleTitle: Measurement of nonlinear index changes in an InGaAsP/InP waveguide using an optical loop mirror interferometer
abstract: We demonstrate the measurement of intensity-dependent refractive index changes in InGaAsP waveguides with 4 ps pump pulses below the bandgap using an optical loop mirror interferometer. Also the pump induced absorption change is reported.

articleTitle: 27-mJ nanosecond pulses in M/sup 2/ = 6.5 beam from a coiled highly multimode Yb-doped fiber amplifier
abstract: 27-mJ and 50-ns pulses are generated at 1064 nm from a 200-/spl mu/m diameter, 0.06 NA core Yb-doped DC fiber amplifier. Fiber supporting /spl sim/200 transverse modes is coiled to produce mode-filtered beam with M/sup 2/ = 6.5.

articleTitle: 0.5 J frequency stabilized diode pumped solid state laser for a next generation lidar system
abstract: A pulsed diode pumped Nd:YAG rod-laser system has been frequency stabilized with a modified Pound-Drever-Hall scheme. It delivers 35 ns pulses in up to 0.5 J at 1064 nm with M/sup 2/=1.5 and 0.25 J at 532 nm at 100 Hz rep.-rate.

articleTitle: High-order PMD characterization of a dispersion-managed link by means of Jones matrix method
abstract: We report the characterization up to second-order polarization mode dispersion of a dispersion-managed fiber using the Jones matrix method. A simple processing algorithm is required to determine differential group delay and principal states of polarization rotation.

articleTitle: Generation, amplitude and phase characterization of 10/sup 21/ W/cm/sup 2/ intensity
abstract: The intensity of 10/sup 21 /W/cm/sup 2/ was generated by correcting F/l off-axis paraboloid aberration in 30 TW diffraction limited laser system. The importance of using diffraction calculation over spot size measurement in determining intensity is discussed.

articleTitle: High power ceramic Nd/sup 3+/:Y/sub 3/Al/sub 5/O/sub 12/ laser
abstract: A high-power ceramic Nd/sup 3+/:Y/sub 3/Al/sub 5/O/sup 12/ laser was developed. 110 W output at 1064 nm was obtained with a slope efficiency of 41%. The laser performance was found to compare favorably with that of single crystal Nd:YAG.

articleTitle: Multi-pass second-harmonic generation using a confocal telescope and a wedged glass plate
abstract: We used a confocal telescope to preserve propagation angle and focusing in double-pass second-harmonic generation using periodically poled KTP. A wedged glass plate provided adjustment of the relative phase between fundamental and second harmonic waves.

articleTitle: Second-order nonlinearity profile in thermally poled twin-hole fibre
abstract: The second-order nonlinearity profile in thermally poled twin-hole fibre was characterized by second-harmonic scanning optical microscopy. The technique enabled us to optimize the poling parameters in order to obtain overlap between non-linear region and core.

articleTitle: Ultira-high quality, ultra-high current proton beams produced with a laser-virtual cathode sheath accelerator
abstract: By structuring the rear surface of the foil, the authors have succeeded to produce modulations in the transverse phase space, which resemble fiducial "beamlets" within the envelope of the expanding plasma. This allows to map the expansion of the beam envelope during the latter, sheath expansion phase. Using this technique that allows to directly image the initial accelerating sheath, and fully reconstruct the transverse phase space for protons of different energy

articleTitle: Probing of surface and bulk optical nonlinearities using surface plasmon optics
abstract: We report on simultaneous measurements of plasmon enhanced second and third optical harmonics; experiment and computer simulations. Both surface and bulk contributions into the nonlinear optical signal are discussed.

articleTitle: Microscopic theory of carrier-wave Rabi flopping and the two-band Mollow triplet in semiconductors
abstract: We compare experiments on carrier-wave Rabi flopping with fully dynamical solutions of the semiconductor Bloch equations, leading to good agreement. This theory confirms that the peak structure is due to a two-band Mollow triplet.

articleTitle: Cavity ringdown spectroscopy with optical-heterodyne detection and miniature external-cavity tunable lasers
abstract: Miniature external-cavity tunable lasers are combined with retro-reflected optical-heterodyne detection for rapidly swept, continuous-wave cavity ringdown spectroscopy. This yields a compact, rugged, versatile, high-performance instrument for efficient spectroscopic sensing of gases.

articleTitle: Simultaneous control of position and emission energy of semiconductor quantum dots
abstract: We demonstrate a simultaneous control of position and emission energy of AlGaAs/GaAs pyramidal quantum dots (QDs) grown on patterned substrates via modification of the pattern features. Applications in QD-loaded photonic crystals are discussed.

articleTitle: High speed surface magneto-plasmon reflectivity modulator
abstract: We propose a magneto-optic (MO) modulator based on surface magneto-plasmons in a rare-earth garnet. The modulator has improved efficiency over MO modulation by bulk propagation, is capable of multi-gigahertz operation, and has a tunable bandwidth.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation by quasi-phase matching in 8 mm-long periodically-twinned quartz
abstract: We report an 8 mm-long periodical twin structure in crystal quartz with 125 /spl mu/m period and second harmonic generation with a tunable light source. The twinning process under distributed applied stress will be discussed with finite-element method.

articleTitle: Measuring bend-curvature and determining bend-direction simultaneously using long period fiber gratings
abstract: A novel long period fiber gratings sensor that can, not only measure the applied bend-curvature directly, but also determine the bend-direction is proposed and demonstrated in this paper.

articleTitle: Multi-species QEPAS based gas sensing using a wavelength-programmable diode laser source
abstract: Quartz-enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy (QEPAS) was combined with a wavelength-programmable near-IR tunable laser source to realize a compact prototype chemical gas sensor for multi-species analysis. The best QEPAS sensitivity achieved to date is /spl sim/4/spl times/10/sup -8/ cm/sup -1/ W//spl radic/Hz.

articleTitle: Towards silicon-compatible 2D and 3D photonic crystals
abstract: The realisation of photonic crystals on silicon platforms is presented with the aim to obtain waveguides and light emitting structures. We report on crystallisation on patterned substrates and defect engineering by direct electron-beam writing as examples of two approaches to fabricate and structure photonic crystals. The requirements to realise waveguides need crystallisation in confined environments.

articleTitle: High-resolution mid-infrared absorption spectroscopy using a broadband femtosecond optical parametric oscillator
abstract: Mid-infrared spectroscopy of methane across 480cn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> (14.4 THz or 600nm) with around lcm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> resolution is demonstrated using a femtosecond parametric oscillator, so combining the bandwidth of a thermal source with the brightness of a laser.

articleTitle: Highly efficient light emission from III-nitride photonic crystal
abstract: Photonic crystal LEDs based on InGaN/GaN QWs was fabricated and exhibited eight-fold enhancement of light emission in far field. Polarization and pumping condition dependence of photonic crystal light emission were further studied

articleTitle: Defect modes in photonic crystals studied using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy
abstract: Two-dimensional photonic crystal band gaps have been studied using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy. We observe the effects of defect modes in both the amplitude and phase spectra. These results are in reasonable agreement with calculations.

articleTitle: New paradigm of ultrafast laser system based on a high energy oscillator and nonlinear optical frequency conversion
abstract: We introduce a novel approach of generating highly reproducible, broadly tunable, ultrashort laser pulses using a very simple and inexpensive concept. Up to 10-W of average power can be routinely generated with energies up to 10 /spl mu/J per pulse and tunability from mid-IR to UV.

articleTitle: Photoinduced changes in arsenic-based chalcogenides
abstract: Photoinduced structural and optical modifications have been created in bulk glasses and thin films at 514 nm below their optical bandgap under different irradiation conditions. These changes were observed using thermal and optical characterization tools

articleTitle: Femtosecond diode pumped regenerative amplifier for micromachining and biomedical applications producing 250 fs, 3 /spl mu/J-pulses at 100 kHz
abstract: We present a compact diode pumped regenerative amplifier useful for biomedical and other applications. The laser generates 3 /spl mu/J, 250 fs pulses at 100 kHz repetition rate of and with M2>1.2. The laser design and characteristics are shown.

articleTitle: Holographic Stokesmeter using polarization-sensitive volume gratings
abstract: A holographic Stokesmeter utilizes the inherent polarization sensitivity of volume gratings to determine all four parameters of the input Stokes vector. We present theoretical and experimental results for an example system.

articleTitle: Room temperature photoluminescence of MBE grown single quantum wells on InGaAs graded buffers
abstract: We present room temperature photoluminescence studies of InGaAs single quantum wells grown on top of In/sub 0/spl rarr/x/Ga/sub 1/spl rarr/(1-x)/As graded buffers (0.05<x<0.25), with InGaAs and InAlGaAs barriers. Emission was improved 30 times by rapid thermal annealing.

articleTitle: Crystal growth, upconversion, and IR emission properties of Er/sup 3+/- and Nd/sup 3+/-doped KPb/sub 2/Br/sub 5/
abstract: We report on the crystal growth, upconversion, and IR emission properties of Er:KPb/sub 2/Br/sub 5/ and Nd:KPb/sub 2/Br/sub 5/ for potential solid-state laser applications. The obtained results will be compared to Er and Nd doped KPb/sub 2/Cl/sub 5/.

articleTitle: A pulsed laser-source for MIR-LIDAR
abstract: The performance of a new pulsed laser-source for MIR-LIDAR based on difference-frequency generation in PPLN is demonstrated. High output power is achieved using a fiber amplifier in combination with a Cr/sup 4+/:Nd/sup 3+/:YAG microchip laser.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation technique combined with electro-optic effect for impulse electric field measurement
abstract: Second-harmonic generation combined with an electro-optic effect is considered for measuring impulse electric fields. Measurements with nonlinear, electro-optic crystals, namely LiNbO/sub 3/ and KTiOPO/sub 4/, show that phase matching condition can be effectively used for such application.

articleTitle: Probing of porous-silicon-based coupled microcavities and photonic molecules by linear and third-harmonic generation spectroscopy
abstract: Linear and third-harmonic spectroscopy of coupled microcavities and photonic molecules formed from porous silicon is presented.

articleTitle: Self-passive q-switching of a Nd:YAG laser
abstract: Self-passive q-switching has been demonstrated using a Nd:YAG gain medium that is externally implanted with chromium ions through annealing process. Pulsewidths up to 2 /spl mu/secs and PRFs up to 100 kHz have been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Effects of encoder/decoder mismatch on BER performance for 2-D wavelength-time OCDMA
abstract: We investigate the impact of encoder/decoder mismatch, caused by wavelength and/or time misalignment, on the bit error rate (BER) performance of 2-D wavelength-time OCDMA systems

articleTitle: Compact fiber laser approach to 589 nm laser guide stars
abstract: We are developing an all-fiber 589 nm laser system for laser-guided adaptive optics by sum-frequency mixing 1583 nm Er/Yb:doped and 938 nm Nd:silica fiber lasers in a periodically poled crystal. System design and performance will be presented.

articleTitle: Probing the electronic structure of molecules by high harmonic generation
abstract: We have generated high harmonics from aligned molecules. The harmonics show a strong dependence on molecular alignment and symmetry of the electron orbital, which enables us to probe the dynamics of electronic structures.

articleTitle: Phase measurement of periodic optical pulses using the temporal fractional Talbot effect
abstract: A novel method of time domain interferometry using the fractional Talbot effect is proposed for pulse phase measurement. The advantage of this method is the stability of the interference pattern and insensitivity to environmental influences.

articleTitle: Optically-pumped ultraviolet microdisk laser on a silicon substrate
abstract: Ultraviolet microdisks lasers are fabricated on silicon substrates, with a thin layer of zinc oxide grown on top of silica disk. Under optical pumping, lasing occurs in the whispering gallery modes at room temperature.

articleTitle: Analytic approximation for migration assisted upconversion in Er-doped silica after short-pulse excitation
abstract: We propose an analytic approximation describing the decay of the population inversion in Er-doped silica affected by the migration assisted homogeneous upconversion. We show that the results well agree with the Monte-Carlo simulations.

articleTitle: Dipole and vector solitons in two-dimensional photonic lattices
abstract: Dipole and vector solitons in a two-dimensional photorefractive optical lattice are demonstrated both experimentally and theoretically. Dipole solitons can be in-phase or out-of-phase in their lobe components, and they are trapped in two nearby lattice sites and stabilized by the lattice-induced waveguide. Vector solitons are realized by mutual trapping of two mutually incoherent beams in the same lattice site, although each beam alone experiences discrete diffraction.

articleTitle: Dember and photo-emf currents in Si photoconductive detectors
abstract: Dember and photo-emf currents are investigated in silicon photoconductive detectors both theoretically and experimentally. Dember photocurrents were found to dominate the response of high-purity silicon samples to 852 nm light.

articleTitle: Characterization of quasi-monocycle NIR pulses with stabilized carrier-envelop phase by XFROG
abstract: Characterization by XFROG was demonstrated for NOPA idler pulses with more than one octave bandwidth at /spl lambda//sub c/ = 990 nm. The compression to near transform-limit was achieved to obtain quasi-monocycle pulses utilizing a deformable-membrane mirror.

articleTitle: The onset and breakdown of passive mode locking with a parabolic gain spectrum
abstract: An explicit analysis of an important passively mode locked lasers class with a parabolic gain profile is derived, using a recently developed statistical mechanics approach. Mode locking occurs when the normalized inverse noise power /spl gamma/ = 9.

articleTitle: Multi-channel DFB dye laser covering 560-1100 nm and rapid thermal wavelength switching
abstract: Multi-channel DFB dye laser with PMMA waveguide can cover a wavelength range 560-1100 nm. Wavelength switching can be done by changing the position of the pumping beam. Rapid thermal-switching of the laser wavelength was also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Large-aperture, polarization-preserving optical circulator
abstract: We demonstrate a polarization-preserving optical circulator for large aperture directional beam separation at 1.5 mum. The device utilizes a magnetless latching Faraday rotator to enable large, 11-mm aperture and high-power handling up to 100 W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>

articleTitle: Optical properties and fabrication of polymeric waveguides containing nanocrystalline quantum dots
abstract: We present a novel method for fabricating polymer waveguides containing various types of nanocrystals while preserving their active optical properties. This method utilizes a surface functionalization of the nanocrystals. This enables fabrication of new active devices integrating both the nanocrystals functionalities and the polymer waveguiding properties.

articleTitle: Femtosecond X-ray diffraction of structural changes in a semiconductor superlattice
abstract: Femtosecond excitation of spatially modulated electron hole plasmas leads to an ultrafast structural response within the unit cell of GaAs/AlGaAs superlattices. The transient rocking curve reflects the expansion of wells and compression of barriers.

articleTitle: High average power diode-pumped slab laser with 10 J, 10 Hz for power photonics applications
abstract: A novel architecture of high average power diode-pumped zig-zag slab laser has been developed. The system generated 8.7 J at 1 Hz output with 291-kW pump diodes and achieved 2.5 J at 10 Hz operation.

articleTitle: A new polymer based nonlinear absorption material
abstract: A new naphthalocyanine was synthesized and incorporated into polycarbonate at high concentration. The thin film exhibits reverse saturable absorption from 520 nm to 725 nm and has an excited state lifetime greater than 5 ns.

articleTitle: Focusing coherent XUV light to micron spot size with an intensity of 10/sup 14/ W/cm/sup 2/
abstract: We have observed focal spots of intense coherent XUV light based on high-order harmonic generation. The focused intensity in excess of 10/sup 14/ W/cm/sup 2/ was successfully achieved at 30 nm.

articleTitle: Vertically integrated InGaAsP/InP microstack lasers
abstract: High power vertically integrated 1.59 /spl mu/m wavelength InGaAsP/InP microstack lasers with three identical optically decoupled emitters series-connected through low resistance tunnel junctions have been realized by MOCVD growth for the first time.

articleTitle: Effect of nitrogen concentration on carrier lifetime in GaAs based long wavelength (/spl lambda/ = 1.2-1.3 /spl mu/m) lasers
abstract: We show for the first time that the differential carrier lifetime (/spl tau//sub d/) of identical In/sub 0.4/Ga/sub 0.6/As/GaAs/sub 0.85/P/sub 0.15//GaAs single QW broad area lasers with and without the addition of nitrogen (/spl lambda/ = 1.2-1.3 /spl mu/m) significantly reduces with the incorporation of nitrogen.

articleTitle: New developments in high speed photodetectors
abstract: A progress on the recent developments in high-speed photodetector technology is presented. Different approaches that trigger changes in photodetector structures are also discussed. These include transition from 10 GB/s to 40 GB/s fiber optic systems, the incorporation of normal-incidence input coupling to photodiodes, and the implementation of waveguide photodiodes for very high-speed operation. However, these approaches give rise to certain tradeoffs between bandwidth and responsivity and limitation issues like input coupling efficiency and sensitivity to polarization. Further improvements in device performance and functionality can be anticipated through monolithic integration. Examples include integration of photodiode with a semiconductor optical amplifier or combining detectors in a balanced receiver.

articleTitle: Selective two-photon imaging with shaped femtosecond pulses
abstract: Selective two-photon microscopy of fluorescent probe molecules using phase-modulated ultrashort laser pulses is demonstrated on fluorescent probes used for biological imaging. Maximum contrast in the excitation of these molecules is achieved using multiphoton intrapulse interference.

articleTitle: Chirp characteristics of a tunable, optically pumped VCSEL
abstract: The frequency response and chirp characteristics of a 1.6 /spl mu/m optically pumped tunable vertical cavity surface emitting laser are presented for the first time. The observed chirp and linewidth enhancement factor /spl alpha//sub H/ behavior are analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: Blind dispersion compensation for optical coherence tomography
abstract: A signal processing dispersion compensation method for optical coherence tomography is presented. This approach, based on generalized autoconvolution function, can improve axial resolution without a priori knowledge of dispersive properties of the sample

articleTitle: Prior-based line-coding for WDM RZ systems
abstract: We propose a block line-coding scheme that uses prior information about the distortion mechanism for reducing timing jitter in WDM return-to-zero (RZ) systems, and we demonstrate its effectiveness using simulations.

articleTitle: Nonlinear 2D semiconductor photonic crystals
abstract: Experimental results demonstrating strong nonlinear effects due to manipulation of photonic modes in 2D photonic crystals slabs show the potential of these objects as platforms for reconfigurable photonic circuits.

articleTitle: N-fold symmetric crossed gratings as gain flattening filters
abstract: We present N-fold symmetric crossed fiber gratings as devices for gain equalization. The fiber grating parameters are optimized to equalize the gain profile of an erbium doped fiber amplifier to within 0.07 dB.

articleTitle: 6 /spl times/ 10 Gbit/s WDM multicast by means of FWM in DS fibers
abstract: Using four wave mixing with three pumps in a dispersion shifted fiber, we produce six optical copies of an input NRZ data signal at 10 Gbit/s. All channels comply with a 200 GHz grid.

articleTitle: Highly accurate fiber-optic dc current sensor with flexible large-diameter sensing coil
abstract: We report a clamp-on type sensor for high dc currents based on a novel polarization rotated reflection interferometer. Accuracy within /spl plusmn/0.1% is demonstrated over an extended temperature range. Applications include current measurement at aluminum smelters.

articleTitle: Programmable beam shaping of femtosecond pulses
abstract: We demonstrate programmable beam shaping of femtosecond pulses. A liquid crystal modulator is used as an active and adaptive phase filtering device for spatial beam shaping. Round, square, ring and triangle shapes are obtained.

articleTitle: Influence of number density and transition cross-section on rapid passage effects in pulsed quantum-cascade laser based spectrometers
abstract: We show how rapid passage effects in molecular gases are influenced by the number density, transition cross-section and reorientation lifetime. Data will be presented that compares rapid passage in ammonia and isotopologues of methyl chloride.

articleTitle: Design of high-speed directly-modulated self-assembled quantum-dot lasers aiming at 40 Gb/s operation: experiments and model
abstract: Modulation characteristics of 1.3 /spl mu/m quantum-dot lasers were investigated experimentally and theoretically to evaluate the K-factor-limited bandwidth. A criteria to improve the K-factor for the 40 GHz-bandwidth is clarified in terms of optical gain and capture time.

Index Terms: Increase In The Number Of Layers

articleTitle: Picosecond response of metal-semiconductor-metal ultraviolet photodiodes
abstract: We studied the ultrafast response in metal-semiconductor-metal ultraviolet photodiodes fabricated on GaN. The best performance of a device with 1-/spl mu/m finger width and spacing showed a 3.5-ps response. The pulse width broadened significantly as the optical energy increased.

articleTitle: Advanced laser processing for integrated biophotonics on a chip
abstract: Today's advanced F/sub 2/ and ultrafast lasers drive strong interactions in transparent glasses for rapid prototyping of novel biochip designs. Interconnecting microfluidic channels, buried optical circuits, electrophoretic separators, and dielectrophoretic traps are presented for single-cell analysis.

articleTitle: Raman pulse compression in counterpropagating pump beams
abstract: Stimulated Raman scattering (SRS) in two counterpropagating focused laser pump beams was investigated both theoretically and experimentally. The SRS threshold decrease up to 3-4 times was achieved. Also the pulse compression from 3.3 ns to 25 ps was obtained by SRS in Ba(NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>

articleTitle: Dependence on intrinsic strain of packaging-induced strain in quantum-well laser diodes
abstract: Intrinsic strain within quantum wells significantly influences interband energy shifts in diode lasers. We show that despite intrinsic strain, energy shifts permit quantitative determination of packaging-induced-strain configurations in commercial devices.

articleTitle: Chirp characterization of a high-resolution, low-chirp, ns-pulsed optical parametric oscillator/amplifier system
abstract: An injection-seeded pulsed optical parametric oscillator is amplified and the frequency chirp characterized using optical heterodyne techniques. The low-chirp 842-nm signal output depends only slightly on amplifier pump energy, suitable for high-resolution spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Manipulation of cavity Q and critical coupling in microring resonator through integration of a semiconductor optical amplifier
abstract: We report the control of quality factor and critical coupling in an InP/InGaAsP microring resonator by altering the internal loss in the ring using an integrated semiconductor optical amplifier.

articleTitle: Single-shot fluorescence lifetime imaging using a novel segmented gated optical intensifier
