abstract: Single-shot wide-field fluorescence lifetime imaging based on a novel gated optical intensifier with differential delays to each of four channels is reported. Single-shot FLIM is demonstrated with polymer films, multi-well plate arrays and biological tissue.

articleTitle: Quasiperiodic photonic crystal microlaser with defect
abstract: We demonstrated a GaInAsP quasiperiodic photonic crystal microlaser with a point defect at room temperature, for the first time. The lasing was observed not only at the defect but also outside of the defect

articleTitle: A new tuning scheme - coherent tuning
abstract: A new tuning scheme, coherent tuning, is proposed and confirmed by experiment for the first time. The coherent tuning is a scheme of wavelength tuning in which the wavelength of coherent light is tuned, but the wavelength of incoherent light isn't. Authors expect that this new tuning scheme can be applied to many optoelectronic devices including tunable semiconductor laser diodes.

articleTitle: Novel interferometric ellipsometer with wavelength-swept source
abstract: A novel interferometric ellipsometer with no moving parts which uses a semiconductor laser diode as the source is described. Temporal fringes are produced by modulation of the bias current and unbalanced arms in the interferometer.

articleTitle: Radio frequency spectrum analyzer based on spectral hole burning: experimental progress and future steps
abstract: We report on spectral-hole-burning-based instantaneous spectral analysis of optically carried broadband radio frequency signals. We have demonstrated 100-channel operation over 3.3 GHz bandwidth. We discuss future steps towards 10 GHz bandwidth and 1000-channel operation.

articleTitle: All-fiber acousto-optic variable optical attenuator with large (>40 dB) dynamic range on recoated single mode fiber
abstract: By recoating a thin layer of soldering oil on a cladding-etched single mode fiber to absorb the cladding mode light, we demonstrated a 5-cm long all-fiber acousto-optic VOA with ultra-large dynamic range (> 40 dB).

articleTitle: Engineering entangled-photon states using two-dimensional PPLN crystals
abstract: We propose to use periodically poled lithium niobate crystals (PPLN) as a source of specially engineered entangled photon pairs. We demonstrate the generation of polarization-entangled states using one-dimensional PPLN, and frequency-entangled states using two-dimensional PPLN.

articleTitle: Optical instrumentation for elastic light scattering monitoring of surface and bulk properties
abstract: A new and powerful method for characterization and monitoring of surface and bulk properties has been developed. This method is based on fast, sensitive and accurate measurements of the half-sphere's angular distribution of scattered light.

articleTitle: Improved OCT dynamic range and wider system bandwidth using bi-phase modulation
abstract: We introduce a novel bi-phase modulation scheme, which extends dynamic range, system bandwidth and increases scanning frequencies of OCT systems. Additionally there are significant improvements in the real-time imaging capability, pixel resolution and reference alignment.

articleTitle: Application of metal nanoparticles in confocal laser scanning microscopy
abstract: We describe experiments in which the field enhancement by silver nanoparticles upon surface plasmon excitation has been exploited in confocal laser scanning microscopy to improve the resolution in the direction of the laser beam.

articleTitle: Polarization mode dispersion and its impact on high bit-rate, fiber-optic communication systems
abstract: Polarization mode dispersion (PMD) in optical fibers and components can be a limiting impairment in high-speed, long-haul communication systems. We describe the impact of first- and higher-order PMD, of modulation format, and of PMD compensation.

articleTitle: Optical frequency measurements of 6s /sup 2/S/sub 1/2/-6p /sup 2/P/sub 3/2/ transition in /sup 133/Cs using an atomic beam and a femtosecond laser frequency comb
abstract: High-resolution spectroscopy and a femtosecond laser frequency comb are used to determine the optical frequencies between the components of the D/sub 2/ line in /sup 133/Cs. The accuracy of <10 kHz is 10/spl times/ better than previous results.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of micro-structured polymer optical fibers
abstract: Single-mode micro-structured polymer optical fibers over the wavelength range of 633 through 1550 nm are fabricated and characterized. The effects of drawing temperature and heating time during the fabrication processes are studied.

articleTitle: Diode-pumped compact broadband femtosecond whitelight laser sources using tapered fibers
abstract: Extremely compact diode-pumped Nd:glass and ytterbium femtosecond lasers generated continua in tapered fibers. Only 88 mW at 1060 nm yield a 200 nm wide continuum, and 600 mW of 1040 nm 30 nJ pulses give a 230 mW and >1100 nm wide continuum with a linear Gaussian peak of >250 nm width around 1120 nm.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional optical discrete/ lattice solitons
abstract: We study families of 2D lattice solitons, and show that they are possible when their power level exceeds a critical threshold. In addition, gap lattice solitons exist when the lattice possesses a complete 2D band-gap.

articleTitle: Wavelength dependence of the photo-electromotive-force effect in bipolar CdTe:V
abstract: Experiments on photo-electromotive-force effect in semi-insulating bipolar CdTe:V in the wavelength range (826-852 nm) close to the crystal fundamental optical absorption show maximal response at /spl ap/840 nm and dynamics governed by the dominating carriers life-time.

articleTitle: Misalignment-tolerant surface-normal low-voltage modulator for optical interconnects at 1.55 /spl mu/m
abstract: We introduce an electroabsorption modulator architecture that combines desirable properties of conventional waveguide designs (e.g. low-voltage operation and optical bandwidth) and surface-normal designs (e.g. misalignment tolerance). Results for an InP/InGaAsP implementation are presented.

articleTitle: Spatially-encoded spectral phase interferometry for direct electric-field reconstruction
abstract: We present a modification of the SPIDER technique for characterizing ultrashort pulses with reduced spectrometer resolution and without the creation of identical replicas of the unknown pulse. This technique is ideal for ultra-broadband pulse characterization.

articleTitle: Alternate multiwavelength picosecond fiber laser
abstract: We demonstrate alternate multiwavelength pulsed operation of an actively mode-locked fiber laser by use of an unbalanced Mach Zehnder interferometer. Three pulse trains at three different wavelengths are obtained at a 1 GHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: The National Ignition Facility: the world's largest laser system for high energy density and inertial confinement fusion science
abstract: The National Ignition Facility (NTF) at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory is a stadium-sized facility containing a 192-beam, 1.8-Megajoule, 500-Terawatt, ultraviolet laser system and a 10-meter diameter target chamber with room for nearly 100 experimental diagnostics.

articleTitle: Optical parametric generation in lithium niobate waveguides
abstract: Single-pass optical parametric generation in lithium niobate waveguides yielded a record low threshold of 200 pJ. Near-transform-limited near-infrared picosecond pulses are obtained from cascaded optical parametric generation.

articleTitle: Polymer-fullerene photovoltaics with concentration gradients induced by thermally-controlled interdiffusion
abstract: The morphology of organic photovoltaic composites containing a semiconducting polymer and fullerene is controlled by thermally-inducing interdiffusion in an initial bilayer structure. The resultant concentration gradient structure yields efficient charge transfer and charge transport.

articleTitle: An all-digital real-time optical coherence tomographic system
abstract: We developed an all-digital OCT system capable of providing real-time functional and structural information. Two different digital approaches are investigated and compared using simulated and phantom data.

articleTitle: Novel polarization reversal technique using liquid electrodes and LiNbO/sub 3/ substrates with patterned grooves
abstract: A new polarization-reversal technique was demonstrated where high voltage through liquid electrodes was applied to a 3-inch LiNbO/sub 3/ wafer grooved by sandblast machining. Domain wall movement was automatically terminated at groove boundary without feedback system.

articleTitle: Nonlinear 1D photonic polymer optical limiter materials
abstract: Nonlinear polymers possessing a 1D modulation in the complex nonlinear refractive index with a period near 100 nm were fabricated. The index modulation can enhance the optical limiting thresholds compared to spatially uniform polymer.

articleTitle: High-throughput, high-damage-threshold broadband beam splitter for high-order harmonics
abstract: We demonstrated a high-throughput and high-damage-threshold beam splitter for high-order harmonics using Si, SiC and Mo plates, set at Brewster's angle with respect to the pump wavelength

articleTitle: Photodiode-driven quantum-well modulators for C-band wavelength conversion and broadcasting
abstract: We report quantum-well modulators directly driven by monolithically-integrated photodiodes for polarization-insensitive, unconstrained wavelength conversion across 45 nm in 1525 nm-1570 nm and dual-wavelength broadcasting over 20 nm in 1530 nm-1565 nm, using <8 mW optical power with >10 dB RF-extinction ratio at 1.25 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Polarization relaxation dynamics of surface-emitting lasers following resonant pulse injection
abstract: We observe polarization relaxation oscillations induced by the resonant injection of a 100-fs optical pulse. The spin-flip time is measured to be 0.6 /spl plusmn/ 0.2 ps.

articleTitle: Power limitations of fiber lasers at 1.5 /spl mu/m by parasitic lasing effects
abstract: Using a powerful model of Er/sup 3+//Yb/sup 3+/ fiber amplifiers, we show that parasitic lasing can severely limit their efficiency. Comparing modeling and experimental results we demonstrate that reflections and temperature effects should be taken into account.

articleTitle: Dilute-nitride mid-infrared type-II "W" quantum-well lasers on InP substrates
abstract: It is predicted that InAsN/GaAsSb/InAsN/GaInP strain-compensated type-II "W" quantum wells grown on InP substrates should emit in the mid-IR (3-5 /spl mu/m) with favorable lasing characteristics.

articleTitle: Harmonics optical biopsy of human skin
abstract: Avoiding the in-focus photodamage and phototoxicity problem of two-photon-fluorescence excitation, noninvasive harmonics optical biopsy of human skin is demonstrated based on a 1200-1300-nm femtosecond light source.

articleTitle: 39 GHz intrinsic bandwidth of a 1.55 /spl mu/m injection-locked VCSEL
abstract: A record resonance frequency of 28 GHz and an intrinsic laser 3 dB bandwidth of 39 GHz is reported for a directly modulated injection-locked 1.55 /spl mu/m VCSEL. Using polarization maintaining components, S21 and RIN is studied experimentally.

articleTitle: Femtosecond pulse compression around 1 /spl mu/m wavelength in air-guiding PCF
abstract: A 22-fold pulse-duration compression around 1 mum is achieved in an air-guiding anomalously dispersive photonic-crystal-fibre. 3.6 ps pulses from an Yb-fibre laser are compressed to 163 fs in the totally-fibre integrated format. Peak/average power scalability is feasible

articleTitle: Optimizing the input scrambling rate in a recirculating loop with EDFAs
abstract: We optimize the input polarization scrambling rate in a recirculating loop by analyzing amplitude modulation in a cascade of EDFAs. This scrambling rate minimizes penalties due to PDL and PDG.

articleTitle: Interferometric side-diffraction position monitoring technique for writing long fiber Bragg gratings
abstract: A new fiber position monitoring method based on the side-diffraction interference technique is proposed and demonstrated to be able to assist the fabrication of long fiber Bragg gratings by sequential UV writing.

articleTitle: All-optical time-division add-drop multiplexer using an optical fiber Kerr shutter
abstract: We propose a novel scheme for all-optical time-division add-drop multiplexing based on an optical Kerr shutter. One 10-Gb/s tributary of a 40-Gb/s signal is exchanged with that of another 40-Gb/s signal by the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Imaging the dynamic tissue response to inhaled carbogen
abstract: We have measured the dynamic changes in the optical properties of tissues in response to inspiratory hypercapnia and hyperoxia. We observed enhanced image contrast between cancerous and normal tissues of the animals studied.

articleTitle: Pr/sup 3+/ doped materials as photon cascade emitters for mercury-free discharge lamps
abstract: Pr/sup 3+/ doped materials for potential application in Hg-free discharge lamps were spectroscopically investigated. The quantum efficiency of the cascade emission was estimated. The possible energy transfer to acceptor ions is analyzed.

articleTitle: Novel multi-wavelength pulse generator for real-time WDM optical sampling
abstract: We demonstrate a novel multi-wavelength pulse generator ideal for WDM photonic analog-digital-conversion. Using a time lens to compress and displace pulses in time, our method greatly simplifies previous approaches and adds new flexibility and control.

articleTitle: 1 MHz high energy passively mode-locked diode-pumped Nd:YVO/sub 4/ laser
abstract: We demonstrate the operation of a 24 kW-peak-power, 16-picosecond diode-pumped Nd:YVO/sub 4/ passively-mode-locked laser oscillator with the lowest repetition rate (below 1 MHz) ever generated without cavity dumping. Application to fluorescence lifetime imaging measurements is presented.

articleTitle: Spectrum broadening and carrier-envelope offset frequency measurement based on cross-phase modulation in a photonic crystal fiber
abstract: We observed a 200-nm spectrum broadening of the third harmonics (520 nm) of an Er-doped mode-locked fiber laser (1560 nm) based on cross-phase modulation in a photonic crystal fiber.

articleTitle: Room temperature lasing in InAs quantum-dot microdisk laser
abstract: We achieved the first room-temperature lasing in a InAs quantum-dot microdisk at a wavelength of 1.23 /spl mu/m by photopumping. We investigated its temperature dependence to estimate dominant factors for lasing.

articleTitle: Sub-wavelength surface structures on silicon irradiated by femtosecond laser pulses
abstract: We present surface structures formed on silicon after irradiation by large numbers of low-fluence femtosecond laser pulses with wavelengths in the transparency regime of silicon. These structures have periods significantly less than the laser wavelength.

articleTitle: Precision tests of femtosecond laser optical frequency synthesizers
abstract: We compare the accuracy of femtosecond laser optical frequency synthesizers that employ microstructured fibers with those that directly generate a broadband output. No limitation of either system is found at fractional frequency levels of 1 /spl times/ 10/sup -18/.

articleTitle: Z-scan measurements of the nonlinear refractive indices of novel Yb-doped laser crystal hosts
abstract: The nonlinear refractive indices of novel Yb-doped, borate laser crystal hosts (GdCOB, YCOB, BOYS) were characterized. The results indicate that these laser crystals are promising candidates for diode-pumped Kerr-lens mode-locked operation.

articleTitle: Temperature dependence of the absorption and refraction of Mg-doped congruent and stoichiometric LiNbO/sub 3/ in the THz range
abstract: The absorption coefficient and the index of refraction of Mg-doped LiNbO/sub 3/ crystals with different compositions are determined in the 30 - 200 cm-1 frequency range. We find that stoichiometric LiNbO/sub 3/ has smaller absorption and index of refraction than congruent samples.

articleTitle: Liquid crystal adaptive optics to improve optical sensors
abstract: The talk will give an overview of liquid crystal based adaptive optics. Different techniques to improve their performance as well as their integration in micro optical disc drives will be demonstrated.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of symmetric Mach-Zehnder structure based on 2D photonic crystal waveguide for all-optical switches
abstract: Symmetric Mach-Zehnder structures based on photonic crystal slab waveguides were successfully fabricated. Several key points in designing this structure are discussed. Measured transmission spectrum gives great feasibility for realizing an ultra-small all-optical switch

articleTitle: Amplitude and phase measurement of 20 ps pulses from a mode-locked high-power InGaAs diode laser MOPA system using frequency-resolved optical gating
abstract: We report on the frequency-resolved optical gating measurement of picosecond pulses with a FWHM bandwidth of less than 0.15 nm generated by a mode-locked high-power InGaAs diode laser MOPA system.

articleTitle: Efficient femtosecond pulse generation in the blue using BiB/sub 3/O/sub 6/
abstract: Efficient second harmonic generation of femtosecond pulses into the blue is reported in BiB/sub 3/O/sub 6/. Single-pass conversion efficiencies of 53% and average powers of 235 mW have been obtained in 50-fs pulses at 85 MHz repetition-rate.

articleTitle: Photonic radio-frequency arbitrary waveform generation using a virtually-imaged phased-array (VIPA) direct space-to-time pulse shaper at 1.55 /spl mu/m
abstract: 10-50 GHz arbitrary radio-frequency waveforms with a temporal aperture up to 1.0 ns and peak-to-peak amplitudes as high as 400 mV are generated using a virtually-imaged phased-array direct space-to-time (VIPA-DST) pulse shaper at 1.55 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Amplification of femtosecond pulses by coherent addition in passive enhancement cavities
abstract: We demonstrate a general technique for enhancement of femtosecond pulses through coherent buildup and subsequent dumping in an external cavity. Sub40 fs pulses are amplified by more than 45 times at 1250 kHz repetition rates.

articleTitle: Parametric down-conversion using multi-crystal dispersion-compensated sources for control of quantum interference
abstract: The space-time states of photons generated by parametric down-conversion must be tailored for particular applications. This can be achieved by compensated nonlinear crystal dispersion using linear optical elements.

articleTitle: Room temperature broadband near-infrared emission from nickel in zinc-alumino-silicate glass
abstract: Broadband near-infrared emission from nickel in zinc-alumino-silicate glass was observed at room temperature. The center and width of the emission band were /spl sim/1400 nm and >300 nm respectively. The emission lifetime was >200 /spl mu/sec even at room temperature.

articleTitle: Single-frequency, polarized ytterbium-doped fiber MOPA source with 264 W output power
abstract: A single-frequency, single-mode, plane-polarized ytterbiumdoped all-fiber master-oscillator - power amplifier source at 1060 um generated 264 W of cw output power (pump-power limited) The final stage amplifier operated with a high gain of 19 dB and a high conversion efficiency of 68%.

articleTitle: Large angle scanning of laser beam by cascaded electro-optic scanning in a ferroelectric chip
abstract: We present the new device concept of cascaded electro-optic scanning. We fabricate this design by domain micropatterning LiTaO/sub 3/. The device scan range is 25.4/spl deg/. Using this design, angles greater than 90/spl deg/ are possible.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a parallel-access holographic RAM using the super-parallel holographic optical correlator architecture
abstract: We show how a super-parallel holographic correlator architecture may be used to realize a super-parallel holographic random access memory. This eliminates the need for a separate random access memory for a holographic correlator based target recognition and tracking system

articleTitle: 42 W Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ bounce laser oscillator
abstract: A continuous-wave, diode-pumped Nd:GdVO/sup 4/ bounce laser oscillator produces 20 W of TEM/sub 00/ output (M/sup 2/< 1.05) from 40 W of diode pumping. 42 W multimode and 35 W of TEM/sub 00 /output from 80 W of diode pumping is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical serrodyne frequency shifting using polymer modulators
abstract: Serrodyne frequency shifting of continuous optical signals and optical pulses by up to 86 GHz is demonstrated in an electrooptic polymer phase modulator. Current work focuses on increasing the frequency shift using time-compressed sawtooth waveforms.

articleTitle: Mode-locked Nd-doped microstructure fiber laser
abstract: We demonstrate first mode-locking of a Nd/sup 3+/-doped microstructured fiber laser using a semiconductor saturable absorber mirror. A pulse width of 25 ps and a peak power of 4 W have been achieved.

articleTitle: Novel optical chemsensor based on etched D-fiber Bragg gratings
abstract: A novel optical chemsensor concept based on the cladding etched Bragg gratings in D-fiber is demonstrated. Two etched devices have been used to measure the concentrations of sugar solution, giving sensitivity as high as 0.02 nm/%.

articleTitle: Fluidic adaptive zoom without lens motion
abstract: This study demonstrated a 20 mm aperture monolithically integrated fluidic zoom lens with a total thickness of 8 mm and a hybrid fluidic zoom lens with a lens distance of 25 mm. The zoom ratios for monolithic and hybrid zoom lenses are 1.8 and 3.0, respectively. This works shows that these characteristics of fluidic lenses fit uniquely to integrated zoom lenses that obtain zooming function without varying the lens distance.

articleTitle: Delivery of high-peak power nanosecond pulses through air-core photonic bandgap fibres
abstract: Nanosecond pulses with peak powers in the order of 12 kW have been delivered single-mode through air-core photonic bandgap fibres at 1064 nm using a high repetition rate (15 kHz) Nd:YAG laser.

articleTitle: Suppression of Brillouin scattering in a single-mode neodymium-doped fiber amplifier
abstract: We demonstrated efficient suppression of cascaded Brillouin scattering in a 72 m-long neodymium-doped fiber amplifier by simultaneous amplification of two seed lasers separated in wavelength by two times the Brillouin-shift.

articleTitle: Incoherent smoothed 20-mJ beam delivered by diode pump laser oscillator
abstract: We present a new compact laser oscillator, which delivers incoherent smoothed beam. It yields 50 ns pulse width at repetition rate of 1 Hz. Its 20 mJ energy pulse may be directly injected in high energy laser chain.

articleTitle: Application of the nonlinear crystal SrB/sub 4/O/sub 7/ for ultrafast diagnostics down to 125 nm
abstract: We used non-phase-matched SHG in the highly-nonlinear but low-birefringent crystal SrB/sub 4/O/sub 7/ for temporal characterization (autocorrelation) of femtosecond UV pulses converting them to wavelengths as low as 125 nm, close to the transparency limit of SrB/sub 4/O/sub 7/.

articleTitle: Low-loss propagation in hollow ARROW waveguides for optical sensing
abstract: Low-loss propagation in novel integrated antiresonant reflecting optical (ARROW) waveguides with hollow cores and two-dimensional confinement is reported. Design principles and applications for optical sensing of gases and liquids are discussed.

articleTitle: Improved distortion and dispersion tolerance of 4-level 40 Gb/s signals in amplified datacommunications links
abstract: We show that 4-level 40 Gb/s modulation in an amplified link has a 3 dB greater tolerance to amplifier distortions and improved dispersion performance compared to the 2-level equivalent.

articleTitle: 1.5-/spl mu/m-wavelength single mode semiconductor lasers with deeply etched vertical grating
abstract: Small periodic grating structures were dry-etched with superior vertically and high aspect ratio. These structures were then applied to demonstrate stable single mode and low threshold operation on high index contrast laser devices.

articleTitle: Generation and wavelength conversion of light in photonic crystal fibres
abstract: Through radically enhanced control of the guided modes, PCF is giving rise to a new generation of high performance all-fibre devices, including gas-Raman cells, supercontinuum sources, nonlinear wavelength converters and ultra-high power cladding-pumped lasers.

articleTitle: Buried planar and channel waveguides in sapphire and Ti:sapphire by proton implantation
abstract: Buried, stacked planar and channel waveguides in sapphire and Ti:sapphire are fabricated by proton implantation. Flexibility of the fabrication technique and good control over the implantation parameters result in variable design and excellent light confinement.

articleTitle: Phase-matching and femtosecond difference-frequency generation in the quaternary semiconductor AgGaGe/sub 5/Se/sub 12/
abstract: Linear and nonlinear optical properties of AgGaGe/sub 5/Se/sub 12/ will be presented which allowed us to produce tunable fs-pulses between 4 and 7.5 /spl mu/m and only 5 optical cycles at 5 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: White light supercontinuum interference of self-focused filaments in water
abstract: The generation of a horizontal array of stable white-light continuum (WLC) filaments in water is observed using a cylindrical plano-convex lens. This array is used to demonstrate the phase relationships between adjacent filaments.

articleTitle: Parametric switching and frequency conversion in PPLN directional couplers
abstract: Ultrafast all-optical switching is experimentally demonstrated based on quadratic parametric interaction in PPLN waveguide couplers. Transparent on/off switching and frequency conversion of milliwatt signals at 1550 nm is achieved with 2 W switching power.

articleTitle: Resonant heating of a cluster plasma by intense laser light
abstract: Cluster heating by a strong laser field is studied using a particle-in-cell code (PIC) for a range of intensities and cluster sizes. Above a threshold intensity, heating is dominated by a nonlinear resonant absorption process.

articleTitle: Laser-assisted nanoimprinting using self-assembled nanoparticles
abstract: A new approach to fabricating hemispherical-cavity arrays on silicon substrates using laser-assisted nanoimprinting of self-assembled particles has been developed. Monolayers of silica or polystyrene particles, with different diameters ranging from 160 nm to 5 /spl mu/m, were deposited on silicon substrates by self-assembly. A quartz plate, which is transparent to the laser wavelength of 248 nm, was tightly placed on the surface of each sample, which has been preheated. A KrF excimer laser beam with a wavelength of 248 nm was vertically irradiated on the quartz / nanoparticle / silicon structure. The silica particles were imprinted into silicon substrates by the quartz due to the transient Si surface melting during the laser irradiation. Ultrasonic cleaning and hydrofluoric-acid (HF) solution were then used to remove the silica particles. Hemispherical cavities on the silicon substrate were formed on the substrate surface. The effects of silica particle size, different laser fluence, laser pulse number and substrate temperature will be discussed in detail. It was found that polystyrene particles could not be used for the laser-assisted imprinting due to their low melting point. Raman spectroscopy will be used to analyze the material properties in the fabricated structures. Periodical multiple-layer structures (3-D structures) will also be made on silicon substrates.

articleTitle: Generation and transmission of 17-GHz optical sideband signals using a 2.5-Gb/s-grade DFB laser with wavelength selective gain from an FP laser
abstract: We demonstrate a new scheme of effectively enhancing laser diode intensity modulation bandwidth and, simultaneously, generating optical single sideband. 17-GHz optical single sideband is generated and 155-Mb/s data transmission at 17 GHz is achieved.

articleTitle: Surface-structure identification using THz radar techniques with spatial beam filtering and out-of-focus detection
abstract: We propose two terahertz reflectometry modalities, optimized to be sensitive to the curvature of surface features. A dark-field approach yields higher sensitivity whilst the out-of-focus technique allows one to distinguish between convex and concave shapes.

articleTitle: Experimental realization of multicanonical sampling
abstract: We report the first experimental implementation of the multicanonical approach to the determination of probability distribution functions of stochastic systems. In particular, we obtain the differential group delay of a polarization mode dispersion emulator for events with a probability of 10/sup -7/ with only 6000 samples.

articleTitle: Integratable, wide free spectral range Fabry-Perot filters fabricated from freestanding LiNbO/sub 3/ thin-films
abstract: Fabry-Perot filters possessing free spectral ranges in excess of 50 nanometers (6.78 THz) have been demonstrated in 10-micron thin freestanding lithium niobate. The ultra compact form of the filters enables integration into optical waveguide systems.

articleTitle: Compact single-bar side-pumped Yb:YAG thin-disk laser
abstract: High-average-power continuous-wave operations of a compact single-bar side-pumped Yb:YAG thin-disk laser with high pumping efficiency was demonstrated. The maximum output power was 104-W from three disks with slope efficiency of 0.47 in full multimode operation

articleTitle: Wavelength conversion in silicon waveguides using parametric Raman coupling
abstract: Parametric coupling enabled by the Raman susceptibility is used to demonstrate wavelength conversion in silicon waveguides. Influence of phase matching and means to achieve phase matched waveguides are discussed.

articleTitle: Wavelength references for precision dimensional metrology in air
abstract: Laser wavelength references based on stable interferometers operating in air are considered. Optical frequency combs using femtosecond lasers are used to calibrate the stable cavities. Long-term monitoring of cavity stability is described.

articleTitle: White-light continuum Z-scan measurements
abstract: A white-light continuum Z-scan technique is proposed and demonstrated as an efficient method to measure degenerated nonlinear absorption spectra in organic materials.

articleTitle: 1.5mW single-mode output power at 90/spl deg/C from 1530nm VCSELs
abstract: VCSELs based on double-fused InAIGaAsflnP-active material and GaAdAIGaAs- DBRs were fabricated and tested. Record-high single-mode output powers of 1.5mW at 90°C were observed at an emission wavelength of 1530nm with side-mode suppression ratio of 42dB.

articleTitle: High-power solid-state sodium laser guidestar for the Gemini North Observatory
abstract: We report on development of the first commercial solid-state sodium laser guidestar (LGS): a critical step towards a robust turn-key LGS that can be upgraded for different observatories and for multi-conjugate adaptive optics and future extra-large telescopes.

articleTitle: Switching dynamics of Raman fiber lasers
abstract: We investigate the switching dynamics of Raman fiber lasers (RFLs). Cascaded RFLs show strong output pulses when switched on, which are reduced by longer rise times of the pump without affecting the overall settling time.

articleTitle: Generation of a single-cycle optical pulse
Multiwavelength Er-doped fiber ring laser incorporating highly nonlinear fiber
abstract: We demonstrate multiwavelength Er-doped fiber ring laser using fiber Fabry-Perot interferometer as the wavelength selective device. Incorporating a highly nonlinear fiber, multiwavelength lasing over 40 nm is achieved at room temperature.

articleTitle: A 0.6 W CW GaInNAs vertical external-cavity surface-emitting laser operating at 1.32 /spl mu/m
abstract: We report the first high-power vertical external-cavity surface-emitting laser operating at 1.3 /spl mu/m. Continuous-wave output power greater than 0.6 W was achieved using a GaInNAs/GaAs structure capillary-bonded to a single-crystal diamond heatspreader.

articleTitle: 87-nm bandwidth noise-like pulse generation from erbium-doped fiber laser
abstract: We operate a passively mode-locked erbium-doped fiber laser in noise-like mode and generate the pulse train with a bandwidth much wider than the gain bandwidth. Super-continuum generation from the noise-like pulse is also demonstrated successfully.

articleTitle: Stimulated Brillouin scattering in small-core PCF
abstract: Ultra-small core PCF is shown to have SBS characteristics radically different from those seen in standard fiber. For small cores, the spontaneous linewidth develops multiple peaks, the threshold power increases, and the frequency shift falls.

articleTitle: Simulation, design, and understanding of high-speed lithium niobate modulators
abstract: We present simulation results of ridged lithium niobate modulators and describe a novel method for visualizing the modulator design space which links structural changes to variations in modulator bandwidth, impedance, and drive voltage

articleTitle: Cavity ring-down spectroscopy of semiconductor quantum dots
abstract: We employ cavity ring-down to perform absorption experiments of InGaAs/GaAs QDs. Integrating an AlAs/GaAs DBR incorporating InGaAs QD's into a Fabry-Perot cavity, we demonstrate this approach and its potential for sensitive measurements on semiconductor nanostructures.

articleTitle: Search for general relativistic effects in table-top displacement metrology
abstract: As displacement metrology accuracy improves, general relativistic effects will become noticeable. Metrology gauges developed for the space interferometry mission, were used to search for locally anisotropic space-time, with a null result at the 10/sup -10/ level.

articleTitle: Broadband saturable Bragg reflectors from the infrared to visible using oxidized AIAs
abstract: Highly strained semiconductor saturable absorbers are monolithically integrated with large area high-index-contrast mirrors through controlled oxidation of AlAs. This technique is used to create broadband saturable Bragg reflectors for lasers from infrared to visible wavelengths.

articleTitle: Picosecond, 60 kW peak power, Yb fibre source
abstract: A novel, 2 ps fibre laser operating in Yb-wavelength range with 60 kW peak and 9 W average powers is demonstrated. Pulses from a self-starting, ring-fibre-cavity Yb oscillator with spectral gain/pulse-duration control were amplified in 1.4 m-long, Yb-doped fiber.

articleTitle: 10 Gbit/s directly modulated signal transmission over 80 km SMF with chirp compensation using four-wave mixing
abstract: We proposed a novel method of chirp compensation using four-wave mixing and confirmed the effect by SMF transmission employing 10 Gbit/s directly modulated laser. This method enabled SMF transmission over 80 km with a very low penalty.

articleTitle: Real-time holography using photorefractive sillenite crystals and their applications in surfaces analysis with phase-stepping technique
abstract: This work applies a holographic setup that uses the photorefractive Bi/sub 12/SiO/sub 20/ and Bi/sub 12/TiO/sub 20/ crystals for real-time holography (RTH). This device is connected with an interferogram-analysis method that uses the phase-stepping technique for quantitative measurement of changes on object and topograph. So we captured holographic interferograms from analyzed surface, and calculated the phase and removed the wrapping of tangent function (unwrapping), using the cellular-automata technique, where obtained good results.

articleTitle: Generation of flatly broadened, wideband and low noise supercontinuum by use of highly nonlinear hybrid fiber
abstract: We demonstrated the generation of 1180-2100 nm wideband, flat, and low noise supercontinuum using optimally designed highly nonlinear hybrid fiber and fiber laser. Stable smooth spectrum without fine structure was realized.

articleTitle: Relativistic electron acceleration in the wavelength-cubed regime
abstract: We report on relativistic electron acceleration from bulk copper in the wavelength-cubed regime with 0.4-mJ, 25-fs pulses focused to 1.2 /spl mu/m at 400 Hz. Results show electrons with energies exceeding 500 keV propagating toward the vacuum.

articleTitle: Scaleable high-energy femtosecond Ti:sapphire oscillator
abstract: We demonstrate a Ti:sapphire oscillator generating 130-220 nJ pulses of 27-35 fs at a repetition rate of 11 MHz. Excessive nonlinearities are avoided by chirped picosecond pulse generation from the oscillator followed by extracavity compression. The concept is scaleable to higher pulse energies.

articleTitle: 0.5 W efficient continuous wave Tm:KY(WO/sub 4/)/sub 2/ laser
abstract: Spectroscopic properties and laser performance of Tm/sup 3+/:KY(WO/sub 4/)/sub 2/ laser crystal were investigated. A maximum output power of 555 mW with a slope efficiency of 53% was obtained under CW diode pumping at 802 nm.

articleTitle: Training 1100 /spl times/ 1100-port MEMS-based optical crossconnect switches
abstract: We report 1100 times 1100-port optical crossconnect switch using micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS) technology. The challenge of generating the database for each connection was addressed by advanced mathematical modeling, streamlined learning process and efficient hill-climbing algorithm

articleTitle: 1-W green generation by frequency-doubling of a diode end-pumped Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ laser in a bulk periodically poled MgO:LiNbO/sub 3/ at room temperature
abstract: 1.38 W continuous-wave power at 531 nm with 19.6% internal conversion efficiency is obtained at room temperature by single-pass extracavity frequency doubling of a Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ laser through a 2-mm-thick, 25-mm-long periodically polled MgO:LiNbO/sub 3/.

articleTitle: Terahertz time-resolved linear spectroscopy of single-wall carbon nanotube films
abstract: Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy was applied to measure absorption and dispersion by single-wall carbon nanotubes in the frequency range of 0.2-5 THz. In addition, we determine the carrier and phonon relaxation rates in the nanotubes ensemble excited by a near infrared subpicosecond pulse.

articleTitle: Ultraviolet and blue emission properties of Tm doped AlGaN and AlN
abstract: We report on the ultraviolet (UV) and blue emission properties of Tm doped AlGaN/AIN thin films under above- and below bandgap excitation. UV (/spl sim/300-350 nm) and blue (/spl sim/465 nm) emission lines of Tm/sup 3+/ ions are of interest for potential applications in chemical/biological sensing, full color displays, and solid-state lightening.

articleTitle: Semiconductor optical amplifier for CWDM operating over 1540-1620 nm
abstract: A semiconductor optical amplifier was developed for CWDM operating over 1540-1620 nm. Over this band, 24 dB maximum chip gain was obtained with less than 4.3 dB gain flatness and more than 14.6 dBm saturation power.

articleTitle: Generation and application of high intensity XUV lights by high-order harmonics
abstract: We report our efforts on observation of multiphoton process in the XUV region including high intensity high harmonic generation and its application technology such as beam splitters and multilayer mirrors

articleTitle: Sub femto-joule sensitive single-shot XFROG measurements based on optical parametric amplification
abstract: A new single-shot XFROG technique for characterizing ultrashort optical pulses with extremely weak intensity is demonstrated. The design uses beam-crossing OPA-FROG with all-reflective optics which enables the measurement of optical pulse with pulse energy less than femto-joule and pulse width as short as a few femtoseconds. The measurable wavelength range from visible to IR, depending on the phase-matching of the nonlinear crystal used, the pump wavelength and the configuration of OPA.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence from a Nd/sup 3+/-doped AIGaAs semiconductor structure
abstract: We report room-temperature photoluminescence from a Nd/sup 3+/ -doped AlGaAs semiconductor. Oxidation of the AlGaAs greatly improves the luminescence efficiency of the Nd/sup 3+/ ions.

articleTitle: 3W cw output power from an optically pumped semiconductor disk laser at 1050 nm
abstract: We have demonstrated the first optically pumped semiconductor disk laser at 1050 nm with 3 W continuous wave output power and good beam quality. High differential efficiency of 42% results in an optical conversion efficiency of 30%.

articleTitle: Self-organizing diode laser with cavity formed by dynamic holographic gratings
abstract: A diode laser based on an electrically pumped InGaP/GaAs/InGaAs two-quantum-well heterostructure with cavity completed by dynamic holographic gratings was created. The temporal dynamics, frequency spectra and spatial diagrams of lasing beams were examined.

articleTitle: Investigation of thermal stability of UV written planar waveguides using direct grating writing
abstract: We use the direct grating writing technique, based on direct UV writing, to define planar Bragg channel waveguides and accurately probe the refractive index to characterise thermal waveguide erasure and material properties.

articleTitle: Experimental comparison of RZ-IMDD and RZ-DQPSK performance in a standard 2000-km DWDM system
abstract: We experimentally compare BER performance obtained by doubling the data-rate from 10 Gb/s RZ-IMDD modulation format to 20-Gb/s-equivalent RZ-DQPSK format in a standard 2000-km 33-GHz spaced 64-channel DWDM link.

articleTitle: Multi-wavelength 10 GHz pulse source constructed from injection locking of a Fabry-Perot laser diode by spectrally broadened and comb-filtered DFB laser pulses
abstract: Using a single DFB laser as an injection source, we successfully generate 5-wavelength, 10 GHz pulses from a Fabry-Perot laser diode. The number of wavelengths is adjustable and the scheme is insensitive to wavelength drift.

articleTitle: Enhancement of third-harmonic generation in photonic crystals
abstract: Significant enhancement (25X) of third-harmonic generation is observed in both 1-D and 3-D photonic crystals. The phase matching conditions and the local field enhancement are analyzed through the numerical simulations and the effective medium theory.

articleTitle: Inscription of fiber Bragg gratings by high-intensity 264 nm femtosecond radiation
abstract: We report on the first fabrication of fiber Bragg gratings using UV femtosecond radiation. The Bragg gratings with a photoinduced refractive index modulation of up to 2/spl times/10/sup -3/ were recorded in standard H/sub 2/-loaded SMF-28 and four different H/sub 2/-free photosensitive fibers by high-intensity (31-86 GW/cm/sup 2/) femtosecond pulses at 264 nm.

articleTitle: Mapping of Cr ions and refraction index profile in Cr:YAG crystal fiber with double-cladding structure
abstract: Double cladding Cr:YAG crystal fiber was fabricated by a co-drawing laser heated pedestal growth technique. The Cr/sup 3+/, Cr/sup 4+/ fluorescence and refraction index distribution were investigated by a 2-D scanning microscopy.

articleTitle: 10-GHz-order optical frequency shifter using Bragg-diffraction-type electrooptic traveling phase grating
abstract: We propose a novel 10-GHz-order high-efficiency optical frequency shifter based on Bragg diffraction in an electrooptic traveling phase grating with slant periodic domain inversion. Frequency shifting was demonstrated at 16.25 GHz with conversion efficiency 70%.

articleTitle: Ultrafast nonlinear switching in a semiconductor two-dimensional photonic crystal
abstract: We report ultrafast switching operation around 1.5 /spl mu/m in a nonlinear 2D photonic crystal induced via resonant optical Kerr effect. We measure time responses faster than 10 ps.

articleTitle: Ultrashort femtosecond OPA measurement of two photon absorption in InAs
abstract: Nonlinear optical absorption in InAs has been studied using a mid-infrared, ultrashort femtosecond pulse OPA-DFM system. The magnitude and dispersion of the deduced two photon absorption coefficient is compared with theory

articleTitle: Use of 4f pulse shaper as an active carrier-envelope phase shifter
abstract: We show that the pulse shaper composed of a spatial light modulator and the 4f optical configuration works as an active carrier-envelope phase shifter. The relative phase shift was measured by the spectral interferometry.

articleTitle: Laser based multiple gas species sensor for harsh combustion process control applications
abstract: Results from a tunable diode laser system for simultaneously monitoring of O/sub 2/, CO, H/sub 2/O and gas temperature are presented for laboratory characterization studies and industrial testing on a steel reheat furnace and aluminum reverberatory furnace.

articleTitle: Nano-patterning of PMMA using a /spl lambda/ = 46.9 nm table-top laser
abstract: The recording in PMMA of nanometer-size features from a Fresnel diffraction pattern utilising a very compact 46.9 nm capillary discharge laser is discussed.

articleTitle: Electro-optic detection of narrowband radiation tunable from the far-infrared through the mid-infrared
abstract: We demonstrate the coherent detection of tunable narrowband far-infrared and mid-infrared radiation. This radiation is produced using conventional difference frequency mixing and detected using the linear electro-optic effect.

articleTitle: Radio on multimode fiber systems based on VCSELs with external light injection technique
abstract: A radio on multimode fiber (MMF) system based on 1.55 /spl mu/m vertical cavity surface emitting lasers (VCSELs) and external light injection technique is proposed and demonstrated. Low error vector magnitude (EVM), third order intermodulation distortion to carrier ratio (IMD/sub 3//C) and bit error rate (BER) values were obtained in our proposed radio on MMF systems. Using VCSELs as optical sources in radio on MMF systems are very attractive, as they are relatively simple to fabricate and potentially low cost. Such a proposed radio on MMF system is suitable for the short-haul microwave optical link.

articleTitle: Thin rod Yb:YAG regenerative amplifier for high average power and high repetition rate pulse generation
abstract: A diode-pumped thin rod Yb:YAG regenerative amplifier has been developed. Average output power of 30 W was obtained at pulse repetition rate of 30 kHz.

articleTitle: Raman extension of the soliton self-frequency shift
abstract: The soliton self-frequency shift is employed to generate wavelength-tunable subpicosecond solitons between 1.56-1.70 mum. it is shown that the soliton self-frequency shift can be further extended using Raman gain from an external pump

articleTitle: Metrology system for space interferometry mission system testbed 3
abstract: A 3-baseline interferometer fourteen metrology gauges are used to monitor changes in the two baselines; calculate the length of the third. Simulation for estimating the third baseline indicates measurement capability better than 1 nm error.

articleTitle: Radiation and scattering of linear waves and solitons in photonic crystal fibers
abstract: We report theoretical and experimental results on the cancellation of the soliton self-frequency shift in photonic crystal fibers. We also analyze the scattering of linear waves by the soliton in these fibers.

articleTitle: All-optical switch on a silicon chip
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical switching on silicon using highly confining microstructures. The transmission of the structures is modulated by more than 97% in less than 500 ps using light pulses with energies as low as 40 pJ

articleTitle: Luminescent measurements of upconverting chelates
abstract: Upconverting chelates provide novel capabilities as biological reporters. We report on the detailed optical response of different chelate compounds using one- and two-color laser light excitation.

articleTitle: Novel low-loss 60/spl deg/ bends in photonic crystal waveguides
abstract: A novel type of 60 degree photonic crystal waveguide bend has been designed, simulated and fabricated in silicon-on-insulator material utilizing deep ultraviolet lithography. Loss-free bending has been observed in certain wavelength regions

articleTitle: Fiber Raman figure-of-eight lasers
abstract: A compact and simple subpicosecond 1330-nm figure-of-eight fiber laser employing stimulated Raman scattering in standard fiber is described. The laser could be easily translated to other spectral regions and used for a variety of applications.

articleTitle: Chirped pulse optical parametric amplification of 17.3-fs, CEO-stabilized pulses
6.5 GHz analog optical signal processor based on coherent integration of complementary sequences
abstract: We demonstrate broadband TTD spectral gratings using complementary sequences at 6.5 G bit/s. Comparative analysis of integration dynamics between single and pairwise complementary coding reveals 18 dB increase in dynamic range due to complementary sidelobe cancellation.

articleTitle: Compact high power (5.6 W) picosecond white light source
abstract: The combination of a diode-pumped Nd:YVO/sub 4/ picosecond laser source with tapered fibers allows the realization of a compact white light source with an average output power of up to 5.6 W. We generated supercontinua with an efficiency of /spl sim/ 50 % over a spectral range of up to 1150 nm by using a series of tapered fibers.

articleTitle: Fiber-based, high-power 1-micron source for optical coherence tomography
abstract: We report supercontinuum generation at 1 micron from a practical, fiber-based source for optical coherence tomography. The portable fiber device provides compact, high-power (~80 mW) broadband spectrum with 6.5-micron longitudinal resolution

articleTitle: Timing jitter due to intra-channel nonlinearities in an installed fiber optic network
abstract: We report field measurements of intra-channel nonlinearity-induced timing jitter in an installed fiber transmission system. The timing jitter is strongly dependent on the distribution of dispersion compensation, in agreement with numerical simulation results.

articleTitle: Suppression of side fringes in a low-coherence measurement with gain-switched Fabry-Perot laser diode
abstract: To use laser diodes as low-coherence light source, side fringes appearing in the autocorrelation measurement of multi-longitudinal mode oscillation from a gain-switched Fabry-Perot laser diode were effectively suppressed by applying a lightwave synthesis technique.

articleTitle: Deep-notch and ultra-compact long-period grating in large mode-area photonic crystal fiber
abstract: A strong resonance and ultra-compact long-period grating is fabricated in large-modearea photonic crystal fiber with LPo, notch of -31.5dB at wavelength of 1529.2nm, and 8 periodic collapse within 2.8-mm-long of fiber by using CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser.

articleTitle: Discrete optical solitons in waveguide arrays and photonic lattices
abstract: Optical discrete solitons and their various types such as in-phase, staggered or gap, twisted, vortex will be studied in the paper. Discrete solitons in two-dimensional nonlinear waveguide array networks are also discussed.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser pulse self-stabilization
abstract: A photoconductive switch directly driving a Pockels cell ensures stabilization of ultrafast laser pulse energy. Here, for the first time to our knowledge, the pulse corrects itself.

articleTitle: Development of the CW coaxial diode-pumped solid state multi-color laser
abstract: We have developed 1 W class (CW) coaxial diode-pumped solid state multi-color laser (532 nm, 593 nm, 671 nm) by use of intracavity second harmonic and sum frequency generation for Nd:YVO/sub 4/ dual cavities of 1342 nm and 1064 nm.

articleTitle: Probability-density function for energy perturbations of optical pulses in 10-Gb/s communication systems
abstract: The probability-density function (PDF) for noise-induced energy perturbations of isolated optical pulses is determined analytically and numerically. This PDF differs significantly from the (idealized) Gauss PDF that is often used to predict system performance

articleTitle: Continuous laser source for cooling Rubidium atoms using second harmonic generation from a PPLN crystal
abstract: We have realized a compact, 0.2 W continuous sub-MHz laser source at 780 nm from second harmonic generation inside a periodically poled LiNbO/sub 3/ crystal. The fiber system fulfill requirements for cooling and trapping Rubidium atoms.

articleTitle: All optically driven femtosecond keV X-ray source
abstract: Polychromatic and femtosecond keV X-ray beams have been generated from laser-plasma interactions. We present results on the synchrotron radiation from relativistic electrons undergoing betatron oscillations, and on nonlinear Thomson scattering radiation.

articleTitle: Improvement of high power and high current operation of GaN light emitting diodes by laser lift-off technique
abstract: We have demonstrated the high operation current up to 400 mA for the laser lift-off InGaN/GaN LEDs on Cu heat sink with 3.5 fold increase in the light output power over the regular LEDs.

articleTitle: Polarization sensitive multiplexed organic DFB lasers
abstract: Multiplexed organic distributed feedback lasers exhibiting polarization sensitivity have been realized. Fast optical tuning of the emission wavelength and spectral encoding of polarization state of the pumping beam are demonstrated.

articleTitle: X-ray diffraction with sub-picosecond time resolution
abstract: Considerable efforts are currently being made to develop new schemes for the generation of ultrashort X-ray pulses, in particular pulses of sufficiently short wavelength to enable resolution of the atomic structure of matter. With such pulses at our disposal we can perform measurements with sufficiently high temporal and spatial resolution to record ultrafast changes in the atomic configuration and measure transient structures.

articleTitle: Thermal profiling of gain saturation in semiconductor optical amplifiers
abstract: Using thermal profiling of semiconductor optical amplifier we measure the location of gain saturation in the device. This method is used to determine the light intensity and gain in the SOA using only surface measurements.

articleTitle: GDD-matched sum-frequency generation for the indirect phase control of sub-20-fs pulses in the deep ultraviolet region
abstract: We have demonstrated a novel scheme of sum-frequency generation with a sufficiently broad spectrum to be transformed to a sub-20-fs pulse in the deep ultraviolet region (~256 nm) by achieving the group-delay-dispersion matching condition

articleTitle: Highly sensitive frequency-resolved optical gating based on third-harmonic generation in organic films
abstract: We report on the diagnostic of ultra-fast pulses by frequency-resolved optical gating (FROG) based on strong third harmonic-generation (THG) in organic films. The high THG intensity allows for the characterization of pulses emitting at telecommunication wavelengths using a low cost portable fiber spectrometer.

articleTitle: Measurement of picosecond transverse mode dynamics in data communication VCSELs beyond 10 Gbit/sec
abstract: We have measured the individual transverse mode dynamics of high speed vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers (VCSELs). A newly developed experimental technique has enabled picosecond-resolved measurements under modulation conditions comparable to typical Gbit/sec optical communication applications.

articleTitle: High order Bragg grating microfluidic dye laser
abstract: We demonstrate a single mode distributed feedback liquid dye laser, based on a short 133 'rd order Bragg grating defined in a single polymer layer between two glass substrates.

articleTitle: Flexible tunable dispersion compensator based on chirped fiber Bragg gratings without a central wavelength shift
abstract: A flexible tunable dispersion compensator based on chirped fiber Bragg gratings without the central wavelength shift will be proposed. The linear group delay in the range from -1406.0 ps/nm to -495.5 ps/nm can be controlled.

articleTitle: Investigation of active mode-locking of a DBR-diode laser in an external resonator
abstract: We report on an actively mode-locked DBR-diode laser oscillator emitting nearly transform-limited picosecond pulses with several milliwatts of average power. Amplification and frequency doubling of the mode-locked pulses generate 420 mW of blue 460 nm radiation.

articleTitle: Tunable optical filtering with an intracavity Bragg grating associated to a standard grating
abstract: We propose a new tunable wavelength filtering technique combining the dispersion of standard gratings and the angular selectivity of intracavity period tunable Bragg gratings. A liquid crystal device is used to test the filter selectivity.

articleTitle: Apodizable integrated filters based on holographic Bragg reflectors
abstract: A dual-channel integrated multiplexer exhibiting flat-top 4-nm-wide passbands is demonstrated. The device is based on holographic Bragg reflectors (HBRs). Measured and designed device performance are in excellent agreement.

articleTitle: High bandwidth, low latency, burst-mode optical interconnect for high performance computing systems
abstract: High performance computing systems (HPCS) require increased memory access bandwidth and reduced latency to solve difficult computing problems. High speed optical burst switched interconnection technologies are being developed which promise increased bandwidth and scalability, lower power and lower cost than conventional electrically mediated interconnection in scaled systems. This paper addresses the context of development for these platforms and highlights recent developments.

articleTitle: A dispersion law for virtually-imaged phased-array spectral dispersers based on paraxial-wave theory
abstract: We derive the spectral dispersion law for the virtually-imaged phased-array (VIPA) based on paraxial wave theory using Fresnel diffraction analysis. The validity of the dispersion law is verified by comparison with experiments.

articleTitle: Fiber optical devices using a gigantic Faraday rotation in nanometric region
abstract: We demonstrate a novel fiber device using a gigantic Faraday rotation in sharpened optical fiber. The rotation angle of this reaches as much as 105 degrees in spite of the sub-wavelength size of the device.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal structures with large densities of states
abstract: Our work on photonic crystal structures exhibiting large densities of optical states, including high-quality nanocavities and two-dimensional coupled nanocavity arrays, is presented. Applications ranging from nanoscale and nonlinear optics to quantum information processing are discussed.

articleTitle: Ultrabroadband chirped pulse optical parametric amplification of 12 fs pulses from a Ti:sapphire oscillator
abstract: First experimental results from ultrabroadband chirped-pulse optical parametric amplification of 1.7 nJ, 12-fs pulses show amplified flat spectra (160 nm) with energies of 50 alphaJ, leading to preliminarily compressed pulses of 28 fs duration

articleTitle: Space-time dynamics of ultrashort light pulses in water
abstract: We monitor the space-time transformation of 150-fs pulse, which undergoes self-focusing and filamentation in water, by means of the nonlinear gating technique and provide full characterization of the resultant wave packet.

articleTitle: Precise stabilization of a femtosecond laser comb to a high finesse, passive optical cavity
abstract: We report on direct stabilization of a femtosecond comb to a stable optical cavity with an analysis of various stabilization schemes. An absolute fractional frequency instability of <7 /spl times/ 10/sup -14/ at 1 second is measured.

articleTitle: All-optical XOR gate based on Kerr effect in single highly-nonlinear fiber
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical XOR gate based on Kerr effect in a single highly-nonlinear fiber. We obtain a 25 dB extinction ratio using 2-km of highly-nonlinear fiber with a nonlinear coefficient of 9.1 W/sup -1/km/sup -1/.

articleTitle: Fused silica hollow-core photonic crystal fiber for mid-infrared transmission
Quantum-noise protected data encryption for WDM networks
abstract: We demonstrate quantum-noise protected data encryption over a 2OOkm optically amplified WDM fiber line at 650Mbps rate using off-the-shelf components. This demonstration paves the way for widespread deployment of quantum cryptography in WDM networks.

articleTitle: Broadband multichannel polarization-insensitive dual-pump PPMGLN wavelength converter
abstract: Based on cascaded sum frequency generation and difference frequency generation, a novel broadband multichannel polarization-insensitive wavelength converter is demonstrated in a periodically poled MgO:LiNbO/sub 3/ (PPMGLN) waveguide and with two pump wavelengths advantageously located out of signal band.

articleTitle: Linewidth enhancement factor of a type-II quantum-cascade laser
abstract: We directly measured the optical gain, refractive index change, and the linewidth enhancement factor of a type-II quantum-cascade laser. We obtained very low linewidth enhancement factor of 0.83 near threshold.

articleTitle: Characterization and modeling of dynamic phase response of EDFAs
abstract: For the first time at our knowledge, we present an experimental characterization and fine modeling of dynamic phase behavior of an erbium doped fiber amplifier (EDFA).

articleTitle: Multicolor lattice solitons
abstract: We report on the existence of multicolor solitons supported by periodic lattices made of quadratic nonlinear media. Such solitons exhibit a wealth of new features in comparison with discrete solitons and solitons in uniform media.

articleTitle: Non-destructive inspection techniques for illicit drugs using terahertz imaging
abstract: We have developed a novel basic technology for terahertz imaging; which allows detection and identification of drugs concealed in envelopes, by introducing the component spatial pattern analysis. The spatial distributions of the targets are obtained from terahertz multispectral transillumination images, using absorption spectra measured with a tunable terahertz-wave source. The samples we used were methamphetamine and MDMA, two of the most widely consumed illegal drugs in Japan, and aspirin as a reference. The three kinds of samples hidden in mail envelopes were clearly distinguished. Hereby we expect this technology to contribute to the screening letters and packages.

articleTitle: Ytterbium-doped double-clad large-core fiber lasers with kW-level continuous-wave output power
abstract: We report highly efficient cladding-pumped ytterbium-doped fiber lasers in various configurations, generating up to 1 kW of continuous-wave output power at 1.1 /spl mu/m with an 80% slope efficiency and a good beam quality.

articleTitle: Selective detection of labeled DNA using an air-clad photonic crystal fiber
abstract: Demonstration of selective detection of fluorophore labeled DNA by hybridization inside the air holes of a photonic crystal fiber A laser exposes the fiber from the side and the emitted fluorescence tunnels into the core

articleTitle: Novel design of low-jitter 10 GHz all-active monolithic mode-locked lasers
abstract: Using a novel design, we have fabricated 10 GHz all-active monolithic mode-locked semiconductor lasers that generate 1.4 ps pulses with record-low timing jitter. The dynamical properties of lasers with 1 and 2 QWs are compared.

articleTitle: 250 W, single-mode, CW, linearly-polarized fibre source in Yb wavelength range
abstract: 250 W single-mode CW generation is demonstrated around 1076 nm in Yb-doped fibre in linear-polarization format with extinction ratio >23 dB and M/sup 2/ < 1.04. Stimulated Raman scattering is found to be the major effect limiting the output power.

articleTitle: Wideband collimator using hybrid polymer-fiber lens
abstract: We report a novel fiber-collimator using expanded coreless silica fiber, and self assembled polymer lens. It provides a working distance over 6 mm, wide wavelength band of operation, and a stable spot size over 50 micron.

articleTitle: SBS remote and spatially-resolved monitoring of the state of polarization in optical fibers
abstract: A new technique is demonstrated that allows remote monitoring of the distributed state of polarization along a fiber. The technique is based on the stimulated Brillouin Scattering of a pulsed pump and a cw probe

articleTitle: Fabrication of InGaAs quantum dots by metal organic chemical vapor deposition and selective area epitaxy
abstract: We have demonstrated the fabrication of uniform arrays of quantum dots by metal organic chemical vapor deposition using electron beam lithography and selective area epitaxy techniques. Photoluminescence data showing emission at 1250 nm is presented.

articleTitle: Characterization of a three-dimensional photonic crystal with point defects at near-infrared wavelengths
abstract: A 3D photonic band gap was verified with FTIR microscopy at near-infrared wavelengths for a recently fabricated 3D photonic crystal. For the first time, point-defect states in a 3D photonic crystal were experimentally observed

articleTitle: Rainbow volume holographic imaging
Direct characterization of phase-encoded channels
abstract: We present the first temporal characterization diagnostic that measures statistical information on both the intensity and phase of data-encoded channels. Application to the characterization of differential-phase shift keyed signals is presented.

articleTitle: "Noncontact" pumping of semiconductor nanocrystals via nonradiative energy transfer from a proximal quantum well
abstract: We demonstrate a novel, nanocrystal (NC)-based LED, in which the emission color is tuned by varying the NC size. The NCs are pumped "noncontactly" via nonradiative energy transfer from a proximal quantum well.

articleTitle: The role of spherical aberration on THz pulse propagation
abstract: Spatio-temporally resolved terahertz pulses elucidate the effect of spherical aberration and surface waves on far field THz beam profiles. The observed "swallowtail" pulse shape is predicted by catastrophe theory and occurs in a wide range of ultrafast transmissive THz optical systems.

articleTitle: High performance 2.4 /spl mu/m GaInAsSb/AlGaAsSb laser diodes
abstract: Strained triple-quantum-well (TQW) GaInAsSb/AlGaAsSb laser diodes were fabricated. Internal losses as low as 4 cm/sup -1/ and threshold current density per quantum well as low as 34 A/cm/sup 2/ for a 3 mm long-cavity were obtained.

articleTitle: Direct synthesis of germanium sulphide glass planar waveguides by chemical vapour deposition (CVD)
abstract: Germanium sulphide glass has been deposited on CaF/sub 2/ and Schott N-PSK58 glass substrates directly by chemical vapour deposition (CVD). The CVD process has shown the high potential for germanium sulphide glass planar waveguides fabrication.

articleTitle: A novel organic waveguided dye laser including an active random scattering layer
abstract: We present a novel organic waveguided laser based on an active random scattering medium. The slope efficiency of 8.9% and lasing threshold of 0.2 /spl mu/J were obtained, respectively.

articleTitle: Coherent optical code-division multiple access with dynamic encoder and decoder
abstract: A new implementation of spectral coherent code-division multiple access is proposed, offering dynamic encoding/decoding capabilities through a wavelength-to-time mapping by dispersion of a short pulse. Experimental results are shown, including a two-channel eye-diagram measurement

articleTitle: Laser fabricated waveguides in various materials
abstract: Waveguiding devices are fabricated in various optical materials, including oxide glasses, chalcogenide glasses and polymers. Their optical properties are characterized, and the photo-induced structural modifications are inferred from Raman spectroscopy data.

articleTitle: Observation of optical refrigeration in Tm/sup 3+/:BaY/sub 2/F/sub 8/
abstract: We report the first experimental demonstration of laser cooling with thulium-doped BaY/sub 2/F/sub 8/. Cooling by /spl sim/1.5 K below ambient temperature is obtained at /spl lambda/ = 1.902 /spl mu/m in a single pass geometry.

articleTitle: Generation of 465 nm light by frequency doubling of a diode laser in two passively coupled ring resonators
abstract: A potassium-niobate-crystal inside a high finesse ring resonator generates the second harmonic of infrared light from a low finesse ring resonator driven by a broad area diode. They modelock by design without active control.

articleTitle: Waveguide inscription in YAG:Cr /sup 4+/ crystals by femtosecond laser irradiation
abstract: We have observed a positive change of refractive index and formation of waveguides in YAG:Cr/sup 4+/ crystals, exposed to a high-intensity femtosecond laser beam. The technique is potentially suitable for fabrication of waveguide lasers in crystal materials.

articleTitle: Quantum cascade external cavity laser systems in the mid-infrared spectral range
abstract: Quantum cascade laser (QCL) are an excellent tool for MIR-spectroscopy. We report on the design and realization of antireflection coated pulsed and cw-QCL in external cavity (EC) configurations and investigate their performance.

articleTitle: Avalanche EIT laser
abstract: Avalanche upconversion lasers can exhibit new gain features, from combined avalanche dynamics and electromagnetically-induced transparency (EIT), that are expected to make room temperature operation of avalanche upconversion lasers possible in bulk crystals.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of the optical buffers based on coupled resonators lines and on media with electromagnetically induced transparency
abstract: Performance of the optical buffers based on slow wave propagation in coupled resonator lines and the media with EIT is shown to differ in the presence of higher order dispersion.

articleTitle: Optically pumped liquid oxygen jet waveguides for production of singlet delta oxygen
abstract: Thin, flat, stable liquid oxygen jets have been created for use as optical indexed planar waveguides. These waveguides are pumped at 1067 nm with 100 W Yb fiber lasers producing number densities /spl sim/6.5/spl times/10/sup 20/#/cm/sup 3/ for /spl sim/75 MW/cm/sup 2/ pump intensities.

articleTitle: Enhancement and cutoff up-shift in photoemission from He/sup +/ by simultaneous irradiation of laser and soft X-ray pulses
abstract: We numerically show that high-order harmonic emission from He/sup +/ is enhanced by 17 orders of magnitude and that the cutoff is shifted to higher energy by the addition of an intense soft X-ray pulse.

articleTitle: Investigation of temperature distribution and phase distortion in high-power diode edge-pumped microchip composite Yb:YAG laser
abstract: Temperature distribution modelling and measurement are reported for 400-/spl mu/m thick Yb:YAG/YAG composite structure with 2/spl times/2-mm/sup 2/ core area, 10-at.% Yb:YAG. Small focus shift and low astigmatism is demonstrated while absorbed power is in hundreds watts range.

articleTitle: Reach extension in 10-Gb/s directly modulated systems using narrow-band partial optical filtering
abstract: We investigate the impact of narrow-band partial optical filtering at the transmitter or receiver in 10-Gb/s directly modulated systems and double the reach from <25-km to >45-km without dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Intraband dynamics of excitonic wave packets in a biased superlattice tested by THz emission
abstract: We find that the intraband dynamics of Bloch oscillations can only be understood in a complete excitonic picture. The results of THz emission experiments are modelled well by theory employing a full excitonic basis.

articleTitle: Up or down chirping - a recipe to generate sub-200 fs pulses from a dispersion-managed semiconductor laser
abstract: SHG-FROG measurements revealed 185 fs pulses generated by linear down chirping in a dispersion-managed semiconductor mode-locked laser. Compared to up chirping, temporal and spectral semiconductor gain dynamics broaden a mode-locked spectrum for down-chirped pulses.

articleTitle: Observation of efficient THz generation with a tuning range of 84-1134 /spl mu/m based on quasi-phase-matched difference-frequency generation in a cubic crystal
abstract: We have efficiently generated THz waves continuously tunable in the range of 84-1134 /spl mu/m in a cubic crystal, GaP, based on collinear quasi-phase-matched difference-frequency generation. The highest peak power is 15.6 W at 173 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Optical transmission of frequency standards using mode-locked lasers
abstract: We report on distribution of highly-stable microwave and optical frequency standards across optical fiber networks using mode-locked lasers. Ultrafast technology has been found to improve transmission instability penalties by at least one order of magnitude

articleTitle: Elimination of thermally induced modal distortions in Faraday isolators for high power laser systems
abstract: Two methods of eliminating thermal lensing in Faraday isolators are theoretically and experimentally investigated: use of an ordinary negative lens and use of a compensating glass element with negative induced thermal lensing.

articleTitle: Generation of 36-femtosecond pulses from a ytterbium fiber laser
abstract: By optimizing the cavity dispersion map, 1.5-nJ, 36-fs pulses are obtained from a Yb-doped fiber laser. Higher-order dispersion currently limits the pulse duration.

articleTitle: Super-wideband amplified spontaneous emission generated by double-clad Cr/sup 4+/:YAG crystal fiber
abstract: Double-clad Cr/sup 4+/:YAG crystal fiber is demonstrated by a co-drawing laser-heated pedestal growth method. Up to 913 /spl mu/m of super-wideband amplified spontaneous emission was generated at the optical fiber communication band with a 3-dB bandwidth of 265 nm.

articleTitle: Laser induced organisation and size control of nano-scale etch-resistant features in lithium niobate single crystals
abstract: We report pulsed UV laser-induced organisation of etch-resistant features on the -z face of lithium niobate single crystals, and discuss the formation mechanism and future application areas.

articleTitle: The dynamics of normal dispersion regime scalar modulation instability in photonic crystal fiber
abstract: The temporal dynamics associated with scalar modulation instability experiment in the normal dispersion regime have been investigated. Experiment and simulation demonstrate a significant suppression of the walk-off of the sideband from the pump.

articleTitle: Ultrabroadband dispersive amplification of laser and hollow fiber pulses
abstract: Broadband amplification without gain-narrowing is demonstrated with 12-fs oscillator pulses and with ultrabroadband hollow fiber spectra (650-900 nm). This scheme shows excellent capabilities for spectral shaping of few-cycle pulses important for coherent control and attosecond science.

articleTitle: Broadband THz-radiation emitter using laser-irradiated n-type InAs under magnetic field
abstract: Broadband THz-radiation emitter using n-type InAs is demonstrated. The high-frequency component of THz-radiation spectrum originating from the hybrid modes of the plasmons and the LO phonons is found to be enhanced by external magnetic field.

articleTitle: New horizons in ultrashort pulse generation from fiber-based sources
abstract: Novel all-fibre-based, short-pulse sources are described using resonator geometries or single-pass plus nonlinear shaping for pulse-length and wavelength versatility with holey fibres for dispersion compensation. Air-cored PCF's allow the realization of all-fibre chirp pulse amplifiers.

articleTitle: High-power end-pumped composite ceramic Nd:YAG laser
abstract: We present a high power ceramic Nd:YAG laser with an output power up to 110 W longitudinally pumped with 232 W from fiber-coupled laser diodes and measurements on the thermal lensing of the composite ceramic Nd:YAG rod.

articleTitle: Growth of diamond-like films at room temperature on Si and III-V materials
abstract: A new method to grow diamond-like films was used on Si and in III-V optoelectronic components. Room temperature deposition of amorphous-like films with refractive index of 2.24 was done on and around AlGaAsSb waveguides.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal microcavity lasers
abstract: By using photonic crystal cavity designs, we have defined ultra-small lasers for optical switching and spectroscopy. Here we describe the design, fabrication, and characterization of these nanocavity lasers.

articleTitle: Optimization of the photorefractive response of lithium niobate crystals
abstract: Optimization of saturation refractive-index changes, of recording sensitivities, and of the lifetimes of holograms in photorefractive lithium-niobate crystals by suitable doping, annealing, and by application of extremely large external electrical fields will be reported.

articleTitle: Composite optical solitons in self-induced lattices
abstract: We predict novel composite optical solitons consisting of nonlinearly coupled spatially extended (periodic or quasi-periodic) and localized components, and experimentally demonstrate their formation in a photorefractive medium.

articleTitle: Gauss-Laguerre nondispersive and nondiffractive pulsed beams in dispersive media
abstract: A new family of localized spatial-temporal Gauss-Laguerre waves in dispersive media is introduced. Contrary to pulsed Bessel beams and envelope-X waves, these spatial-temporal beams may exist both in the normal and anomalous dispersion spectral regions.

articleTitle: Ultrafast all-optical switching by pulse-induced birefringence in a multi-quantum well optical amplifier
abstract: We have demonstrated femtosecond pulse-induced nonlinear birefringence in a multi-quantum well semiconductor optical amplifier for all-optical switching. Coherent nonlinear optical effects such as two-photon absorption could be responsible for the ultrashort-transient birefringence.

articleTitle: Generation of a broadband continuum with high spectral coherence in tapered single-mode optical fibers
abstract: A significant input wavelength dependent variation of the supercontinuum mutual spectral coherence is observed for the first time using the delayed pulse method, and conditions for generating a highly coherent and broadband supercontinuum are established.

articleTitle: Direct F/sub 2/ laser fabrication of Y-junction waveguides in flame hydrolysis deposited germanium-doped silica
abstract: Planar waveguides and Y-junctions designed for single mode operation at 632.8 nm were fabricated in flame hydrolysis deposition (FHD) germanium-doped silica through contact-mask exposure with 157-nm F/sub 2/ laser nanosecond-pulse irradiation.

articleTitle: XPM-induced control signal degradation for DOP and RF-power-based PMD monitors in WDM systems
