abstract: We statistically investigate and compare the effect of XPM on two monitoring control signals, DOP and half bit rate frequency component power, for NRZ and RZ signals in a 10 Gb/s WDM system.

articleTitle: Modification of internal stress distribution in low-PMD spun fibers, evaluated by photoelastic tomography
abstract: By means of photoelastic tomography the effect of the spinning process on the development of residual stress in spun fibers is investigated. Measured stress distributions in spun and corresponding unspun fibers are compared

articleTitle: Passive all-optical phase-locking of two independently tunable femtosecond Ti:sapphire lasers
abstract: One shared frequency comb is established between two synchronized femtosecond Ti:sapphire lasers. The locking of the carrier-envelope offset phase relies on cross phase modulation in the gain medium and is maintained over minutes without external stabilization

articleTitle: Width-tunable optical pulse generation based on four-wave mixing in highly-nonlinear fiber
abstract: We demonstrate a simple technique for width-tunable pulse generation based on four-wave mixing in highly-nonlinear fiber. By electrically tuning the delay between two pump pulses, the pulse-width of a generated pulse train is continuously tuned.

articleTitle: Arbitrary wave profile generation of a laser using a digital micromirror device
abstract: A digital micromirror device (DMD) is a microelectromechanical structure (MEMS) device with many micromirrors on the top surface; it is used as a spatial light modulator for many applications, including lithography, projection, telecommunications, and lasers. We determined the limiting resolution of a DMD by measuring the modulation transfer function (MTF) of a DMD and intersecting with the aerial image modulation (AIM) at 351 -nm wavelength. The limiting resolution was 14.61 cycles/mm. We generated the laser-beam profile by changing the pattern of micromirrors in the DMD. The input beam from center peaked profile transformed into a flattop super-Gaussian profile with order 6.

articleTitle: Advanced optical performance monitoring of differential phase-shift keyed signal using RF spectrum analysis
abstract: The properties of the RF spectrum allow dispersion-independent monitoring of the incoherent noise and bias drift of the data modulator in differential phase-shifted keyed (DPSK) systems, which are demonstrated at 10 Gb/s using low-speed electronics.

articleTitle: Liquid crystal displays backlit with LEDs
abstract: Recent LED technology makes all-solid-state illumination of flat panel liquid crystal display efficiently enough to be comparable to that with fluorescent lamps. Our recent development of liquid crystal displays backlit with LEDs is described

articleTitle: Comb generation of collinear Raman sidebands by three correlated coherent molecular oscillations
abstract: We show that three correlated coherent oscillations, driven adiabatically in a molecule, modulate single frequency laser radiations and generate a comb of collinear sidebands densely in an ultrabroad spectral region from ultraviolet to infrared.

articleTitle: Quantum cascade Raman injection laser
Type-II "W" mid-infrared lasers: Improved growth and device performance
abstract: Improvements in type-II "W" midwave-infrared lasers have led to an internal loss of <3 cm/sup -1/, a Shockley-Read lifetime of >20 ns at 78 K, and photonic-crystal distributed-feedback devices with etendue within 8/spl times/DL for 600-/spl mu/m-wide stripes.

articleTitle: Specialty fibers for 160, 320 and 640 Gb/s signal processing
abstract: Specialty highly non-linear fibers are experimentally characterized as signal processing components in ultra high-speed OTDM systems. Pulse compression to 359 fs and demultiplexing of 160, 320 and 640 Gb/s signals are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Widely tunable Ce/sup 3+/-Er/sup 3+/--ZBLAN fiber laser under 975-nm pumping
abstract: A widely tunable Ce/sup 3+/-/sup Er3+/-ZBLAN fiber laser with 975-nm pumping is demonstrated. Tunable range between 1495 and 1605 nm is attained, which can be expanded further by optimizing wavelength-dependent reflectivity of the cavity mirror.

articleTitle: Oversampled photonic A/D converters using self-electro-optic effect devices
abstract: We investigated photonic pulse code modulation (PCM) and sigma-delta A/Ds, which utilise optoelectronic comparators. PCM was demonstrated by simulation and experiment. Extending the simulation to a sigma-delta architecture yielded a peak SNR of 50 dB.

articleTitle: Resonant-phonon terahertz quantum cascade lasers at long wavelengths
abstract: We report a resonant-phonon terahertz quantum cascade laser at a wavelength of /spl lambda/ /spl ap/ 141 /spl mu/m (2.1 THz) that uses a low-loss, high-confinement metal-metal waveguide. Continuous wave operation is obtained up to 40 K.

articleTitle: High-Q buried heterostructure microring resonators
abstract: All-buried InP/InGaAsP microring resonators laterally coupled to bus waveguides are demonstrated. Very low optical losses of 0.4 cm/sup -1/ and coupling-limited quality factors of 10/sup 5/ or greater are observed from 200-/spl mu/m-radii microring resonators.

articleTitle: Quantum cascade laser spectrometer for trace-gas detection of exhaled carbonyl sulfide
abstract: Simultaneous concentration measurements of exhaled carbonyl sulfide and carbon dioxide were demonstrated using a pulsed quantum cascade laser based gas sensor. This sensor has potential applications in biomedical diagnostics such as in lung transplant rejection.

articleTitle: Electron capture time in InGaN/GaN multiple quantum wells
abstract: We have used femtosecond spectroscopy to determine the electron capture times of blue-emitting InGaN/GaN quantum well laser structures. We confirm theoretical predications that the capture time depends on both the temperature and carrier density.

articleTitle: Optimized design of highly nonlinear dispersion-shifted fiber for optical parametric amplifier
abstract: Fiber requirements for raising the gain and broadening the gain bandwidth of OPA were investigated. We optimized the fiber design considering high nonlinearity, low dispersion slope, zero dispersion wavelength, and low bending loss.

articleTitle: Electrical beam steering of quantum cascade lasers
abstract: We present the realization of a quantum cascade laser with tapered waveguide and patterned contacts that allow to control the emission profile by modifying the electrical excitation in different sections of the device.

articleTitle: Near field observation of a refractive index grating and a topographical grating by an optically-trapped gold particle
abstract: A refractive index grating fabricated on a planar light waveguide circuit (PLC) and an optical disk tracking groove profile are observed by scanning an optically-trapped 100-nm diameter gold particle.

articleTitle: A compact, all-solid-state, 50 mW Nd/sup 3+/:KGd(WO/sub 4/)/sub 2/ yellow-orange laser
abstract: A compact, efficient, all-solid-state yellow-orange laser based on a transversely diode-pumped self-stimulating Nd/sup 3+/:KGd(WO/sub 4/)/sub 2/ Raman laser is demonstrated. A 590 nm yellow-orange output of 50 mW was obtained.

articleTitle: All-optical signal regeneration with wavelength multicasting using an electroabsorption modulator
abstract: All-optical signal regeneration has been demonstrated with wavelength multicasting at 6/spl times/10 Gb/s using a single electroabsorption modulator. The output extinction-ratio, the linewidth and the pulse shape are improved and a negative power penalty is obtained.

articleTitle: Ultra-low noise, ultra-stable-power cyan laser
abstract: We describe the performance of a next generation solid-state cyan (488 /spl mu/m) laser. We demonstrate the low noise and high power stability that result from its directly doubled external cavity design.

articleTitle: Generation of XUV supercontinuum and single pulses by half-cycle polarization gating
abstract: Ultrafast ellipticity dependent pulses were created by polarization shaping of few-cycle pulses with birefringence optics. When the pulses were used for high harmonic generation, a supercontinuum spectrum extending 25-45 nm was produced in the plateau and cutoff region that corresponds to single attosecond pulses.

articleTitle: In suture-less bonded single crystal and ceramic composite lasers
abstract: We have developed successfully most advanced composite laser media which perfectly bonded both single crystal and polycrystalline ceramics. The bonding interfaces between single crystal and ceramics become almost "suture-less" or "seam-less" conditions.

articleTitle: Experimental characterization of dispersion maps with Raman gain in 160 Gb/s transmission systems
abstract: We investigate the combined effects of dispersion compensation and Raman amplification in SMF-based transmission span of 160 Gb/s system. The post compensation map shows better power tolerance.

articleTitle: Photon avalanche pumped solid state lasers
abstract: The general characteristics of the photon avalanche process, its description and modeling by rate equation systems and an overview of photon avalanche pumped solid state lasers will be presented.

articleTitle: Terahertz spectroscopy of single crystal HMX
abstract: We present the results of terahertz spectroscopic studies on single crystals of the energetic material HMX at various temperatures and crystal orientations. Distinct intermolecular vibrational modes are observed in the range from 55-75 cm/sup -1/.

articleTitle: Mid-IR continuous-wave fiber-laser-pumped optical parametric oscillators
abstract: We review recent developments in continuous-wave mid-infrared optical parametric oscillators pumped by fiber lasers. Such devices are potentially valuable spectroscopic sources providing high output powers and rapid, wide-range tuning in the mid-infrared molecular fingerprint region.

articleTitle: Coherent control for femtosecond switching of vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers
abstract: We demonstrate the use of interference to switch the emission of microcavity lasers on a pulse-width limited, femtosecond time scale. The use of optical gain counteracts dephasing.

articleTitle: Pulse-front tilt caused by spatial and temporal chirp
abstract: Pulse-front tilt in ultrashort laser pulses is usually considered equivalent to angular dispersion. We prove, however, that the combination of spatial and temporal chirp also produces pulse-front tilt. We verify this experimentally using a GRENOUILLE.

articleTitle: Tuning of transmission characteristics with double layer metallic photonic crystals in the sub-THz region
abstract: We demonstrated the tunability of transmission characteristics of double-layer metallic photonic crystals. One transmission peak is split into two peaks with increasing the lateral displacement. Such phenomenon is attributed to the coupling of two surface-plasmon-polaritons.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional discrete diffraction in silica waveguide arrays
abstract: The investigation of light propagation in cubic lattices of coupled fused silica waveguides reveals ideal discrete diffraction and demonstrates the excellent quality of the waveguide arrays, which have been manufactured using fs-laser-induced refractive index modifications.

articleTitle: 50-W peak power AlGaAs/InGaAs/GaAs single quantum-well 990-nm diode lasers
abstract: 50 W peak-power was demonstrated from 2-mm-long, 100-/spl mu/m-aperture AlGaAs/InGaAs/GaAs single-quantum-well lasers driven with 40-ns, 80-A current pulses. Grown by organo-metallic vapor-phase epitaxy, the lasers have internal losses of 1.5 cm/sup -1/ and internal efficiencies of 0.90.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked Yb/sup 3+/-doped ceramic lasers
abstract: Femtosecond Yb/sup 3+/-doped disordered Y/sub 3/Al/sub 5/O/sub 12//Y/sub 3/Sc/sub 2/Al/sub 3/O/sub 12/ (Yb:Y/sub 3/ScAl/sub 4/O/sub 12/) ceramic laser is reported. Up to 72% slope efficiency for input power was obtained under cw operation. We achieved pulses as short as 580 fs with 25 mW output power.

articleTitle: Powerful RGB laser source for projection displays based on a passively mode-locked thin disk laser
abstract: We demonstrate a multi-watt RGB laser source, using a frequency doublet, a two-stage parametric generator, and two sum frequency mixers. We do not require any synchronously pumped parametric oscillator or a laser amplifier.

articleTitle: Adaptive pulse compression for photonic crystal fiber by direct feedback of spectral phase
abstract: A computer-controlled feedback system that combined modified-SPIDER and a 4-f active chirp compensator enabled us to compress photonic-crystal-fiber output pulses to 6.8 fs. Furthermore, the compressed-pulse profile showed the excellent agreement with fringe-resolved autocorrelation measurement.

articleTitle: Control of transient refractive index and laser propagation in a nanoplasma gas with a prepulse
abstract: Prepulse controlled laser beam propagation is demonstrated by utilizing transient refractive index in expanding-nanoplasma gases. The correlation between macroscopic refractive index and microscopic polarizability is verified, supporting the one-dimensional self-consistent hydrodynamic nanoplasma model.

articleTitle: All-optical switching of 160 Gbit/s OTDM signal using FWM in SOA for wavelength routing
abstract: All-optical switching and wide-range wavelength conversion was demonstrated at 160 Gbit/s using four-wave mixing in an SOA. The cross-correlation measurements using short reference pulse show the high-speed switching capability for wavelength routing in OTDM networks.

articleTitle: Carrier envelope phase locking of an in-line, low-noise Er fiber system
abstract: Carrier envelope phase locking of a frequency comb based on an in-line low-noise Er fiber system is demonstrated. The repetition rate and the carrier envelope offset frequency are locked by two phase locked loops over several hours.

articleTitle: Employing double external light injection techniques in radio-on-fiber transport systems
abstract: A radio-on-fiber (ROF) transport system employing double external light injection techniques to improve systems' performance is proposed and demonstrated. Simultaneously using external light injection techniques to enhance the frequency response of laser diode and increase the saturation output power of semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA), resulting in decreased third order intermodulation distortion (IMD/sub 3/) and SOA gain-saturation-induced distortion.

articleTitle: Rotation of microscopic isotropic particles by transfer of spin angular momentum of light
abstract: We show that contrary to general belief, spin angular momentum of light can also be transferred to transparent and non-birefringent objects. This should facilitate wider use of this approach for optically driven micromachine components.

articleTitle: Tunable silicon Fabry-Perot microcavity
abstract: We demonstrate a 20-/spl mu/m-long tunable optical Fabry-Perot resonator integrated on a silicon-on-insulator waveguide. The device is electrically driven and shows a modulation depth as high as 53% for a power consumption of only 20 mW.

articleTitle: Pulsed quantum cascade lasers for intra-pulse spectroscopy of pollutants such as tobacco bye-products
abstract: The use of an intra-pulse spectrometer to detect atmospheric pollutants at wavelengths of 8 and 10 /spl mu/m is discussed. We will outline the potential of the system with reference to tobacco smoke and upper atmosphere indicators such as methane.

articleTitle: Whispering gallery modes disclosed by a fs-wavepacket in a spiral-shaped microcavity
abstract: Ballistic trajectories of a femtosecond-wavepacket along whispering gallery modes (WGM) of a spiral-shaped PMMA-DCM microcavity are demonstrated by pump-probe spectroscopy. The pulse scattering on the spiral notch does not prevent its partial recoupling in WGM.

articleTitle: General design rules for multi-pass cavity lasers in ultrashort pulse generation
abstract: We present a general analysis of q-preserving multi-pass cavities (MPC) which can be used in the construction of high-energy and compact ultrashort pulse sources. The application of MPC designs to femtosecond Ti/sup 3+/:Al/sub 2/O/sub 3/ lasers is described.

articleTitle: High precision laser micromachining depths by pulsed ultraviolet and mid-UV Nd:YAG laser of sapphire and silicon for microfluidic applications
abstract: We explore the use of near-UV and mid-UV Nd:YAG laser for rapid micromachining for microfluidic applications. The laser ablation depths and precision on sapphire and silicon have been discussed.

articleTitle: Hollow optical fiber core mode blocker for acousto-optic tunable bandpass filter
abstract: We have demonstrated a novel all-fiber acousto-optic tunable bandpass filter using a hollow optical fiber segment as a core mode blocker. The device showed a wide tuning range in S, C band with a 3 dB-bandwidth of 3.2 nm.

articleTitle: Temporal and spectral characteristics of a femtosecond laser pulse interacted with a Raman active medium
abstract: We observed self-narrowing and reshaping of a femtosecond pulse accompanied by development of rotational Raman emissions of hydrogen. This fact implies the generation of, coherently phased spectral components based on four-wave Raman mixing.

articleTitle: Analysis of phase locking in diffraction-coupled arrays of semiconductor lasers with gain/index coupling
abstract: We developed an analytical model of the phase-locking mechanism for a diffraction-coupled array of semiconductor lasers. While the phase-locking range is found to be limited by nonuniformities between the individual lasers, this range can be expanded by increasing the gain-index coupling. Extensive computer simulations confirm these predictions.

articleTitle: 8 dB increase of the SBS threshold in an optical fiber by applying a stair ramp strain distribution
abstract: We study the increase of the SBS threshold in an optical fiber by applying different tensile strain distributions. We show a maximum increase of 8 dB using a stair ramp strain distribution.

articleTitle: Depth resolved fluorescence measurement in a turbid medium by polarized fluorescence spectroscopy
abstract: We show that when a layered turbid medium is excited by linearly polarized light, measurement of angle resolved polarized fluorescence spectrum can provide depth resolved fluorescence measurements.

articleTitle: Novel wideband active waveguide photonic crystal polarisation selector
abstract: We have designed and fabricated a broadband and compact polarisation selector using a photonic crystal at the junction of two intersecting active waveguides. The crystal shows >8 dB polarisation selectivity over a 70 nm range

articleTitle: Temporal self-compression of intense femtosecond pulses in argon-filled waveguides
Low threshold, highly efficient phase conjugation using optical coherent transients
abstract: We discuss and demonstrate two approaches to achieving low threshold, highly efficient phase conjugation using optical coherent transients in rare-earth ion doped crystals. One approach utilizes coherent media inversion and the other utilizes integration gain.

articleTitle: A spliced and connectorized highly nonlinear and anomalously dispersive bismuth-oxide glass holey fiber
abstract: We demonstrate the operation of a small core, connectorized bismuth-oxide glass holey fiber The splicing losses achieved were close to the theoretical limit.

articleTitle: Experimental implementation of optical clockwork without carrier-envelope phase control
abstract: We demonstrate an optical clockwork without camer-envelope phase control using sum-frequency generation between a CW optical parametric oscillator at 3.39 μm and a modelocked Tisapphire laser with dominant spectral peaks at 834 and 670 nm.

articleTitle: A novel technique for measurement of refractive indexes and thermo-optic coefficients
abstract: We present a novel technique using beam width to evaluate refractive index and thermo-optic coefficient of a liquid or gel material filled in the trench of a micro-double-lens. Routine refractive index measurement precision exceeds 1/spl times/10/sup -4/.

articleTitle: Rapid scanning all-reflective optical delay line
abstract: We describe a dispersion-free high-speed scanning optical delay line, which is based on one curved and two flat reflective mirrors. A total scanning depth of 1.50 mm and a 4.1 kHz repetition rate is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Improved contrast in confocal microscopy by using a blue frequency doubled diode-pumped solid-state laser
abstract: The standard Ar ion laser in a confocal microscope was replaced with an intra-cavity frequency doubled Nd:YAG laser operating at 473 nm. The fluorescence image quality suggests that excitation at 473 nm could be preferable.

articleTitle: Holographic optical coherence imaging of living tissue
abstract: The high sensitivity and fast update rates of photorefractive quantum well devices enable holographic optical coherence imaging of living tissue, showing evidence for sub-cellular motility in living rat tumors as time-dependent speckle holograms.

articleTitle: Phase-jitter reduction by in-line phase conjugation
abstract: The main impairment of differential-phase-shift-keyed communication systems is phase jitter. Noise-induced phase jitter, which is mediated by self-phase modulation, can be reduced significantly by a small number of in-line phase conjugators.

articleTitle: Phase locking of continuous-wave optical parametric oscillator to an optical frequency comb
abstract: A continuous-wave optical parametric oscillators was phase-locked to an optical frequency comb in the 830 nm region. The optical frequency of the optical parametric oscillator was controlled by changing the cavity length of the pump laser. Its control bandwidth was about 20 kHz.

articleTitle: Applications of microstructured polymer optical fibres
abstract: Microstructured polymer optical fibres have recently been developed, providing new fibre functionalities for a range of applications, including imaging, high-bandwidth transmission, sensing, astronomy, high birefringence and polymer fibre lasers.

articleTitle: Complete characterization of fiber laser pulses using real-time spectral interferometry
abstract: We present a method for complete pulse characterization by frequency-to-time conversion. A demonstration is done with a conventional photodetector and an oscilloscope, measuring time scale stretched pulses of /spl sim/1 ps duration from a mode-locked fiber laser.

articleTitle: Wave propagation and solitons in 2D photonic structures
abstract: We review the recent experimental and theoretical progress made by our group on wave propagation and solitons in nonlinear photonic lattices.

articleTitle: High sensitivity photo-EMF detection using pulsed lasers
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a high-sensitivity vibrometer based on photo-EMF detector and pulsed laser for the detection of ultrasonic induced surface displacements. Comparison between the pulsed and continuous-wave illumination is presented.

articleTitle: High-dynamic-range SPIDER characterization of compressed octave-spanning continuum pulses
abstract: An improved SPIDER apparatus for characterization of pulses with strong spectral amplitude variations is demonstrated with sub-5-fs supercontinuum pulses. This apparatus employs double phase retrieval for an increased dynamic-range.

articleTitle: Period-doubling route to multiple-pulsing in soliton-like fiber lasers
abstract: An analytical model, compatible with large changes per roundtrip, describes soliton mode-locking in fiber lasers. The predicted period-doubling route to multiple-pulsing is confirmed experimentally. The simple model explains the remarkable observation that chaos does not follow period-doubling.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave high-power Nd:YAG-KNbO/sub 3/ blue laser at room temperature
abstract: Continuous-wave power of 418 mW at 473 nm with 6.7% overall optical-to-optical conversion efficiency is obtained through intracavity frequency-doubled with KNbO/sub 3/ at room temperature of a Nd:YAG laser operating on the 946-nm /sup 4/F/sub 3/2//spl rarr//sup 4/I/sub 9/2/ transition.

articleTitle: Variable refractive index elastomeric polymers
abstract: Films comprised of alternating elastomeric and glassy polymer layers with a layer thickness less than one-quarter wavelength of light exhibit a useful pressure dependent refractive index.

articleTitle: Fully coherent light at 13 nm using quasi phase matching in gas-filled modulated waveguides
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of fully spatially coherent EUV light at 13 nm for the first time using high harmonic upconversion. This is a significant improvement over past work.

articleTitle: Yb:YSO diode-pumped single-mode laser at 1003.4 nm
abstract: Single-mode laser emission at 1003.4 nm with an ytterbium-doped crystal (Yb:YSO) is reported for the first time under diode pumping at 978 nm. An average power of 190 mW was obtained.

articleTitle: Excited state absorption in a strongly two-photon absorbing neat organic material
abstract: We characterize the two-photon absorption and photophysics of a neat organic material. We show that the strong nonlinear absorption in the nanosecond regime is due to triplet-triplet absorption, the triplet state pumped by two-photon absorption.

articleTitle: Multiphoton EUV photonics
abstract: We demonstrate high-order quasi-phase-matched conversion of laser light into the water-window region of the spectrum around 300 eV for the first time. We also demonstrate phase matching in a fully ionized gas for the first time

articleTitle: The effect of nitrogen in InGaAsN quantum well lasers
abstract: We compare the gain and radiative efficiency characteristics of an InGaAsN and InGaAs laser structures where the devices are identical except for the nitrogen content and emission wavelength.

articleTitle: VCSEL modulation using an integrated electro-absorption modulator
abstract: We report the epitaxial integration of a resonant electroabsorption modulator (EAM) on top of a standard 850-nm oxide-confined VCSEL. Optimization of the epitaxial structure and high-speed modulation results will be discussed.

articleTitle: The temperature sensitivity of GaAs-based 1.5 /spl mu/m GaInNAsSb lasers
abstract: The temperature behavior of 1.5 mum GaInNAsSb edge-emitting lasers is analyzed through variation of cavity length and temperature. Monomolecular recombination and intervalence band absorption dominate the threshold current, and carrier leakage becomes important at elevated temperatures

articleTitle: Quantitative, in vivo fluorescence measurements with a two-photon fiber probe
abstract: We demonstrate the capability of a two-photon optical fiber fluorescence (TPOFF) probe for quantitative, in vivo fluorescence measurements in mice tumors.

articleTitle: Dynamic behavior of 1.55 /spl mu/m vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser with external light injection
abstract: We demonstrate the nonlinear input-output response of a 1.55 /spl mu/m vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser with an external light injection. Pulse compression was observed with a transient response of below 100 ps, exhibiting a possibility of optical signal processing with low power consumption.

articleTitle: Wavelength conversion and multi-carrier generation using quasi-phase-matched LiNbO/sub 3/ waveguides operating on optical frequency grid
abstract: A novel wavelength conversion and multi-carrier generation scheme operating on optical frequency grid is proposed using quasi-phase-matched LiNbO/sub 3/ waveguides. The operating bandwidth of 20 nm is successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Fourier-domain holographic optical coherence imaging
abstract: We demonstrate the first spatial Fourier-domain holographic (FDH) optical coherence flythroughs of rat tumors and mouse corneas. FDH eliminates scattered background in the holographic reconstruction and improves signal-to-noise over previous image-domain holography of tissue

articleTitle: All-optical packet demultiplexing based on Raman-assisted four-wave mixing in dispersion-shifted fiber
abstract: We demonstrated all-optical packet demultiplexing at 10 Gbits/s based on Raman-assisted four-wave-mixing in dispersion-shifted fiber. Improvement of more than 65 dB in the conversion efficiency and 26 dB in the signal-to-background ratio are obtained.

articleTitle: Splice-less interfacing of conventional fibers to photonic crystal fibers
abstract: Coupling into small-core photonic crystal fibers is not easy, even with bulk optics. By adapting the PCF fabrication technique, low-loss adiabatic transitions between single-mode fibers and small-core PCFs are achieved without splicing.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon enhanced organic light emitting devices
abstract: By adding gold nanoparticles to the emissive layer of an electrophosphorescent light emitting diode, significant increase of the device efficiency has been achieved due to acceleration of emission rates caused by the interaction with surface plasmons.

articleTitle: Enhanced nonlinear optical phase response of an AlGaAs microring resonator
abstract: We have constructed and characterized a 5 micron radius optical microring resonator in AlGaAs. The device displays an enhanced nonlinear phase response at a length scale 100 times smaller than an ordinary AlGaAs waveguide.

articleTitle: Fundamental phase noise on supercontinuum generated in microstructure fiber: limits on frequency metrology
abstract: We present quantitative results for the excess phase noise of a frequency comb that employs microstructure fiber. This fundamental phase noise arises from amplification of the input shot noise during supercontinuum formation in the fiber.

articleTitle: Microscopic imaging of defect density distribution in GaAs and InGaP using the decay time of photo-excited carriers
abstract: Through pump-probe experiment using femtosecond laser pulses, we demonstrated that the defect density distribution in a GaAs and InGaP can be imaged by the decay time of photo-excited carriers.

articleTitle: Laser beam combining: techniques and prospects
abstract: The prospects for power and brightness scaling of lasers by using arrays of gain elements have been enhanced by advances in beam combining. An overview of the fundamentals and of recent progress will be given.

articleTitle: Trapping cavitation bubbles with a self-focused laser beam
abstract: We demonstrate that laser-induced cavitation bubbles can be trapped in a self-focused laser beam. This counterintuitive phenomenon is in contrast to conventional optical tweezers effect.

articleTitle: Electrical characteristics of highly strained InGaAs/InAlAs 2 /spl mu/m quantum cascade light-emitting devices
abstract: Growth of electroluminescent devices operating at 2 /spl mu/m based on quantum cascade (QC) design of strain-compensated In/sub x/Ga/sub 1-x/As/In/sub y/Al/sub 1-y/As has been undertaken. Experimentally measured current-voltage characteristics are in good agreement with theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Polarization-independent cross-correlation using two-photon absorption
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally investigate the polarization dependence of two-photon absorption in cross-correlation measurements, and we demonstrate that by fixing one of the input polarization states, the cross-correlation signal becomes independent of the second polarization.

articleTitle: Video-rate wide-field fluorescence lifetime imaging
abstract: We present an optimisation of wide-field time-gated fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLIM) based on gated microchannel plate image optical intensifier technology and report a FLIM system that operates at video rate (29 Hz).

articleTitle: Femtosecond time-of-flight measurements in photonic crystal waveguides
abstract: Ultrafast optical gating was used to resolve the time of flight of photons through photonic crystal waveguides. We observed the slowing down of light around the band gap

articleTitle: Electroluminescence evolution of Ge quantum-dot diodes with the fold number
abstract: We observed intensity enchantment and blue shift versus temperature for a LEDs consisting of 30-fold Ge QDs. The diffusion length on p-side is controlled by temperature and will active more QDs at room temperature.

articleTitle: Coherent anti-Stokes Raman spectroscopy for THz-frequency modes of biomolecules in aqueous solution
abstract: In vivo detection of terahertz (THz)-frequency vibrational modes in biological tissue is a challenging subject. By use of coherent anti-Stokes Raman spectroscopy, new THz-frequency resonances for proteins in aqueous solution are successfully detected.

articleTitle: Mach-Zehnder modulator arm length mismatch measurement and analysis
abstract: We describe an accurate technique to measure the arm length mismatch of Mach-Zehnder modulators (MZMs), based on their broadband filter characteristics. We experimentally determine the mismatch of rib waveguide and poling-induced waveguide polymer MZMs.

articleTitle: 525-1800nm, Watt-level, all-fibre picosecond source
Optimizing erbium doped materials for optical processing, memory, and laser frequency stabilization applications at 1.5 /spl mu/m
abstract: Dramatically lengthened coherence lifetimes in erbium doped crystals for spatial-spectral holography applications at 1.5 /spl mu/m were obtained through optimization of multiple material design parameters. Microscopic processes responsible for spin dynamics were elucidated and quantitatively modeled.

articleTitle: Channel waveguide laser in neodymium doped silica-on-silicon by direct-UV-writing
abstract: We demonstrate UV-written laser waveguides in neodymium-doped silica-on-silicon. Lasing at 1048-1056 nm and 1356 nm was observed and a slope efficiency of 33% and threshold of 4 mW were measured for the /sup 4/F/sub 3/2/ /spl rarr/ /sup 4/I/sub 11/2/ transition.

articleTitle: First experiment of third order optical parametric generation for a photon triples source
abstract: We report the first experimental third order optical parametric generation The experimental setup leads to an efficient and pure cubic process. This result opens the way to quantum experiments on three-photon entanglement.

articleTitle: Accuracy and scalability in holographic content-addressable storage
abstract: We use an experimental platform to investigate the potential accuracy and scalability that a massively-parallel holographic content-addressable storage system might have for use in searching digital databases

articleTitle: Differential birefringent fiber frequency-modulated continuous-wave Sagnac interferometer
abstract: The paper reports on a differential birefringent fiber frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) Sagnac interferometer, which, due to the nature of differential structure, can automatically eliminate the unexpected non-reciprocal phase drift and make the resolution of the interferometer doubled.

articleTitle: A high-power, TEM/sub 00/-mode, diode-pumped, Brewster-cut Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ laser
abstract: The continuous-wave and Q-switched (and cavity-dumped) operation of a robust and efficient diode-pumped Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ laser is presented. Tailoring of the pump-induced thermal lens in the Brewster-cut gain medium allows high-power (>10 W), circular TEM/sub 00/-mode operation.

articleTitle: Collinear, background-free, third harmonic FROG techniques for characterizing ultrashort pulses at high NA
abstract: We demonstrate collinear, background-free, third harmonic spatial correlation, temporal correlation, and FROG techniques for characterizing the focus of high NA optics for the first time.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of microstructured optical fibres with elliptical holes
abstract: The fabrication of the first microstructured optical fibre with elliptical holes is presented. We describe simple techniques for achieving the desired hole ellipticity in polymer fibre and discuss the light guiding and polarization properties.

articleTitle: Integrated optical ring resonators fabricated by silver ion-exchange in glass
abstract: Glass integrated optical ring resonators are fabricated using silver ion-exchange. Propagation losses of 0. 1 dB/cm are consistently achieved yielding a finesse of 40. These resonators are promising devices for frequency selective applications including Sagnac-based optical gyroscopes.

articleTitle: Observation of vortex-ring "discrete" solitons in 2D photonic lattices
abstract: We present the experimental observation of both on-site and off-site vortex ring solitons of unity topological charge in a nonlinear photonic lattice, along with a theoretical study of their propagation dynamics and stability.

articleTitle: Tunable microfluidic optical fiber
abstract: Pumped microfluidics provides a powerful new way to dynamically tune the transmission characteristics of optical fibers. We describe the fabrication and performance of several classes of devices based on fiber gratings and microfluidics.

articleTitle: High power junction dynamics of the intra-step quantum well electroabsorption modulator
abstract: Novel DC and RF behaviors are experimentally observed for a high power p-i-n electroabsorption modulator using intra-step quantum well and single-sided large optical cavity. The phenomena are explained by the junction dynamics.

articleTitle: Temporal characterization of ultrashort X-ray pulses using X-ray anomalous transmission
abstract: By exciting coherent optical phonons in a Laue crystal with a fs-laser pulse and measuring anomalous transmission of an X-ray pulse versus delay between the two pulses, the temporal structure of the X-ray pulse can be determined with a time resolution comparable to the period of the excited vibration.

articleTitle: Direct laser fabrication of blazed diffraction gratings on polymer films
abstract: Interference between 20 ns 193 nm ArF laser beams is used for the fabrication of blazed gratings on Cyclotene (BCB, Dow) polymer films. The grating shape is tuned for almost complete power diffraction into the 1/sup st/ order.

articleTitle: Multiterawatt laser as a front end for the OMEGA EP (extended performance) laser chain
abstract: We report on a laser system developed as the front end for a multipetawatt-class laser that uses an optical parametric chirped-pulse amplifier as a preamplifier and a glass power amplifier. Early results are presented.

articleTitle: Frequency-shifting with local nonlinearity management in non-uniformly poled quadratic nonlinear materials
abstract: The frequency shifts resulting from cascaded processes with strong group-velocity mismatch can be controlled and enhanced with nonlinearity management in quasi-phase matched structures. We demonstrate theoretically tailored, efficient frequency shifting of infrared pulses.

articleTitle: Wavelength modulation off-axis integrated cavity output spectroscopy for biogenic NO detection in human breath
abstract: A compact gas sensor based on a CW mid-infrared tunable quantum cascade laser and wavelength modulation off-axis integrated cavity output spectroscopy has been developed to measure biogenic NO concentrations in human breath.

articleTitle: New approach to fabricating channel in z-cut PPLN using zinc-diffusion
abstract: High-yield zinc-diffused channel waveguides in pre-poled z-cut PPLN with high photorefractive resistance at room temperature are presented. Frequency doubling of a 1064 nm Nd:YAG laser at 145/spl deg/C gave a conversion efficiency of 16.7%/Wcm/sup 2/.

articleTitle: High-resolution EUV imaging using high harmonic generation
abstract: We use a simple set-up consisting of two multilayer mirrors and a hollow fiber EUV light source to obtain high-resolution EUV images. Magnifications of X20 and X50 are demonstrated

articleTitle: Improvements in multi-photon laser scanning microscopy using photonic crystal fibre
abstract: We report a powerful system based on microstructured fibres that improves upon incumbent multiphoton microscopy instrumentation. Applied to biological specimens, more than a 7-fold increase in fluorescence yield was observed when compared with commercial systems.

articleTitle: High power, single-mode, single-frequency DFB fibre laser at 1550 nm in MOPA configuration
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated fibre DFB laser followed by cladding pumped EYDFA which delivers optical output power in excess of 14 W without any degradation of DFB properties. Measured RIN was < -147 dB/Hz for frequencies above 5 MHz.

articleTitle: Selective quantum well intermixing of 1.22 and 1.55 /spl mu/m GaInNAs laser material
abstract: Selective quantum well intermixing in 1.22 and 1.55 /spl mu/m GaInNAs/GaAs laser structures using a sputtered silica cap deposition process is reported. Controlled wavelength shifts of 60 and 93 nm were obtained in 1.22 and 1.55 /spl mu/m material respectively.

articleTitle: Biological imaging with second-harmonic generation
abstract: We describe novel imaging techniques based on second-harmonic generation (SHG). These include SHG microscopy and auto-confocal microscopy (ACM). Biological applications are reviewed.

articleTitle: Study of the dispersion of an air-core photonic bandgap fiber and its application as a linear chirped pulse compressor
abstract: We study the dispersion of an air-core photonic bandgap fiber and show its application in chirped pulse amplification. /spl sim/500 fs pulses, stretched to /spl sim/ 100 ps using dispersion-compensating fiber, were re-compressed to /spl sim/1ps in 10 m of this fiber.

articleTitle: Instability of single frequency oscillation in semilinear photorefractive oscillator with reflection gratings
abstract: We show, experimentally and by calculation, that two-frequency oscillation in semilinear photorefractive coherent oscillator extends the range of pump intensity ratios where the oscillation is possible and ensures a higher output intensity.

articleTitle: A novel ultra-fast optical router using time-slot switching
abstract: We present a novel optical routing scheme scalable to greater than 50/spl times/50 channels with a potential aggregate bit-rate of 1 Tbps. The proof-of-principle experiment demonstrates the feasibility of the router with a de-multiplexed Q-factor of 6.35.

articleTitle: Multi-source phased-array approach to improve the spatial resolution in frequency-domain diffuse optical imaging
abstract: We present an approach to diffuse optical imaging based on a multi-source phased array of intensity-modulated light sources. Experimental data illustrates the improvement in spatial resolution compared to conventional imaging with a single source-detector pair.

articleTitle: Site selective spectroscopy of energy transfer processes in Er doped GaN
abstract: Using the site selectivity of combined excitation-emission spectroscopy, we have identified six different Er/sup 3+/ centers in GaN and investigated their role in energy transfer from other ions and electron-hole pairs.

articleTitle: In-vitro studies of nanoparticle-virus complexes
abstract: We have enclosed an optically active nanoparticle inside a virus coat to create a virus-like, intracellular optical probe. The core-shell interactions of the self-assembled, nanoparticle-enclosing capsids are investigated spectroscopically and compared with intact viruses.

articleTitle: Passive mode-locking of multi-watt grazing-incidence Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ laser using a saturable Bragg reflector
abstract: Passive modelocking of a diode-pumped grazing-incidence Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ laser is reported for the first time to our knowledge. Mode-locked slope efficiencies of 30%, output powers up to 4.2 W and pulse durations down to 8.5 ps are reported.

articleTitle: 5 Gb/s elevated temperature data transmission using quantum dot lasers
abstract: We report the first error free 5 Gb/s transmission over 4 km single-mode fibre and 500 m multi-mode fibre using InGaAs/GaAs quantum dot lasers emitting at 1.3 /spl mu/m. Low penalty elevated temperature transmission at 2.5 Gb/s is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Pump-probe measurements of multiwavelength ultrafast gain dynamics in a semiconductor optical amplifier
abstract: The ultrafast gain dynamics of a semiconductor optical amplifier is measured under phase-correlated multiwavelength pulse amplification. Four-wave mixing, carrier heating and carrier cooling effects are observed and shown to enhance the phase correlation.

articleTitle: Sub-hertz stabilization of femtosecond laser frequency combs
abstract: Femtosecond laser frequency combs can have sub-hertz linewidths when phase-locked to a similarly narrow reference laser. Long term coherence is verified by high-contrast interference between two combs with integration times up to 10 s.

articleTitle: Electrically driven room temperature THz modulators
abstract: We describe our work on electrically controlled modulators for THz radiation, which operate at room temperature. The modulation is achieved by reducing the electron density in a gated two-dimensional electron gas structure.

articleTitle: Wavefront correction of laser rods using magnetorheological finishing
abstract: A magnetorheological finishing technique for correcting the transmitted wavefront of laser rods is reported. Significant improvements for large-aperture Nd:YLF laser rods are demonstrated, and the potential for correcting smaller apertures and thermal aberrations is addressed.

articleTitle: Laser Doppler velocity profile sensor using a two-wavelength technique and diffractive optics
abstract: A measuring system based on a differential laser-Doppler anemometer has been extended to determine one-dimensional velocity profiles of shear flows with a spatial resolution in the micrometer range. The principle of the realised velocity profile sensor is based on two-wavelength fringe systems with different gradients of their fringe spacings. After wavelength-sensitive detection two Doppler frequencies are determined, which yield the position as well as the velocity component of individual tracer particles. For fluid flow investigations with high spatial resolution and high data rate, laser Doppler anemometers (LDA) are often applied. An LDA set-up can be considered a Mach-Zehnder interferometer operating by beam splitting and subsequent superposition of the partial beams. In the volume of intersection an interference pattern consisting of parallel fringes develops, which defines the measurement volume of the LDA. The velocity of small particles passing the measurement volume is determined from the modulation frequency of the scattered light, the Doppler frequency. The spatial resolution is generally limited by the size of the measurement volume which is usually about 1/spl middot/0.1/spl middot/0.1 mm/sup 3/. But in many applications, especially for turbulence research, highly spatially resolved velocity measurements with a resolution down to e.g. 10 /spl mu/m (Kolmogorov scale) are required. We have developed a laser Doppler velocity profile sensor, which enables velocity measurements with a spatial resolution inside the measurement volume with nearly 1 /spl mu/m accuracy. A Mach-Zehnder configuration is used with two wavelengths each of which generates a fringe pattern. A two-wavelength laser was used, which emits an upconversion laser line and the pump light. The beam waist of the different wavelengths are spatially separated by a diffractive lens offering a great chromatic dispersion. Due to the wavefront curvature of the employed Gaussian beam a convergent and a divergent interference pattern results. The ratio of the fringe spacing functions is monotonously varying along the optical axis and used as a calibration function for the determination of the position. From particles passing the measurement volume and scattering a bi-chromatic light two Doppler frequencies can be calculated, the ratio of which yields together with the calibration curve the position. In conclusion a differential laser Doppler profile sensor for spatial resolved velocity measurements of shear flows was realised. The advantages of this profile sensor can be outlined as follows: (i) A spatial resolution of about 1.6 /spl mu/m, (ii) a relative velocity measurement error of about 1.4/spl times/10-4 and (iii) distributed velocity measurements without traversing the sensor were achieved. The drawbacks mentioned above concerning conventional point-wise LDA systems, such as strongly limited spatial resolution, systematic velocity measurement errors due to a non-correctable varying fringe spacing and the need for scanning the velocity profile are overcome.

articleTitle: Transmission properties of nonlinear multimode waveguide arrays
abstract: Multimode capillary waveguide arrays containing reverse-saturable absorbers exhibit an enhancement of the nonlinear response. Experimental data are modeled by the effect of partial mode filling, influenced by fill fraction and capillary diameter.

articleTitle: Components and subsystems for analog microwave photonics
abstract: The performance and component requirements for externally-modulated analog microwave photonic links will be reviewed. Specific emphasis will be placed on modulator efficiency (Vpi), laser relative intensity noise, detected photocurrent, link linearity and link impairments

articleTitle: Optical limiting behaviors of nano-gold self-assembled multi-wall carbon nanotubes
abstract: The optical limiting behaviors of nano-gold self-assembled multiple wall carbon nanotubes was investigated experimentally. The result shows that the optical limiting behavior of nano gold MWNTs is better than those of C/sub 60/ and CBS.

articleTitle: Determination of the absolute responsivity of a standard detector for F/sub 2/ lasers at 157 nm
abstract: A new method for the determination of the absolute responsivity of a standard detector for the measurement of the average power of the F/sub 2/ laser radiation at 157 nm is presented.

articleTitle: Self-homodyne RF-optical microdisk receiver
abstract: Nonlinear optical modulation in a LiNbO/sub 3/ microdisk RF-optical receiver is used in a self-homodyne configuration to demodulate 50 Mb/s data on an 8.7 GHz RF carrier.

articleTitle: Phase-matched magnetization-induced second-harmonic generation in magnetophotonic crystals
abstract: Resonant enhancement of magnetization-induced second-harmonic generation due to the phase-mismatch compensation at the photonic band gap edge is observed in magnetophotonic crystals formed from a stack of ferromagnetic Bi-substituted yttrium-iron-garnet layers.

articleTitle: Progress in CARS microscopy using photonic crystal fiber based light sources
abstract: We report on two orders of magnitude improvement of signal to noise ratio and enhanced tunability in photonic crystal fiber based CARS microscopy using an optimized photonic crystal fiber.

articleTitle: Multiple spectrum filtering and thermal fixing for volume holographic correlator
abstract: A volume holographic correlator, including off-line thermal fixing, is demonstrated by storing 1020 images in a Fe-doped LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3 </sub> crystal through two-dimensional angular-multiplexing. A multiple spectrum filtering is proposed to suppress output noise

articleTitle: Nd:YVO/sub 4 /master oscillator power amplifier system with 20 W output at 1342 nm
abstract: We report the operation of a diode-side-pumped Nd:YVO/sub 4/ MOPA at 1342 nm. TEM/sub 00/ oscillator output power of 10 W with M/sup 2/ < 1.1 and 20 W from a MOPA configuration is obtained.

articleTitle: Effect of biological water in the far-infrared absorption spectrum of myoglobin studied by terahertz time-domain spectroscopy
abstract: Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy was applied to study the far-infrared absorption spectra of the myoglobin-water system as a function of hydration level. The effect of biological water on the far-infrared absorption properties of myoglobin was observed.

articleTitle: Domain reversal in single crystal strontium barium niobate (Sr/sub 0.61/Ba/sub 0.39/Nb/sub 2/O/sub 6/)
abstract: The first systematic domain reversal for crystal strontium barium niobate (Sr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.61</sub>Ba<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.39</sub>Nb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>, SBN:61), such as coercive fields, polarization, wall mobilities are reported. Its 4-fold rotational symmetry of the domain shape is reported for the first time

articleTitle: X-ray radiation properties of micron-sized clusters under the action of superintense laser radiation
abstract: High resolution K-shell spectra of a plasma created by laser irradiation of micron-sized Ar clusters have been measured with an intensity above 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and a pulse duration of 30 fs

articleTitle: Self-guiding and frequency shifts of intense laser pulses propagating in clustered gases
abstract: We report time-resolved measurements of frequency modulations of intense laser pulses interacting with clustered gas jets. The results are consistent with recent observations of intense laser self-focusing in these jets.

articleTitle: Two-wave mixing via dynamic Bragg gratings recorded in Er-doped fibers via spatial hole burning
abstract: Two-wave mixing at dynamic Bragg gratings recorded via spatial hole burning in Er-doped fibers is reported. Adaptive detection of fast phase modulation is demonstrated but the gratings were /spl ap/ 7 times weaker than expected.

articleTitle: Diffraction limited polarized emission from a multimode Yb fiber amplifier after nonlinear beam converter
abstract: The multimode and depolarized output beam of a multimode diode-pumped Yb-doped fiber amplifier is converted to a diffraction limited, linearly polarized beam by a self-referencing two wave mixing process in an infrared sensitive photorefractive crystal.

articleTitle: In vivo study of early development of vertebrate nervous system using noninvasive harmonics optical microscopy
abstract: Due to the noninvasive and functional natures of higher-harmonics generation, harmonics optical microscopy provides an excellent tool to study the early developmental dynamics of vertebrate nervous system without any extrinsic or intrinsic fluorophores.

articleTitle: Ultra-short pulse Yb/sup 3+/ fiber based laser and amplifier system producing >25 W average power
abstract: We have demonstrated an ultra-short-pulse Yb/sup 3+/-fiber laser and amplifier system that produces >25 W average power. The output pulses were recompressed to a duration of 110 fs using a standard bulk grating-based compressor.

articleTitle: Self-channeling of 100-MW 30-fs Ti:sapphire-laser pulses in the fundamental air-guided mode of a hollow-core-photonic-crystal fiber
abstract: Spatial self-action of 100-MW 30-fs laser pulses in hollow-core photonic-crystal fibers filled with different gases is demonstrated, resulting in the formation of circularly symmetric Townes-like beam profiles and allowing channeling of high-intensity ultrashort laser pulses

articleTitle: High repetitive-Q-switched operation in a transversely diode pumped Nd:YVO/sub 4/ holographic laser
abstract: We demonstrate a high-repetition operation (>500 Hz) in a transversely diode-pumped Nd:YVO/sub 4/ holographic laser. The maximum output energy of 510 /spl mu/J was obtained, and the corresponding energy extraction efficiency of 7% was achieved.

articleTitle: Gain-flattened gain-clamped discrete Raman amplifier
abstract: We demonstrated effective optical gain clamping for gain-flattened S-band discrete Raman amplifier. Gain flattening is achieved by pumping at multiple wavelengths. Minimum input signal dynamic range is over 18 dB in different cases of lasing wavelengths.

articleTitle: First demonstration of diode-pumped ew and femtosecond Vb/sup 3+/:CaF/sub 2/ lasers
abstract: Abstract: We present, for the first time, the pcrfonnances in both cw and fs regime of diode­ pumped lasers based on Yb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sub>:CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. 5.8-W cw power for 15 W of pump power and 150-fs pulses has been obtained.

articleTitle: Ultraviolet diode laser induced fluorescence detection of biological aerosol agents
abstract: The threat of biological aerosol attack has become a feature of life. Fast detection of airborne agents and discrimination against benign aerosols has been demonstrated using ultraviolet diode laser induced fluorescence of key biological substances.

articleTitle: A coarse-WDM transmitter/receiver for 10 Gb/s /spl times/ 4ch interconnection using a silica-based planar lightwave
abstract: A compact multi-wavelength transmitter/receiver for coarse WDM was developed and 10-Gb/s /spl times/ 4-ch interconnection was experimentally demonstrated. Laser diodes and photodiodes were hybrid-integrated on a silica-based planar lightwave circuit with an arrayed-waveguide grating (AWG).

articleTitle: Raman spectroscopy and breast cancer: looking beyond mammography for the early detection of breast cancer
abstract: This is a project to develop Raman spectroscopy techniques to diagnose breast cancer in human patients in real time during mammography, using a fiberoptic device delivered through a biopsy needle.

articleTitle: Development of laser-terahertz emission microscope for inspecting the electrical faults in semiconductor devices
abstract: We have developed a laser-terahertz emission microscope for inspecting the electrical faults in integrated circuits. By improving the spatial resolution of the system, we successfully observed the THz emission image in a microprocessor chip on standby.

articleTitle: A compact all-optical 40 Gb/s clock recovery using a traveling-wave electroabsorption modulator-based ring oscillator with a chip coplanar Q-filter
abstract: A compact, 40 Gb/s all-optical clock recovery is demonstrated by utilizing filtered and actively amplified photocurrent in a traveling-wave electroabsorption modulator-based ring oscillator. The recovered 40 GHz optical clock has 500 fs timing jitter and 8 ps pulsewidth.

articleTitle: Generation of a 3-octave white-light continuum in a high-n2 microstructure fiber with normal dispersion in the visible/near-infrared spectral region
abstract: A white-light continuum spanning from 200 nm to 1800 nm was generated in a microstructure optical fiber manufactured from a soft glass with high nonlinearity. The fiber exhibits normal dispersion throughout the vis/nir spectral region.

articleTitle: Simple repetition rate upgrade scheme for passively mode-locked solid-state lasers
abstract: We propose a technique for increasing the repetition rate of solid-state lasers potentially solving the limitation of cavity length reduction. Based on spectral selection we achieved high quality multiplication with relatively broad detuning range.

articleTitle: Phase noise measurement by interferometric fringe among DC-locked femtosecond subharmonic pulses
abstract: We have fixed an optical phase relation among femtosecond subharmonic pulses, and observed interferometric fringes by a video. The estimated phase noise by a movie guaranteed out-of-loop Fourier synthesis of them for long time.

articleTitle: Multi-terabit per second cross gain modulation in quantum dot amplifiers via excited state lasing
abstract: A method of exploiting just the fast intra-dot relaxation in quantum dots for signal processing is examined. Simulations showing 2.5 Tb/s signal processing and a flat frequency response illustrate the concepts utility in future telecommunication systems.

articleTitle: Nonlinear guided waves in negative refraction waveguides
abstract: We analyze nonlinear guided waves in a planar waveguide made of a left-handed material surrounded by a Kerr-like nonlinear dielectric. We study the symmetry breaking bifurcation and asymmetric modes in such a symmetric structure.

articleTitle: Compact supercontinuum generation and four-wave mixing in PCF with 10 ns laser pulses
abstract: We report broad flat supercontinuum, 500-1750+ nm, using a kHz train of nanosecond Q-switched microchip laser pulses at 1064 nm or 1047 nm. The same systems exhibit strong parametric generation of FWM peaks, e.g. at 732/1945 nm or 895/1315 nm.

articleTitle: Nondestructive evaluation of ceramic bearings using THz impulse ranging
abstract: Non-contact terahertz impulse ranging can detect aluminum oxide bearings damaged by thermal stress. Results using two different analysis techniques are reported which can determine the presence of fractures in a variety of ceramic materials.

articleTitle: Novel holographic masking technique for Bragg reflector inscription on integrated optics components
abstract: A novel triangular interferometer configuration is used to inscribe periodic or aperiodic patterns with micronic or submicronic fringe spacing. It is employed to realize Bragg reflectors or resonant grating filters on integrated optical components.

articleTitle: Sellmeier and thermo-optic dispersion formulas for KTiOAsO/sub 4/
abstract: Thermo-optic constants for KTiOAsO/sub 4/ were measured from 20.0 to 120.0 /spl deg/C in the 0.532-1.571 /spl mu/m range. The Sellmeier and thermo-optic dispersion formulas that reproduce well the phase-matching conditions for normal and periodically poled crystals are presented.

articleTitle: Third-order nonlinearities in Ge/sub 33/As/sub 12/Se/sub 55/ glass for high-index contrast fiber devices
abstract: The nonlinear properties of a chalcogenide glass, Ge/sub 33/As/sub 12/Se/sub 55/, were investigated. This glass shows promise for fabrication into high-index contrast highly nonlinear fiber because of its relatively high glass transition temperature and nonlinear index of refraction.

articleTitle: Widely tunable, photocurrent-driven wavelength converter for narrowband analog applications
abstract: A widely-tunable photocurrent-driven, directly modulated wavelength converter is demonstrated for narrowband applications. Wavelength conversion RF gain up to 30 dB and spurious-free dynamic range up to 105 dB-Hz/sup 2/3/ are measured at 2.5 GHz.

articleTitle: Bandgap-tuned In/sub 0.5/Ga/sub 0.5/As/GaAs quantum dot lasers
abstract: Bandgap tuned quantum dot lasers were fabricated and their performance compared to lasers fabricated from as-grown material. The output spectrum of the tuned lasers was blueshifted by 84 nm and significantly narrower than the as-grown devices.

articleTitle: Forming a 2D waveguide array in PR ferroelectric crystal
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally a fixed two-dimensional (2D) periodic waveguide array by plane-wave interference in a photorefractive (PR) ferroelectric crystal, and then demonstrate the localized states as a function of applied electric filed.

articleTitle: Allocable dispersion compensation for thermal dispersion variations in transmission fibers
Fabrication and characterization of ZnO:PPLN crystal fiber by electric-field induced micro-swing technique
abstract: A novel electric-field induced micro-swing poling technique was developed to fabricate quasi-phase-matched crystal fibers. Flat and poled-through domain period of 16.3 /spl mu/m was achieved with a diameter of less than 200 /spl mu/m and a diameter variation within 1%.

articleTitle: Noise reduction in fiber ring lasers by use of a semiconductor optical amplifier
abstract: We analyze the high-pass filtering characteristics of the SOAs and show that the SOA carrier lifetime and saturation power will have important influence on its applications of beating noise suppression in fiber ring lasers.

articleTitle: Toward the commercial realization of high performance holographic data storage
abstract: An overview of the InPhase Technologies holographic demonstration platform is presented This compact, mobile system is the first fully functional, portable, holographic recordable drive complete with custom optics and control and channel electronics. The development of this device paves the way for the commercialization of this technology.

articleTitle: Nonlinear properties of left-handed composite metamaterials
abstract: We study nonlinear properties of microstructured materials with negative refraction and demonstrate that the hysteresis-type dependence of the magnetic permeability that would allow changing the material properties from left- to right-handed and back.

articleTitle: Performance optimization of volume gratings with finite size through numerical simulation
abstract: A numerical simulation is used to investigate and, optimize the diffraction performance of 2-D restricted volume gratings with variable coupling strength. Results on angle and wavelength selectivity are given, and the potential use in grating design discussed.

articleTitle: Novel Nd:YVO/sub 4/ composite thin slab laser with 11.5 W of output power and M/sup 2/ /spl sim/2.5
abstract: We present a novel and simple Nd:YVO/sub 4/ composite thin slab laser with low thermo-optical aberrations. Preliminary experiments demonstrate 11.5 W of output power with M/sup 2/ /spl sim/2.5 and an optical slope efficiency of 38 %.

articleTitle: Transparent switching in PPLN waveguide arrays
abstract: Ultrafast all-optical switching and routing based on a quadratic parametric interaction is experimentally demonstrated in PPLN waveguide arrays. Milliwatt signals at 1550 nm can be switched to different positions and wavelengths with low cross-talk.

articleTitle: Optical signals of the ovary
abstract: Ovarian cancer has the highest mortality of all gynecologic cancers. Patients at high risk need technologies that detect early malignant changes. Optical techniques will play an important role in the screening, diagnosis and treatment monitoring.

articleTitle: Above-threshold operation of antiguided VCSEL arrays
abstract: 2D antiguided vertical cavity surface emitting laser array above threshold operation was studied by 3D bi-directional beam propagation method and experimentally. 5/spl times/5 rectangular array emit in-phase mode up to >10 threshold in agreement with theory.

articleTitle: Ultra-narrowband optical fiber Bragg grating filters for water vapor lidar atmospheric measurements
abstract: An ultra narrowband, high transmission fiber Bragg grating optical filter at 946 nm is presented for water vapor lidar measurements. The filter and water line have the same bandwidths, significantly reducing optical background in lidar receivers.

articleTitle: A 25/spl times/10 GHz modelocked erbium-doped fiber laser
abstract: We demonstrate a room-temperature fiber laser with simultaneous modelocking of 25 wavelengths at 10 GHz. The multiwavelength emission is achieved using a frequency-shifter and a Fabry-Perot filter giving a weakly-chirped 18 ps output pulses.

articleTitle: Discrete soliton-trains in two-dimensional optically-induced photonic lattices
abstract: We demonstrate the formation of 2D discrete soliton-trains in a photonic lattice induced with partially coherent light, along with a clear observation of anisotropic behavior of discrete diffraction and discrete self-focusing in the 2D lattice.

articleTitle: Remote spectral imaging with multi-wavelength and tunable, wavelength-modulation lasers
abstract: Scanning laser remote imaging with wavelength-division-multiplexed and/or wavelength-agile transmitters allows acquisition of different target spectral signatures. Wavelength-modulation-spectroscopic imaging of a gas using broadly tunable mid-IR lasers is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal fibre laser source for short-wavelength multi-photon laser scanning microscopy
abstract: We report a source based on soliton self-frequency shift in microstructured fibres for multi-photon microscopy of calcium indicators. We demonstrate the system by imaging smooth muscle cells from the rat pulmonary vein loaded with fura-2/AM.

articleTitle: Optimizing the third-order optical susceptibility of Pt-doped BaTiO/sub 3/ grown by combustion chemical vapor deposition
abstract: Optimization of the nonlinear optical properties of metal nano-cluster films imbedded in a nonlinear host is demonstrated using combustion chemical vapor deposition and subsequent Z-scan analysis.

articleTitle: High-energy coherent THz radiation from laser wakefield accelerated ultrashort electron bunches
abstract: We report on the observation and characterization of intense pulsed coherent THz radiation. This radiation is generated by ultra-short multi-nC electron bunches passing the plasma/vacuum boundary. The electron bunches are produced through laser wakefield acceleration.

articleTitle: Imaging the microstructure of menisci using optical coherence tomography
abstract: Using optical coherence tomography, changes in the polarization sensitivity of pig menisci were detected both in healthy and enzymatically degraded samples.

articleTitle: Self-similar collapse in air
abstract: We show that filaments generated in air exhibit circular symmetry indicative of self-similar collapse.

articleTitle: 6W diffraction-limited pico-second output a phase conjugate Nd:YVO/sub 4/ amplifier
abstract: 6 W diffraction-limited pico-second pulses from a diode-pumped Nd:YVO/sub 4/ slab amplifier with a photorefractive phase-conjugate mirror are demonstrated. The corresponding energy extraction efficiency of 26% was achieved.

articleTitle: Fundamental limits to few-cycle pulse generation from compression of broadband supercontinua generated in photonic crystal fiber
abstract: The compression properties of octave-spanning supercontinuum spectra generated in photonic crystal fibers are studied using stochastic nonlinear Schrodinger equation simulations. The conditions under which sub-5 fs pulses can be obtained after compression are identified.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum generation in a photonic crystal fiber with two closely lying zero dispersion wavelengths
abstract: We demonstrate stable supercontinuum generation in a photonic crystal fiber with two closely lying zero dispersion wavelengths. The supercontinuum is insensitive to changes of the input pulse over a wide range of pulse parameters.

articleTitle: Highly efficient phase conjugation by pico-second four-wave-mixing in solid-dye saturable amplifier
abstract: We demonstrate 2.5 times phase conjugation by four-wave-mixing with the use of pico-second pulses in a rhodamine6G dye polymer amplifier. Phase conjugation pulse shortening by a factor of 2 is also measured.

articleTitle: Optical parametric chirped pulse amplification and spectral shaping seeded by a continuum generated in photonic band gap fiber
abstract: The combination of a femtosecond laser oscillator, a photonic band gap fiber and a nanosecond parametric amplifier makes it possible to propose a new tunable and spectrally shaped amplified laser source.

articleTitle: Electro-optic beam deflection using multiple total-internal-reflection interfaces
abstract: We report a novel design of an electro-optic beam deflector using two total-internal-reflection interfaces creating a three-port switch.

articleTitle: Passive mode-locked 21 W femtosecond Yb:YAG laser with 124 MHz repetition-rate
abstract: We report on a high-power passively mode-locked Yb:YAG laser generating Fourier-limited pulses with a pulse-duration of 578 fs and an average power of 21.2 W in a diffraction-limited beam at a repetition-rate of 124 MHz.

articleTitle: Femtosecond ultra-relativistic electron bunch length measurements
abstract: We used single-shot electro+ptic sampling to temporally characterize 28.5GeV compressed electron bunches at the Sub-Picosecond Pulse Source at SLAC. Resolution limited measurements yield a minimum electrodptic feature of 300fs (FWM).

articleTitle: Promise of QPM-MgO:LiNbO/sub 3/ devices: fabrication process and highly efficient wavelength conversion at room temperature
abstract: Advances in wavelength conversion, such as second-harmonic generation and optically parametric oscillation based on QPM-MgO:LiNbO/sub 3/ are discussed. Topics include ultrafast pulse treatments with type-I QPM by use of an off-digital nonlinear optical coefficient.

articleTitle: Determination of resonant frequencies for DNA and protein by directly measuring absorption spectra
abstract: Resonant frequencies for Salmon and Herring DNA and protein have directly been measured by measuring absorption spectra through frequency-tuning the output of a coherent and monochromatic THz source in the range of 0.2-4.5 THz.

articleTitle: The changing technology of solid state lasers
abstract: The development of high-power diode lasers started an earlier advance in solid state lasers and is behind the emergence of fibers as high-power media. Here we compare and contrast fiber- and bulk-media lasers.

articleTitle: Performance computation of a 160 Gbit/s NOLM-based 3-stage all-optical regenerator
abstract: The performance of a 160 Gbit/s NOLM-based 3-stage all-optical regeneration is analytically evaluated in order to demonstrate the effectiveness of this scheme in a multi-span link. The used analytical model is experimentally validated.

articleTitle: Multi-watt, continuous wave, continuum generation by use of erbium fiber source and dispersion shifted fiber
abstract: Continuum generation in the continuous wave regime is proposed and demonstrated in conventional optical fiber pumped by a high power seeded EDFA. A continuum delivering 2.3 W over 430 nm at the -3 dB level is achieved.

articleTitle: Active stabilization of a passively modelocked, grazing-incidence Yb:YAG slab laser
abstract: Passive modelocking of a quasi-CW Yb:YAG laser based on a grazing-incidence geometry is demonstrated. Active stabilization via intracavity loss modulation is essential to prevent damage to the saturable absorber by undesirable Q-switching of the laser.

articleTitle: All-optical multifocal-type time-to-space converter module using an optical Kerr gate of a squarylium dye film
abstract: A 4-ch all-optical time-to-space converter module was developed using an optical Kerr switch of a squarylium dye film and beam splitter units. Conversion of 1-Tb/s equivalent four signal-pulses into parallel signals was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Interactions between "dissipative" spatial solitons in SOAs with automatic signal restoration
abstract: We observed the interactions between two coherent "dissipative" spatial solitons in a periodically patterned semiconductor optical amplifier (PPSOA). The interactions are non-local, phase dependent and exhibit unique features such as soliton birth and signal restoration.

articleTitle: New low temperature poly-silicon fabrication technique by near infrared femto-second laser annealing
abstract: Combining ultrafast Ti:sapphire laser pulses and the sequential lateral solidification technique, we achieved films with large grains, wide laser-fluence window, at lower temperatures, than conventional annealing methods.

articleTitle: Quadratic electro-optic effect in a novel nano-optical polymer (iodine-doped polyisoprene)
abstract: Quadratic electro-optic effect in a novel nano-optical polymer (iodine-doped polyisoprene) has been measured. The magnitude of the Kerr coefficient is large, about 66 times that of nitrobenzene at 632 nm.

articleTitle: High single mode power in photonic crystal vertical cavity lasers
abstract: Photonic crystal confinement incorporated into selectively oxidized vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers (VCSELs) is for the first time shown to enable increased continuous wave single mode output power compared to selectively-oxidized devices fabricated in the same material.

articleTitle: Dynamic wavelength conversion by using highly-nonlinear fiber for optical code labeled packets
abstract: We demonstrate dynamic wavelength conversion by using a highly-nonlinear fiber for optical code labeled packets. After dynamic wavelength conversion by two DFB-LDs, which is based on four-wave mixing, the eight-chip-BPSK optical code is successfully conserved.

articleTitle: Single shot multi-channel demultiplexing at 1.55 /spl mu/m by using an optical Kerr gate of an organic dye film
abstract: We report single-shot demultiplexing of optical pulses at 1.55 /spl mu/m. Using an organic dye film as a two-dimensional optical switch, we succeeded to observe conversion of 1 Tbit/s serial femtosecond laser pulses into parallel pulses.

articleTitle: High average power, 10 W Ti:sapphire laser amplifier system using downchirped pulse amplification
abstract: We demonstrate a single stage ultrafast laser system that is capable of up to 10.7 W of average power at 10 kHz repetition frequency and employs a glass pulse compressor.

articleTitle: Photonic logic NOR gate using two symmetric microring resonators
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical NOR logic gate which consists of two cascaded and symmetric GaAs-AlGaAs microring resonators. The switching energy of the device is 20 pJ/pulse and the switching window is 40 ps

articleTitle: Use of 4f pulse shaper as an active carrier-envelope phase shifter
Direct measurement of resonant frequencies for H/sub 2/O in the range of 0.2-4.2 THz by frequency-tuning monochromatic THz source
abstract: Absorption lines in the range of 0.2-4.2 THz for the distilled water and water vapor in the atmosphere have directly been measured for the first time by tuning a coherent and monochromatic THz source.

articleTitle: THz spectroscopy of selected gasoline samples
abstract: We report THz spectroscopic measurement of selected gasoline (#87, #89, and #93) in 5 cm/sup -1/ to 650 cm/sup -1/ region by using Fourier transform far infrared spectroscopy and time-domain THz spectroscopy. New absorption resonances are identified.

articleTitle: Efficient 879 nm-LD pumped Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ laser and its thermal characteristics
abstract: We realized ah 879 nm-LD-pumped Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ laser with maximum slope efficiency of 78%. Thermal conductivity and the thermal lens effect were measured for characterization of the thermal property of the laser.

articleTitle: UV Rayleigh lidar for measuring atmospheric temperature profiles of the troposphere
abstract: A new scheme of UV Rayleigh scattering lidar has been developed for profiling daytime temperature distribution of the troposphere with a compact system. Measurement accuracy of 1-K was obtained at 2-km in daytime.

articleTitle: Integrated semiconductor bio-fluorescence sensor integrated on micro-fluidic platform
abstract: A VCSEL, PIN photodiode and emission filter are monolithically integrated to create a near infrared bio-fluorescence sensor. The theoretical detection limit of IR-800 fluorescent dye was determined to be 40 nM on a microfluidic platform.

articleTitle: Re-circulating loop for programmable true-time delay in an optical beamformer
