abstract: A cost effective, high speed and programmable true-time-delay optical beamformer based on recirculating loop with few nanoseconds beamsteering speed is proposed. This technique can drastically reduce number of components. Experimental results for proof-of-concept are presented.

articleTitle: A novel thermal tuning technique of fiber grating
abstract: A novel thermal tuning technique of fiber grating named double-shoulder beam is, for the first time, proposed, theoretically analyzed and experimentally investigated. With this technique, thermal sensitivity of the grating can be designed freely.

articleTitle: Modulational instability in discrete optics
abstract: We observed, for the first time, the breakup of a wide high intensity beam due to modulational instability in the normal diffraction region of a discrete optical system and its absence in the anomalous regime.

articleTitle: Mode and wavelength selectivity of a distributed-feedback optical parametric oscillator
abstract: We present a coupled-wave theory to show that a distributed-feedback optical parametric oscillator has both longitudinal-mode selectivity and wavelength selectivity. Experimental progress toward this source in bulk and waveguide nonlinear optical materials will be reported.

articleTitle: White-light continuum z-scan technique for nonlinear materials characterization
abstract: We present a rapid characterization technique for nonlinear absorption and refraction: the white-light continuum z-scan. The broadband nature of this pump permits us to measure the two-photon absorption spectrum of ZnSe using only one beam.

articleTitle: Far-fields of photonic crystal microcavity lasers
abstract: The far-field radiation patterns from sapphire-bonded photonic crystal microcavity lasers were measured. Good agreement was obtained between experimental results and numerical predictions.

articleTitle: High power CW Tm:YLF laser with a holographic output coupler
abstract: We report a diode-pumped, CW Tm:YLF laser, with a volume holographic grating in photo-thermo-refractive glass as an output coupler. The Tm-laser operated at 1940 nm with output power exceeding 30 W.

articleTitle: 5 GHz optically cross-gain modulation induced mode-locking of semiconductor optical amplifier
abstract: With the backward injection of sub-bandgap-wavelength single-mode DFB laser diode, the build-up dynamics of a 5-GHz repetitive, <12-ps and 10.5-mW harmonic-mode-locked semiconductor optical amplifier fiber laser induced by purely sinusoidal cross-gain-modulation effect are analyzed.

articleTitle: Optical properties of the output of a high-gain, self-amplified free-electron laser
abstract: The temporal structure and phase evolutions of a high-gain, self-amplified free-electron laser are measured, including single-shot analysis and statistics over many shots. Excellent agreement with the theory of free-electron laser and photon statistics is found.

articleTitle: Room-temperature, mid-IR (/spl lambda/ = 4.7 /spl mu/m) electroluminescence from single-stage intersubband GaAs-based edge emitters
abstract: Strong room-temperature intersubband-emission is obtained at 4.7 microns by using deep quantum wells and high barriers in the active region. The emission linewidth is narrow (/spl sim/20 meV) and the 80 K to 300 K emission ratio is low (/spl sim/2).

articleTitle: Characterization of FWM in EAM using picosecond pulses and its application to high-speed optical signal processing
abstract: FWM in EAM shows wide wavelength operating range and enhanced conversion efficiency with reverse bias. Simultaneous optical demultiplexing and clock recovery using FWM in EAM at 80 Gbit/s is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Using differential confocal microscopy to study voltage-induced membrane movements of lipid vesicles
abstract: Voltage-induced lipid-vesicle membrane movements are characterized with differential confocal microscopy. Deformations are three orders of magnitude larger than those measured on cells using atomic force microscopy. Data are consistent with a model from energy conservation.

articleTitle: Ultra-low-loss, high-Q, four-port resonant couplers
abstract: Ultra-low-loss four-port resonant filters (add/drop geometry) using ultra-high-Q toroid micro-cavities on a chip with waveguide-to-waveguide drop efficiency of 93%, and throughput extinction of 33 dB for narrow bandwidth (57 MHz) operation are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Efficient generation of isolated attosecond pulses through relativistic effects
abstract: Focusing relativistic-intensity pulses to the wavelength scale in plasma leads to the formation of isolated attosecond pulses with ten percent efficiency in simulations. Experiments show this relativistic electron motion is present at 5/spl times/10/sup 17/ W/cm/sup 2/.

articleTitle: A new method for inducing losses using periodic electrodes in electro-optic micro-ring resonators
abstract: A new method for inducing losses by coupling the guided mode to radiation modes using a periodic electric filed in electro-optic micro-resonators is introduced. The coupling of the guided mode to radiation modes is calculated.

articleTitle: Compact high-repetition rate, widely tunable modelocked fiber laser and Raman soliton wavelength converter based on photonic crystal fibers
abstract: We report mode-locked lasers that produce 1-ps, 10-GHz pulses using intracavity pulse compression in photonic crystal fiber (PCF). Moreover, the output pulses were wavelength-shifted by 100 nm and transformed to sub-200-fs-solitons using self-frequency shift in PCF.

articleTitle: GaInNAs and quantum dot lasers - GaAs-based lasers for telecommunications
abstract: The work reviews on the status of GaAs-based lasers for the 1.3 to 1.5 /spl mu/m range with GaInNAs active layers as well as based on In(Ga)As quantum dots (QD). Routes for further improvements like the use of GaInNAsSb as proposed by J. Harris et al., Stanford, will be discussed.

articleTitle: High power, 775 nm, quasi-CW and CW second-harmonic-generation of linearly-polarized fiber source in PPKTP
abstract: An Yb-Er, PM-format, narrow-line, quasi-CW fibre source is demonstrated and used for >25 W average power (>76%-efficient) SHG in PPKTP. A pure-CW operation is also demonstrated with >3 W power and possible fiber delivery in 765-785 nm range.

articleTitle: Portable ultrafast blue light sources
abstract: An effective means of achieving a portable, ultrafast blue-light source using a variety of nonlinear media is demonstrated. We investigate the relative merits of aperiodically-poled bulk and waveguide nonlinear crystals in comparison to periodically-poled structures.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked Nd:YAlO/sub 3/ lasers at 930 nm and 1341 nm
abstract: We report on passively mode-locked Nd:YAlO lasers producing Fourier-limited 1.7 ps long pulses with an average output-power of 1.7 W at 930 nm and 0.5 W at 1341 nm in diffraction-limited beams at a repetition-rate of 160 MHz

articleTitle: Optical parametric oscillation based on periodically-poled 1 mol% MgO-doped stoichiometric LiTaO/sub 3/
abstract: OPO was demonstrated in periodically-poled MgO-doped stoichiometric LiTaO/sub 3/ with 35-mm length and 1-mm thickness. Slope efficiency was /spl sim/ 65 % at RT without photorefraction and maximum output power was 655 mW at 1.3 W pumping.

articleTitle: Generation and characterization of the highest laser intensities (10/sup 22/ W/cm/sup 2/)
abstract: The highest intensity of 0.8x10<sup>22</sup> W/cm<sup>2</sup> was achieved by using a large NA paraboloid conixted by a deformable mirror. Focused intensity with high spatial resolution is calculated from the precise wavefront characterization

articleTitle: LD pumped Yb:YAG micro-thickness slab laser with high-power and high-efficiency oscillation
abstract: A high-power and high-efficiency Yb:YAG oscillator with a micro-thickness slab structure has been developed. Laser output power of 260 W was obtained in cw oscillation with 42% optical conversion efficiency

articleTitle: Short pulse eyesafe solid state Raman laser
abstract: We present results of a solid state Raman laser that is transversely pumped by a Nd:YAG laser. A novel resonator configuration allows active compression of the Nd:YAG pump pulse into a short pulse, eyesafe output.

articleTitle: Stability of near- and mid-infrared free-space links under strong scattering environment
abstract: The stability of analog and digital free-space optical links operating in the near-infrared (830 nm, 1300 nm and 1550 nm) and mid-infrared (8 /spl mu/m) are compared under the influence of strong scattering media within a wind tunnel.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave single-mode bound-to-continuum quantudi-cascade lasers on TE-cooler at 5.4/spl mu/m
Autosoliton propagation at 80 Gbit/s in standard fibre using in-line nonlinear loop switches
abstract: Experimental observation of autosoliton propagation in a nonlinear switch-guided, dispersion-managed system operating at 80 Gbit/s is reported for the first time. The system is based on a strong dispersion map and supports autosoliton propagation over 3000 km.

articleTitle: Electroabsorption of GaInNAs and GaInNAsSb quantum wells at 1300 and 1550 nm
abstract: Electroabsorption spectra were measured for GaInNAs and GaInNAsSb quantum wells around 1300 and 1550 nm, respectively, for use in modulators for telecommunication and optical interconnects. Fine structure of band edge transitions were further studied with photoluminescence and electroreflectance.

articleTitle: Measurement of angular deviation in ultra-linear mirror actuators for scanning high finesse resonators
abstract: We describe a new method for measuring angular deviations of linear actuators as small as 0.1 /spl mu/rad//spl mu/m. Two designs of ultra-linear actuators for cavity ring-down spectroscopy are characterized and compared by achievable sensitivity.

articleTitle: Femtosecond nonlinear phase dispersion of GaAs/AlGaAs quantum wells
abstract: We determined the femtosecond nonlinear phase and amplitude spectra in GaAs/AlGaAs quantum wells using a polarization-division Sagnac interferometer. The nonlinear dispersion around the excitonic resonance can be explained by ultrafast neutralization of the built-in field.

articleTitle: Ar/sup +/ beam etched Ti:sapphire rib waveguides: a route for the development of broadband fluorescence and channel laser sources
abstract: Ar/sup +/-beam-milled rib waveguides were fabricated in pulsed-laser-deposited Ti:sapphire films and overgrown by a 5 /spl mu/m thick sapphire layer to reduce losses. They show broadband single transverse-mode fluorescence emission and potential for development of laser sources.

articleTitle: Self-assembled DNA molecules conjugated to GaN semiconductor nanostructures for radiative decay engineering
abstract: This study aims to develop a highly luminescent biomaterial system that can be conjugated to weakly fluorescing biological molecules for the development of biosensors. The surface and interface properties of a hybrid semiconductor-metal-organic layered structures that affect the optical properties of the system for developing nanophotonic bioprobes is presented. The proposed strategy is dependent on resonant energy transfer between fluorescently labeled receptors via a metallic interface. The novelty of the approach lies in exploiting the link between bioconjugated DNA nucleosides sensing units with GaN quantum dots using fluorescent radiative decay engineering via resonant surface plasmon interaction.

articleTitle: Velocity profile sensor using a frequency modulated laser diode and a molecular absorption cell
abstract: The Doppler frequency shift of scattered light is detected by using an absorption cell. Evaluation of the 1st and 2nd harmonics of amplitude modulated light yields the Doppler frequency without power influences.

articleTitle: High power laser diode array module with 145 kW peak power for inertial fusion energy driver
abstract: A quasi-cw AlGaAs laser diode array module with peak power of 145 kW was developed. High electrical to optical conversion efficiency of 52% and stable wavelength characteristic was achieved with the efficient cooling system.

articleTitle: Single-shot high-order-harmonic spectra in the multi-optical-cycle regime: first evidence of carrier-envelope-phase effects
abstract: For the first time we show, both experimentally and theoretically, that the spectral characteristics of the harmonic emission generated by light pulses in the multi-optical-cycle regime are significantly affected by the pulse carrier-envelope phase.

articleTitle: Tunable electro-optically cavity-dumped RF excited z-fold waveguide CO/sub 2/ laser with two channels
abstract: In order to provide ideal light source for coherent laser radar, we designed z-fold electro-optically cavity-dumped RF excited waveguide CO/sub 2 /laser with two channels. One channel served as transmitter laser include z-fold waveguide resonator with electrooptically modulated system can output cavity-dumped laser. The pulse width can be tuned from 18 ns to 32 ns. Another single channel used as local laser can output CW laser. The two channels are excited by the same RF source. This kind of structure has the advantages of high offset frequency stability, low cost, easy manufacturing and small size over two separated lasers.

articleTitle: Parabolic pulse generation directly from a Ti:sapphire oscillator
abstract: We present experimental and theoretical work on the production of parabolic pulses from a Kerr-lens mode-locked Ti:sapphire laser operated in the positive dispersion regime. We anticipate applications for high-energy oscillators and ultra-high-contrast amplifiers.

articleTitle: Suppression of intensity noise in a diode-pumped Yb:YAG laser
abstract: We investigate the intensity noise of a 1.031 /spl mu/m diode-pumped Yb:YAG laser. An active feedback loop to reduce intensity noise by relaxation oscillation provided an intensity noise reduction of -40 dB was achieved.

articleTitle: RZ to CSRZ format conversion using all-optical clock recovery and electro-optical modulation
abstract: Return-to-zero (RZ) to carrier-suppressed RZ (CSRZ) format conversion was experimentally demonstrated at 40 Gb/s. Retiming and CSRZ pulse regeneration were accomplished all-optically. The converted CSRZ signal had timing jitter of 0.6 ps and extinction ratio of 15 dB

articleTitle: Generation of turquoise light by SFM a DPSSL and a laser diode in a single-pass configuration
abstract: A simple and efficient blue-green source at 492 nm with 4 mW output power was demonstrated by frequency mixing a diode-pumped solid-state laser and a laser diode.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon enhanced THz transmission of subwavelength metallic structures
abstract: We present experimental results of THz transmission through a subwavelength hole array. Sharp phase peaks centered on the surface plasmon resonances are observed. The transmission magnitude has the shape of the derivative of this peak.

articleTitle: Multi-watt cw broadband light sources for optical coherence radar and coherence tomography based on InGaAs tapered laser amplifiers
abstract: We report on InGaAs tapered amplifier systems which provide 900 nm radiation in a narrow beam with output powers of up to 2.5 W and spectral widths exceeding 20 nm.

articleTitle: High-power continuous-wave 266 and 213-nm generation with CsLiB/sub 6/O/sub 10/ crystals
abstract: 5.0 W of cw deep-UV radiation at 266 nm has been generated by external enhancement cavity with a Brewster-cut CsLiB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> crystal. By cascading sum-frequency mixing, 106 mW of cw radiation at 213 nm has also been generated

articleTitle: 40-Gbit/s 32-bit optical packet compressor/decompressor based on a photonic memory
abstract: We propose an optical packet compressor/decompressor with a spectral-width conversion capability using a CMOS memory sandwiched between all-optical serial-to-parallel and photonic parallel-to-serial converters. We demonstrate the 40-to-80-Gbit/s compression and 40-to-10-Gbit/s decompression of 32-bit optical packets.

articleTitle: 400-photon-per-pulse ultrashort pulse autocorrelation measurement with aperiodically poled lithium niobate waveguides at 1.55 /spl mu/m
abstract: We demonstrate accurate ultrashort pulse autocorrelation measurements for coupled energy of 52 aJ per pulse using aperiodically poled lithium niobate waveguides. The corresponding sensitivity is 3.2/spl times/10/sup -7/ mW/sup 2/, about 500 times better than the previous record.

articleTitle: Semiconductor ring lasers with large ring cavity: Directional switching and electrical diagnostics
abstract: Integrated semiconductor ring lasers with 1-cm cavity length are fabricated and characterized. Directional switching is observed and a pumped S-section is used to suppress it. The lasing threshold is identified by differential I-V measurements.

articleTitle: Advanced modulation formats for long-haul optical transmission systems
abstract: New modulation formats targeting long distance transmission should perform as well or better than RZ while providing other desirable attributes such as dispersion tolerance and spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: High speed CClG laser with tailored modulation transfer functions
abstract: The modulation transfer function can be changed from broadband to high frequency narrow band by using a coupled cavity injection grating (CCIG) laser design. Higher order photon-photon resonances are utilized to tailor the modulation function.

articleTitle: All-optical coherent stopping and storage of light
abstract: We show that light can be stopped and stored coherently with an all-optical adiabatic bandwidth compression process, without any coherent or resonant light-matter interactions. Such a process overcomes the fundamental bandwidth-delay constraint in optics.

articleTitle: Optically generated radio frequency signals by sub-harmonically injection locked semiconductor lasers
abstract: The heterodyne beating of two laser signals synchronized on different modulation sidebands of another laser results in a spectrally pure radio frequency signal when the lasers spectra, injection rate, and frequency detuning are simultaneously optimized.

articleTitle: Comparison of Er/sup 3+/ absorption-emission properties in tellurite and ultra highly doped Al-silica fibers
abstract: We present a comparison of the erbium optical properties of doped Al-silica and tellurite fibers. Absorption-emission spectra show a higher and flatter signal gain over shorter lengths in TeO/sub 2/ and lower losses of Al/sub 2/O/sub 3/-SiO/sub 2/ fibers.

articleTitle: Cascaded four-wave mixing in a femtosecond optical parametric oscillator
abstract: We demonstrate multiple cascaded four-wave mixing processes in a periodically poled KTP optical parametric oscillator operating near the degeneracy point

articleTitle: Temporal and spatial compression of near-resonant pulses in a nonlinear defocusing semiconductor
abstract: The coupled spatiotemporal characteristics of subpicosecond pulses propagating in the nonlinear defocusing regime near the band edge of bulk GaAs are investigated experimentally and theoretically. We demonstrate pulse compression both in time and transverse space.

articleTitle: Tunable diode laser sensors for practical combustion applications
abstract: Diode lasers offer the opportunity for wavelength-tunable absorption-based sensors for practical combustion applications. Wavelength-multiplexed diode lasers are used to monitor multiple absorption features of product water vapor and other combustion emissions. Progress in the development of robust sensors for variety of practical applications including ground test of new aero-engine concepts and practical industrial combustors.

articleTitle: Terabit all-optical logic using ultrafast two-dimensional optical switch
abstract: Terabit all-optical complementary logic using two successive time slots to represent a logical status is proposed. An organic molecular device was used as an ultrafast optical switch. Proof-of-principle experiments were demonstrated with 400-fs interval pulses.

articleTitle: Time resolved harmonic generation from noble-gas clusters
abstract: Third-harmonic generation from noble-gas clusters by ultrashort probe pulses is more sharply resonantly-enhanced than linear absorption following heating by an ultrashort pump pulse. Simulations of cluster expansion and collective electron dynamics reproduce the observed trends.

articleTitle: Self-organized nanostructures and related phenomena in glass irradiated. by ultrashort light pulses
abstract: The study of the smallest (20 nm width) and strongest (-0:1 index change) embedded periodic structures ever created by light in transparent materials are reported. These are the first gratings created by light-matter (electronplasma) interference.

articleTitle: Absolute distance measurement with 0.1 /spl mu/m accuracy using the MSTAR sensor
abstract: The MSTAR sensor uses the phase modulation sidebands on a stable laser carrier frequency as the multiple 'colors' needed for absolute distance measurement. A range resolution of 0.1 /spl mu/m has been achieved in the lab.

articleTitle: Single shot temporal characterization of sub-hundred femtosecond electron bunches at the SLAC SPPS experiment
abstract: Electro-optic sampling (EOS) is used to temporally characterize compressed ultra-relativistic electron bunches at the Stanford linear accelerator center (SLAC). These electron bunches are used to produce ultrafast X-rays at the sub-picosecond pulse source experiment (SPPS).

articleTitle: Signal processing with guided-wave optical filters
abstract: Optical signal processing applications employing amplitude, phase and polarization filtering are discussed for implementations using silica-on-silicon planar waveguides. Applications include tunable chromatic dispersion compensators, polarization control and monitoring, PMD emulation and compensation, and ultra-narrowband filtering.

articleTitle: High power continuous-wave operation of side-pumped Yb:YAG thin disk laser
abstract: We have developed a side-pumped Yb:YAG thin disk laser combining the pump-beam focusing technique with the Yb:YAG/YAG composite disk structure. The output power of 235 W was obtained with the optical efficiency of 0.375

articleTitle: Novel high-gain/broadband glasses for Raman gain applications
abstract: Different glass families have been evaluated for their Raman gain performance. Raman cross-section calculations and Raman gain coefficient estimations are reported. The estimated and experimentally measured Raman gain coefficients for bulk samples show excellent agreement.

articleTitle: Picometer laser metrology for the space interferometry mission (SIM)
abstract: This paper reports the progress on displacement measuring laser heterodyne interferometers for the SIM program. We will also describe the technical approaches and results from ground testbeds.

articleTitle: Electro-optic tuning of a periodically poled LiNbO/sub 3/ optical parametric oscillator and mixing its output waves to generate mid-IR tunable from 9.4 -10.5 /spl mu/m
abstract: We demonstrate electro-optic spectral tuning in an optical parametric oscillator employing a segmented periodically poled LiNbO/sub 3/ (PPLN) crystal. The signal and idler waves obtained, are difference-frequency-mixed to produce mid-IR tunable from /spl sim/ 10.5 to /spl sim/ 9.4 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Optically active contrast agents for molecular imaging of cancer
abstract: We describe a comprehensive strategy to develop inexpensive, rugged and portable optical imaging systems for molecular imaging of cancer, which couples the development of optically active contrast agents with advances in functional genomics of cancer.

articleTitle: Efficient input and output coupling between planar photonic crystal waveguides and fiber tapers
abstract: Highly efficient (> 94%) contradirectional coupling into and out of a photonic crystal waveguide is measured using a fiber taper probe as both a source and a collector.

articleTitle: Advances in fibre Bragg gratings and application to fibre lasers
abstract: This paper will review design techniques, device requirements and characteristics of fibre Bragg gratings for use as telecomm's filters and for incorporation in fibre lasers.

articleTitle: Range-Doppler radar signal processing with spectral holography
abstract: Spectral holographic crystals can record the cross-power spectrum of RF signals modulated onto optical carriers and perform range-Doppler processing of gigahertz radar signals, resolving Doppler shifts up to 100 kilohertz with /spl sim/130 Hertz resolution.

articleTitle: Micromirrors for wafer-scale fabrication of electrically-pumped VECSELs
abstract: We describe the performance of a compact electrically-pumped vertical-external-cavity surface-emitting laser (VECSEL) that is designed for mass production. Instead of using a bulk external mirror, we have incorporated a micromirror fabricated by wafer-scale precision molding.

articleTitle: Low-noise, CW-pumped holey-fiber based continuum sources around 1300 nm
abstract: We analyzed noise, temporal and spectral-power-density properties of 5.5 W, CW Raman-soliton continua with >300 nm bandwidth around 1.3 /spl mu/m generated in a holey-fibre pumped by Yb-fibre sources. Fibre-laser and MOPFA pumping configurations are compared.

articleTitle: Continuous wave, all-fibre broad-band sources for optical coherence tomography
abstract: We demonstrate in vivo OCT imaging with < 5 um resolution in tissue at ~1.3 mum wavelength using a new compact, CW, 330 mW, 140 nm bandwidth, holey-fibre continuum light source pumped by a single-mode Yb-fibre laser

articleTitle: Pulsed light absorption induced quantum well intermixing on InGaAsP/InGaAsP MQW using 532 nm irradiation
abstract: Pulsed light absorption at 532 nm induces and achieves 45 nm blue-shifts of the bandgap but no shift at 1064 nm, when the maximal fluence is 125 mJ/cm/sup 2/.

articleTitle: Quantum-dot based saturable absorber with p-n junction for mode locking of solid-state lasers
abstract: We demonstrate stable mode locking in a Yb:KYW laser by using a quantum-dot saturable absorber structure with p-n-junction. A reduction in the output pulse duration was measured when a reverse bias was applied to SESAM.

articleTitle: Pulse compression in a photonic-crystal-fiber of a diode-pumped Yb:SYS oscillator and production of 23-fs pulses
abstract: We demonstrated the production of 23-fs pulses centered at 1070 nm using a photonic crystal fiber for nonlinear pulse compression of a 110 fs diode-pumped Yb:SYS laser.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked 900 nm picosecond fiber laser
abstract: We demonstrate a Nd-doped fiber laser passively mode-locked with semiconductor saturable absorber in the 894-909 nm spectral range. Self-started operation has been achieved in soliton-supporting dispersion regime, generating 360-fs pulses, and in stretched-pulse mode-locking regime.

articleTitle: Influence of fixed and sliding in-line filtering on phase jitter
abstract: We study the influence of fixed and sliding in-line filtering on the phase jitter in dispersion-managed and constant-dispersion systems. Only fixed filtering allows an efficient reduction of phase jitter.

articleTitle: Use of scanning Hartmann sensor for in situ characterization of wavefront distortions in thermally loaded optical components
abstract: Thermal distortions induced by absorption of laser radiation in coating of high reflectivity mirror placed in vacuum are investigated numerically and experimentally. Obtained data allow forecasting the behavior of the gravitation wave detector interferometer.

articleTitle: 400-nm band high power lasers
abstract: We have successfully realized high power 400 nm band lasers. The kink power exceeds 150 mW from 20 /spl deg/C to 80 /spl deg/C under continuous wave operation adopting a new ridge structure and appropriately designed layer structure.

articleTitle: Deep-notch and ultra-compact long-period grating in large-mode-area photonic crystal fiber
abstract: A strong resonance and ultra-compact long-period grating is fabricated in large-mode-area photonic crystal fiber with LP/sub 01/ notch of -31.5 dB at wavelength of 1529.2 nm, and 8 periodic collapses within 2.8-mm-long fiber by using CO/sub 2/ laser.

articleTitle: Influence of molecular structure on double ionization N/sub 2/ and O/sub 2/ in high intensity ultra-short laser pulses
abstract: The paper reports on the first differential investigations on double ionization of N/sub 2/ and O/sub 2/ in order to identify the molecular non-sequential double ionization (NSDI) mechanism and to investigate possible effects of the initial bound molecular state on NSDI.

articleTitle: Dependence of parabolic pulse evolution and compression on SRS threshold
abstract: Limiting effects caused by stimulated Raman scattering on parabolic pulse compression in high power/energy Yb-fiber amplifiers are determined using an analytical model. Numerical simulations verify the analytical results.

articleTitle: Thermo-optical parameters measured in potassium-gadolinium-tungstate
abstract: By accurately measuring the values of dn/dT, thermal expansion coefficients, and indices of refraction for KGd(WO/sub 4/)/sub 2/ (KGW), the athermal orientation for the propagation direction and polarization is determined.

articleTitle: Comparison of bit-error ratios for receiver models with integrate-and-dump and realistic electrical filters using the Gaussian approximation
abstract: A comparison of receiver models with integrate-and-dump and Bessel electrical filters, using the Gaussian approximation of the voltage probability density functions, show that the bit-error ratios are comparable but the decision thresholds differ significantly.

articleTitle: Generation of 2 W cw output power at 457 nm based on a frequency doubled Nd:YVO/sub 4/ thin disc laser
abstract: An efficient, compact blue light source based on an intracavity frequency doubled Nd:YVO/sub 4/ thin disc laser is presented. The laser outputs up to 2 W at a wavelength of 457 nm. In a second resonator configuration 1.5 W was achieved with a near diffraction limited beam.

articleTitle: Efficient generation of coherent soft-X-ray radiation extending beyond the titanium L-edge
abstract: We report the generation of high harmonic radiation from 200 eV to 700 eV. The 1 kHz 10 fs 3 mJ TW laser system provides the conditions for the nonadiabatic self-phase-matching

articleTitle: Efficiently seeded diode pumped laser at 0.946 /spl mu/m
abstract: Seeding of a Nd:YAG diode pumped Q-switched laser at 0.946 /spl mu/m has been accomplished using electronic resonator length control. This approach is extremely efficient with seeding occurring over 99% of the time.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon enhanced light emitting efficiencies of InGaN/GaN quantum wells
abstract: We report a dramatic increase in the light emitting efficiency of InGaN/GaN resulting from surface plasmon interaction between the quantum wells and evaporated silver layers, whereas no such enhancement was obtained from gold deposited samples.

articleTitle: Measurement of broadband gain spectrum of semiconductor optical amplifiers using a two-section technique
abstract: A two-section technique is used to measure gain spectrum of semiconductor optical amplifiers. Without other external setup, broadband gain spectrum is measured for a spectral range of 290 nm with the gain of above 30 cm/sup -1/.

articleTitle: Direct imaging through scattering media using THG in organic materials
abstract: We report on real-time, time-gated, direct imaging through scattering media with an attenuation of 14 mean-free paths using THG in the eye-safe and telecommunication-compatible near-infrared spectral region (1550 nm)

articleTitle: Strain engineered Ge photodetectors on Si platform for broad band optical communications
abstract: This paper presents a strain engineering of Ge photodetectors on Si to cover both C-band and L-band. This high responsivity, Si-CMOS compatible device has promising applications in the next generation of broad band optical communications.

articleTitle: Highly sensitive differential tomographic technique for real-time ultrashort pulse characterization
abstract: We present a highly sensitive real-time optical pulse characterization technique based on differential chronocyclic tomography. Sub 10-/spl mu/W sensitivity and update rates up to 66 Hz are demonstrated.

articleTitle: GaInNAsSb/GaNAs VCSELs at 1.46 /spl mu/m
abstract: We present electrically pumped GaInNAsSb VCSELs at 1.46 mum, the longest wavelength on GaAs to date. At -20 C, pulsed at 0.1% duty cycle, the threshold current density was 4.5 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, with a peak output power of 0.77 mW

articleTitle: Using the extrusion technique to fashion amorphous channel waveguide lasers
abstract: We report the first neodymium-doped amorphous channel waveguide laser through extrusion. Single-mode operation was observed at 1058 nm for a 10 mm long channel waveguide. An output power of 13.3 mW with 36% slope efficiency was measured.

articleTitle: Influence of signal digitization on the master-slave synchronization in chaos-encrypted data transmission
abstract: Digitization of chaos-encrypted data could allow the use of advanced transmission techniques that are resistant to channel impairments. We describe in this paper the impact of digitization on the synchronization between receiver and emitter.

articleTitle: Reliable RT CW operation of GaInAsP/InP multiple-quantum-wire lasers fabricated by dry etching and regrowth method
abstract: A RT-CW operation of GaInAsP/InP 5-stacked quantum-wire lasers (23 nm wide) fabricated by EB lithography, CH/sub 4//H/sub 2/-RIE and OMVPE regrowth was achieved. No significant changes in performance were observable even after 7100 h under the RT-CW condition.

articleTitle: UV direct writing of low loss waveguides at 1.5 /spl mu/m in single crystal LiNbO/sub 3/
abstract: Single mode channel waveguides at a wavelength of 1.52 /spl mu/m have been fabricated in the +z-face of congruent single crystal lithium niobate using c.w. UV laser illumination at 244 nm. Propagation losses of 0.21 dB cm/sup -1/ have been calculated from cut-back measurements.

articleTitle: Employing optical SSB modulation technique in full-duplex radio-on-fiber transport systems
abstract: A full-duplex radio-on-fiber (ROF) transport system based on optical single sideband (SSB) modulation, wavelength-division-multiplexing (WDM) and optical add-drop multiplexing techniques is proposed and demonstrated. Over a long-haul fiber link, low bit error rate (BER) and third order intermodulation distortion to carrier ratio (IMD/sub 3//C) values were obtained in our proposed full-duplex ROF transport systems. Such a proposed full-duplex ROF transport system is suitable for the long-haul microwave optical link.

articleTitle: Simultaneous generation of eight channels with 20 nm spectral spacing from one single semiconductor laser
abstract: With proper control of the loss for each channel, simultaneous generation of eight wavelengths spanning from 1367.1 nm to 1526.9 nm with about 20 nm channel spacing is achieved from a single semiconductor laser.

articleTitle: Down-conversion and entangled photon pairs
abstract: Degenerate down-conversion in photonic crystals is investigated as a source of entangled photons. Phase matching relies on form birefringence and on a change in phase velocity near the band edge of the photonic crystal.

articleTitle: Directional coupling and switching in multi-core microstructure fibers
abstract: A systematic study of directional coupling in dual- and multi-core microstructure fibers is presented. We introduce a fully three-dimensional, efficient and versatile method for modeling light propagation in index-guiding microstructure fibers. Using this model, the coupling length for the two most efficient configurations (/spl radic/3/spl Lambda/ and 2/spl Lambda/ inter-core separation) is determined as a function of the structural parameters (hole diameter and pitch) and wavelength.

articleTitle: Tailoring defect modes in waveguide arrays
abstract: We theoretically predict and experimentally confirm the existence of various types of localized modes at inhomogeneities in otherwise homogenous waveguide arrays. By varying the defect guide single- and multi-mode behavior can be induced.

articleTitle: Ultrafast nonlinear tuning of photonic coupling resonance in AlGaAs photonic crystal waveguides
abstract: Time-resolved and power-dependent pump-probe spectroscopy determines that two-photon absorption induces a strong blue-shift of coupling resonances in a photonic crystal waveguide. Carrier relaxation times are shortened by the surface recombination, showing potential for all-optical switching.

articleTitle: Suppression of group velocity dispersion and diffraction of pulsed beams in optical parametric amplifiers
abstract: It is revealed that suppression of temporal and spatial spread of pulsed beams can be achieved by linear parametric amplification. An effective reduction of beam diffraction in degenerate parametric amplifier is demonstrated experimentally.

articleTitle: Analysis of compressed 3.4 fs-optical pulse based on deviation from its Fourier-transform-limited pulse using Wigner distribution function
abstract: Time-frequency analysis of monocycle-region optical pulses was performed using the Wigner distribution function. The difference between the normalized Wigner distribution functions for a measured pulse and its Fourier-transform-limited pulse provides detailed information of their deviations.

articleTitle: Noise dependent buildup of multiple pulses in mode-locked lasers along with a cascade of phase transitions
abstract: Successive formation and destruction of pulses in passive mode-locked lasers occur with a series of phase transitions, as noise (or power) is varied. We present experimental demonstration and a statistical-mechanics theory, including "thermodynamic" phase diagrams.

articleTitle: Kerr-lens mode-locked diode-pumped Yb:YAG laser
abstract: We report what we believe to be the first demonstration of a Kerr-lens mode-locked diode-pumped Yb:YAG laser. The spectral width is 30 nm, which corresponds to 38 fs of pulse duration assuming Fourier-transform-limited sech-shaped pulses.

articleTitle: Carbon nanotubes based coatings for laser power and energy measurements using thermal detectors
abstract: We describe the spectral responsivity, spatial uniformity, and other properties of thermal-detector coatings based on carbon nanotubes. Such coatings may form the basis of the next generation of standards for laser power and energy metrology.

articleTitle: Polarization transformations by engineering space-variant inhomogeneous media on subwavelength scale
abstract: Radially and azimuthally polarized beams are highly desired for many applications. We proposed to engineer such beams using space-variant inhomogeneous media (SVIM) on subwavelength scale. We conducted optical experiment providing such polarization states with high purity.

articleTitle: Ring-assisted Sagnac frequency discriminator
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated that the linearity of Sagnac frequency discriminator could be improved by adding an intra-cavity ring.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave sodium guidestar laser systems
abstract: We discuss laser design and guidestar tests of our continuous-wave, single-frequency, 589-nm laser system based on a doubly resonant sum-frequency ring containing an LBO crystal pumped by 1064 nm and 1319 nm continuous-wave Nd:YAG injection-locked ring lasers

articleTitle: Ultrashort optical pulse generated by four-wave Raman mixing in deuterium cooled at 77 K
abstract: A 100-fs pulse is focused into deuterium cooled at 77 K to generate rotational stimulated Raman emission. By phase locking in the process of four-wave Raman mixing, the laser pulsewidth was reduced to 20-40 fs.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave operation of InAsSb/InP quantum-dot lasers near 2 /spl mu/m at room temperature
abstract: InAsSb quantum-dot lasers near 2 /spl mu/m were demonstrated in cw operation at room temperature with a threshold current density of below 1 kA/cm/sup 2/, output power of 3 mW/facet and a differential quantum efficiency of 13%.

articleTitle: THz-wave generation in slanted PPLN with double injection seeded ppr-PPLN-OPG pumping
abstract: THz-wave generation in slanted PPLN with double injection seeded ppr-PPLN-OPG pumping was demonstrated. THz-wave output energy increased by injection seeding. And the surface emitted THz-wave was tuned from 1.44 to 1.51 THz.

articleTitle: An asymmetric Fabry-Perot all-optical switch in a spin-polarization scheme for serial-to-parallel conversion
abstract: We investigated the optimum structure for an asymmetric Fabry-Perot-type all-optical switch operated in a spin-polarization scheme as regards efficiency and on/off ratios. We also clarified the advantages of the switch for use in serial-to-parallel conversion.

articleTitle: Mutual information as a performance measure for fluorescence optical diffusion tomography
abstract: Mutual information is used to measure performance in fluorescence optical diffusion tomography. By incorporating statistical models of the unknown image, it is shown that multiple modulation frequencies can improve reconstruction quality in certain problems.

articleTitle: Broadband grating coupling of light into waveguides for characterizing photonic crystals
abstract: We report a method of investigating photonic crystals in planar waveguides by coupling short pulses into the waveguide using gratings. With this method the transmission spectrum can be measured within a spectral range of 90 nm.

articleTitle: High resolution radio frequency spectral analysis with photon echo chirp transform in Er:YSO
abstract: The chirp transform algorithm is investigated with photon echoes in a Er:YSO crystal for rf spectral analysis purposes. Thanks to a high spectral purity fiber laser we demonstrate 40 kHz resolution and a time bandwidth product of 500.

articleTitle: Designing multi-core optical fibres for minimal modal dispersion
abstract: A design principle for achieving low modal dispersion in a multi-core fibre with a high packing fill-fraction is presented. The effect is achieved by maximising the coupling between neighbouring cores at the desired operating wavelength.

articleTitle: Tapered micro-photonic crystal fibers
abstract: We report on a novel use of photonic crystal fiber where it is tapered to reduce the pitch spacing and the tapered region is probed transversely at different locations to form a tunable microphotonic device.

articleTitle: Two-photon microscopy reveals that cortical blood flow reverses direction at the first branch that lies downstream from a localized photothrombotic clot
abstract: Using two-photon microscopy, we quantify changes in blood flow after photothrombotic occlusion of individual blood vessels in rat neocortex, and find that flow reverses direction at the first branch that lies downstream from localized clots.

articleTitle: Adaptive spinning-disk interferometry for biosensing
abstract: We have implemented the first adaptive interferometry for biosensing on a spinning disk by two-wave mixing homodyne detection using photorefractive quantum wells. Binding between specific antigen and antibody has been observed using this technique.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal fibers used in a multi-wavelength source and as transmission fiber in a WDM system
abstract: We present a WDM system based entirely on photonic crystal fibers. It includes a novel dispersion flattened highly nonlinear PCF to generate supercontinuum used in a multiwavelength pulse source and a 5.6 km transmission PCF.

articleTitle: Surface-mode behavior of air-core photonic-bandgap fibers
abstract: The relation between core size and surface modes in photonic-bandgap fibers is analyzed through numerical simulations. We present a simple criterion to predict the presence of surface modes and identify novel geometries that support no surface modes.

articleTitle: High power diode-pumped laser technology
abstract: The paper deals with the progress of diode-pumped laser technologies such as rods, fibers, thin-disks, slabs, and even gases , which are all in the running to engineer systems that are scalable to ever higher power.

articleTitle: Probing the atmosphere using a femtosecond terawatt lidar
abstract: We present applications of the nonlinear propagation of ultra-short ultra-intense laser pulses in air for multicomponent remote sensing, aerosol detection by in-situ nonlinear processes, as well as anomalous transmission through clouds.

articleTitle: Wideband and efficient wavelength conversion based on absorption modulation of a Fabry-Perot laser diode
abstract: An wideband and efficient wavelength conversion based on the absorption modulation of a Fabry-Perot laser diode is proposed. The experimental results show an 50 nm wavelength conversion range with more than 10 dB extinction ratios.

articleTitle: The measurement of unstable, ultracomplex, ultrabroadband, ultraweak, ultrashort pulses
abstract: New variations on the FROG technique can measure ultrashort pulses weaker, more complex, and broader-band than thought possible, despite such additional complexities as random absolute phase, poor spatial coherence, and massive shot-to-shot pulse-shape variations.

articleTitle: Short laser pulse compression in air
abstract: A negatively chirped laser pulse propagating in air compresses and focuses resulting in intensity increase and ionization near focal region. Using femtosecond laser we observe pulse compression and focusing that is controlled by induced chirp.

articleTitle: Tunable multichannel filter based on voltage-controllable multiple long-period fiber gratings and its application
abstract: The simple tunable optical multichannel filter based on voltage controllable multiple-cascaded long-period fiber gratings will be proposed and experimentally demonstrated. We will also investigate its application to the multiwavelength generation of Raman fiber ring lasers.

articleTitle: Wavefront correction of a 100 TW high-peak-power, ultrashort laser pulse
abstract: Adaptive optics is installed and demonstrated in JAERI 100 TW laser system to achieve over 10/sup 20/ W/cm/sup 2/ peak intensity at the focal spot.

articleTitle: High-performance 1.5 /spl mu/m coherent Doppler LIDAR for wind-field measurement
abstract: Recent technical progress of fiber-optics and nonlinear wavelength conversion improves the performance of 1.5 /spl mu/m coherent Doppler LIDAR (CDL) dramatically. Our new development of the 1.5 /spl mu/m CDL with all-fiber type transmitter/receiver circuit and optical parametric amplifier is briefly described.

articleTitle: Highly sensitive surface plasmon resonance optical biosensor based on the use of differential phase Mach-Zehnder interferometer
abstract: We propose a novel differential phase technique for improving the performance of surface plasmon resonance (SPR) biosensor systems. Typical prism-coupled schemes use a Mach-Zehnder interferometer to analyze the phase change caused by the SPR effect. In the conventional case, since the probe beam and the reference beam are required to separate into two different optical paths, mechanical drift and vibrations introduces a high level of unwanted noise. In the new scheme, we use a differential phase sensing technique, which means that both the probe beam and reference beam traverse identical optical paths in the system. Experimental results obtained from water/glycerin mixtures show good measurement sensitivity (5.48 /spl times/ 10/sup -8/ refractive index unit) thus demonstrating the performance merit of our technique.

articleTitle: In-situ measurement of the duty-cycle during periodic poling of ferroelectrics domains
abstract: A simple method is proposed to measure the duty cycle for periodic poling of ferroelectrics domains. This non-destructive method is based on monitoring the poling current and has been tested on lithium niobate.

articleTitle: Optical switching systems using nanostructures
abstract: High capacity multiservice optical networks require compact and efficient switches. The potential benefits of optical switch elements based on nanostructured material are reviewed considering various material systems.

articleTitle: Damage of Sc/Si multilayer mirrors exposed to intense nanosecond 46.9 nm laser pulses
abstract: The damage threshold fluence (/spl sim/ 0.08 J/cm/sup 2/) and damage mechanism of extreme ultraviolet Sc/Si multilayer coatings irradiated by 46.9 nm laser pulses of nanosecond duration are reported.

articleTitle: Scattering model of whole blood at hemoglobin glycation monitored by refractive index measurement with OCT
abstract: Scattering coefficient and anisotropy factor of whole blood with glucose have been calculated using Mie theory modified to account for RBC size distribution and packing, and experimental data on OCT measured refractive index of blood. The increase of scattering coefficient and decrease of anisotropy factor were found at elevation of glucose concentration within physiological range.

articleTitle: High-order harmonic generation from argon ions up to 250 eV
abstract: We demonstrate that high harmonic generation from ions can reach higher energies than from neutral atoms. We extend the highest cutoff observed in argon using 800 nm light from 100 eV to 250 eV.

articleTitle: An efficient cw diode-pumped Nd:YVO/sub 4/ laser with reciprocal self-organizing dynamic holographic cavity
abstract: A diode-pumped Nd:YVO/sub 4/ laser with a reciprocal self-intersecting loop cavity completed by dynamic grating induced by the generating beams was realized. Continuous-wave, high-quality beam generation (M/sup 2//spl ap/1) with 10 W power and 32% optical efficiency was obtained.

articleTitle: Generation of 10-GHz similariton pulses using erbium-doped fiber amplifiers for application to multiwavelength sources
abstract: We demonstrate a 10-GHz 'similariton' source using a 1.2 km-long erbium-doped fiber amplifier. The spectrum-sliced pulse of the broadband similariton exhibits excellent noise performance owing to the flat spectrum.

articleTitle: Single fiber bi-directional links using 3D stacked thin film emitters and detectors integrated onto CMOS transceiver circuits
abstract: This study demonstrates the stacking of a GaAs-based thin film emitter directly on top of a InGaAs-based thin film photodetector which is integrated directly onto a Si CMOS transceiver circuit. This is the first demonstration of a mixed material 3D thin film device stack and a 3D device stack integrated onto a Si CMOS integrated circuit.

articleTitle: All fiber high resolution OCT system using an ultrashort pulse high power fiber laser
abstract: High resolution, real time OCT is demonstrated with <10 /spl mu/m in tissue at 1.5-1.6 /spl mu/m wavelengths using high power, low noise broadband spectrum generated by mode-locked stretched-pulse Er doped fiber laser and highly nonlinear fiber.

articleTitle: Dispersion-designed high-delta photonic crystal fiber
abstract: We present high-Delta photonic crystal fibers with specifically designed dispersion properties and illustrate the different nonlinear regimes that are specific to each fiber when ultrafast pulses are coupled into them

articleTitle: Nontrivial dynamics of coherent oscillator with two-movable-species photorefractive crystal
abstract: The semilinear coherent oscillator in photorefractive crystal with pronounced electron-hole competition in formation of space charge grating features in saturation either high contract sinusoidal modulation of the intensity only or simultaneous intensity and phase modulation.

articleTitle: In-line high energy Yb fiber laser based chirped pulse amplifier system
abstract: Chirped-pulse amplification of a modelocked Yb fiber laser in a large mode-area polarization-maintaining Yb-fiber using a nonlinearly-chirped fiber Bragg-grating stretcher is demonstrated. Pulses with 8 nm bandwidth are amplified to 43 /spl mu/J and 1000x recompressed to 900 fs.

articleTitle: Multi-kilowatt, picosecond pulses from an all-fiber chirped pulse amplification system using air-core photonic bandgap fiber
abstract: Multi-kilowatt, /spl sim/1 ps pulses at 1550 nm are obtained from a fully fiber integrated chirped pulse amplification system using a conventional single-mode EDFA, and an air-core photonic bandgap fiber as the compressor. /spl sim/40/spl times/ pulse compression is obtained.

articleTitle: 213 W linearly polarized fundamental mode Nd:YAG ring laser
Second-harmonic blue generation using periodic 90/spl deg/ domain structures in KNbO/sub 3/
abstract: The first demonstration of second harmonic generation using periodic 90/spl deg/ domain structures in KNbO/sub 3/ is presented. A walk-off compensated blue light at 480 nm was generated in the structure with 18.6 /spl mu/m periodicity.

articleTitle: Monitoring of small organic molecules using a broadly-tunable mid-infrared laser source
abstract: Small organic molecules, including acetone, methanol, isopropanol, methane, ethane, and ethylene, can be monitored in real time using a new broadly-tunable mid-infrared laser source. This technique will lead to better process control.

articleTitle: Confocal autofluorescence spectroscopy of biological tissues
abstract: The depth-resolved autofluorescence of biological tissues are investigated with a confocal spectroscopy system. The results are consistent with histology analysis and demonstrate that depth-resolved autofluorescence may provide more diagnostic information to characterize tissue pathology.

articleTitle: Diode-pumped 40-GHz passively mode-locked Nd: YVO/sub 4/ laser with 288-mW average output power
abstract: We present a diode-pumped passively mode-locked Nd:YVO/sub 4/ laser with a repetition rate as high as 40 GHz. The laser generates 288 mW of average output power in 6.5-ps pulses at a wavelength of 1064 nm.

articleTitle: Demonstration of subgigahertz channel demultiplexing based on optical heterodyne detection using a single axial mode from a passively modelocked semiconductor laser local oscillator
abstract: Subgigahertz channel demultiplexing by optical heterodyne detection based on injection locking is reported. The single channel filtered from two amplitude modulated signals detuned by 200 MHz exhibits a signal-to-noise ratio of over 65 dB/Hz.

articleTitle: Low-threshold supercontinuum generation from a compact Cr/sup 4+/:YAG-laser using a soft-glass extruded PCF
abstract: Supercontinuum and third-harmonic generation in two different high-n/sub 2/ extruded photonic crystal fibers was achieved at pulse energies of only 40 pJ, using a compact 60 fs mode-locked Cr/sup 4+/:YAG laser, and studied both, experimentally and theoretically.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked Yb:Y/sub 2/O/sub 3/ ceramic laser with a GaAs saturable absorber mirror
abstract: We report on a diode-pumped passively mode-locked Yb: Y/sub 2/O/sub 3/ ceramic laser by using a GaAs wafer simultaneously as saturable absorber and output coupler. Mode-locked pulses of 1.1 ps with repetition rate of 125 MHz are achieved.

articleTitle: Semiconductor optical amplifiers near 1.3 /spl mu/m based on InGaAs/GaAs quantum dots
abstract: We report fiber-to-fiber gain > 8 dB of a quantum dot amplifier equivalent to a net gain of 0.4 dB/(mm*QD layer). This is to our knowledge the best value achieved so far at 1.3 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Ultrafast all-optical recirculating shift register with SOA-assisted Sagnac switch and SOA feedback
abstract: An all-optical shift register is demonstrated at 10 GHz and 10 Gb/s using a Sagnac interferometer with two semiconductor optical amplifiers for nonlinear switching and feedback amplification. Arbitrary pattern profiles could recirculate stably for hours.

articleTitle: All-optical switching of spatial gap solitons
abstract: We propose a new approach to the soliton switching in periodic structures based on Bloch-wave filtering. We also demonstrate that mobility of gap solitons can be selectively enhanced or suppressed, allowing for precise control of the soliton dynamics.

articleTitle: Radio frequency noise of femto- and picosecond pulse generated supercontinuum spectra
abstract: We evaluate radio-frequency noise generated during supercontinuum generation in photonic crystal fibers. Dramatically reduced noise is observed when seeding with picosecond pulses compared to femtosecond pulses for the same generated bandwidth in the infrared region.

articleTitle: Temperature-dependent vibrational modes of potential estrogenic environmental pollutants measured by terahertz spectroscopy
abstract: Temperature-dependent absorption-spectra measurements in far-infrared of estrogenic pollutants at various temperatures using terahertz spectroscopy are presented. The shifting of absorption peaks with decreasing temperature is ascribed to the collective vibrational modes of the molecule.

articleTitle: Optical and optoelectronic properties of inverse photonic crystals composed of single-wall carbon nanotubes and conductive polymers
abstract: We present linear arid nonlinear optical characteristics as well as electrical properties of photonic crystals and their inverse structures, which are made of conductive polymers imbedded with single wall carbon nanotubes.

articleTitle: Investigation of intervalence band absorption in type-II QW MIR lasers
abstract: We investigate the intervalence band absorption (IVA) in InAs/InGaSb/InAs type-II MIR lasers using a nonlinear pump-probe spectroscopy technique. We resolve the increased IVA cross-section with temperature, its influence on Auger rates and carrier heating.

articleTitle: Coherent coupling of laser diodes using a double phase conjugate mirror
abstract: Long-term and stable coherent coupling of multiple laser diodes was achieved for the first time using a barium titanate double phase-conjugate reflector. Phase locking continued for more than one and half hours by suitable coupling.

articleTitle: OC-192 optical duobinary transmitter using OC-48 nonbuffered Mach-Zehnder modulator
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a cost-effective way to implement an OC-192 optical duobinary transmitter using an OC-48 nonbuffered x-cut LiNbO/sub 3/ Mach-Zehnder modulator, still maintaining good dispersion and self-phase modulation tolerance of duobinary signals.

articleTitle: High power femtosecond fiber CPA systems - design and applications
abstract: We discuss high average power (/spl sim/100 W) and high energy (/spl sim/100 /spl mu/J) femtosecond fiber laser systems and their applications ranging from index modification in transparent materials to micromachining of metals.

articleTitle: A novel low-loss integrated expandable 16/spl times/4 client-reconfigurable optical add/drop multiplexer
abstract: We have demonstrated a monolithically integrated expandable 16/spl times/4-channel client reconfigurable optical add/drop multiplexer based on silica-on-silicon PLC. A novel cascading switch array design enables the OADM to scale with DWDM channel density.

articleTitle: Characteristics of 1.3 /spl mu/m AlGaInAs-based multiple quantum well tunnel injection lasers
abstract: 1.3 /spl mu/m AlGalnAs-based multiple quantum well tunnel injection lasers have been fabricated for the first time for high speed and uncooled operation. By introducing the tunnel barrier, we have improved a frequency bandwidth and a damping rate, while the low frequency roll-off is increased by increasing a diffusion capacitance.

articleTitle: Quasi-CW THz-imaging based on a high-efficiency tunable photonic transmitter
abstract: A quasi-continuous-wave THz imaging system is constructed based on a compact photonic transmitter with a record-high external converging efficiency. 2D transmission images of biological objects are demonstrated at various THz frequencies.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a single exposure technique for determining the M/# of a holographic substrate
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a simple technique to determine the M/# for a holographic material. Using divergent object and reference beams, we write a single grating in the material. The resulting diffraction pattern can be analyzed to find the M/#

articleTitle: Intracavity adaptive optics optimisation of a grazing-incidence Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ laser
abstract: An intracavity deformable membrane mirror has been used to control the transverse mode profile of a diode-pumped, grazing-incidence Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ laser. Automatic mode and power optimisation are demonstrated using a closed-loop genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: Development of a coherent laser transceiver for the NASA CO/sub 2/ laser absorption spectrometer instrument
abstract: We describe the development of a coherent laser r designed to measure planetary boundary layer CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> from an airborne platform to a concentration precision of 1 ppmv, using the technique of Laser Absorption Spectrometry.

articleTitle: Biomolecular sensor based on optical spectroscopy of single gold nanoparticles
abstract: Light-scattering spectroscopy on single gold nanoparticles is used to detect molecular binding events. We show that our method is able to detect less than 200 molecular binding events under physiological conditions.

articleTitle: Transverse mode control by etching depth tuning in 1120-nm GaInAs/GaAs photonic crystal vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers
abstract: Transverse mode control by etching depth tuning is demonstration from long wavelength (1120 nm) photonics-crystal vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers. The non-degenerate single-transverse mode was obtained in 12 /spl sim/ 18-pair-etched PC-VCSELs over the entire operating current range.

articleTitle: Fourier domain optical coherence tomography to characterize optical fiber cross sections
abstract: Fourier domain optical coherence tomography is used to reconstruct the cross section of coated optical fibers. A single measurement yields information on the coated and uncoated fiber diameter, and the fiber-coating concentricity.

articleTitle: Highly-birefringent elliptical hollow optical fiber
abstract: We propose and analyze a novel design of high birefringence fiber incorporating an elliptical air hole in the core. Compared to solid elliptical core fibers, several times higher birefringence is achieved with a sub-wavelength-sized hole.

articleTitle: Random-phase solitons in nonlinear periodic lattices
abstract: We present the first theoretical study and experimental demonstration of random-phase solitons (RPS) in nonlinear periodic lattices. For RPS to exist, their intensity profile and statistical (coherence) properties must conform to the lattice periodicity.

articleTitle: The BioCD: A high-sensitivity spinning-disk interferometer for antigen detection
abstract: The BioCD spinning-disk format enables the high-frequency narrow-bandwidth detection of antigen in a high-speed optical immunoassay. We experimentally demonstrate a detection limit approaching 100 attomoles per track and sensitivity to 100 ng/ml.

articleTitle: Power scaling of multi-wavelength erbium-doped fiber lasers
abstract: We report on the emission of several wavelengths in a fiber laser by coherently combining in a ring cavity two erbium-doped fiber amplifiers by employing an acousto optic modulator and a Mach-Zehnder spectral filter.

articleTitle: Software compensation for dispersion mismatch in optical coherence tomography
abstract: We demonstrate a novel method for dynamically and effectively compensating the fundamental and higher-order dispersion mismatches in an optical coherence tomography system based on multiple scans of sliced spectral bands and software process.

articleTitle: All-optical wavelength conversion based on periodic phase modulation in optical fibers
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, a simple wavelength converter based on periodic phase modulation in optical fibers, that offers good efficiency, and format- and bit-rate-independence. Conversion to more than 20 channels was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Guiding of intense laser pulses in plasma waveguides from clustered gases
abstract: Self-focusing in clustered media is utilized to generate end-pumped, preformed plasma waveguides for guiding intense laser pulses. The waveguides are studied using end-mode imaging and transverse interferometry. Propagation of high-intensity femtosecond laser pulses is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Dispersion and absorption effects by water and lipid in 1.3 /spl mu/m OCT system
abstract: The water and lipid induced group velocity dispersion (GVD) and absorption effects were investigated in OCT system. These results suggest possible limitations in intravascular imaging in vivo, as well as possible tissue characteristics using GVD.

articleTitle: Cd/sub 1-x/Mn/sub x/Te magneto-optical waveguide on GaAs substrate for monolithical integration of optical isolator
abstract: Complete magneto-optical mode conversion was attained in waveguide of diluted magnetic semiconductor Cd/sub 1-x/Mn/sub x/Te. The Cd/sub 1-x/Mn/sub x/Te waveguide with graded-refractive-index layers showed optical loss below 1 dB/cm, and high magneto-optical figure-of-merit, 200 deg/dB/kG at /spl lambda/ = 730 nm.

articleTitle: Femtosecond light filaments: robust "tracks" through the atmosphere?
abstract: The interaction of ultrashort laser pulses with opaque droplets in the atmosphere is examined numerically. (3 + 1)-dimensional numerical simulations show that the filament is rapidly rebuilt with minimal loss of energy.

articleTitle: Fabrication of multimode polymer waveguide using new replication method
abstract: Polymeric large-core multimode waveguides have been fabricated on Si-wafers and optical acrylic sheet by using a new replication method and newly developed UV curable materials

articleTitle: Routes to control of soliton propagation and pulse compression in microstructured fibers
abstract: We experimentally and theoretically demonstrate control of soliton propagation in microstructured fibers using adaptive learning. We also theoretically pose a route to /spl sim/1 fs pulse compression in dispersion tailored photonic crystal fibers.

articleTitle: Multi-pass frequency conversion in PPKTP
abstract: A multi-pass scheme with periodically poled KTiOPO/sub 4/ was employed to optimize the non-resonant frequency conversion of a non-planar monolithic ring Nd:YAG laser. We measured a normalized conversion efficiency as high as 27.3% W/sup -1/.

articleTitle: Soliton mode-locked femtosecond Er:Yb:glass laser
abstract: We demonstrate a simple, diode-pumped passively mode-locked 50-MHz Er:Yb:glass laser with 440-fs pulse duration and 59-mW average output power.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked Yb:Lu/sub 2/O/sub 3/ laser
abstract: A mode locked Yb-laser with host material of Lu/sub 2/O/sub 3/ is demonstrated for the first time. Using a saturable absorber mirror ps-pulses and with dispersion compensation pulses as short as 220 fs were obtained at 1033.5 nm.

articleTitle: High-aspect-ratio periodical twin structure for QPM SHG in quartz
abstract: We demonstrate periodic twins propagating with high aspect ratio of 11:2:1 and 3rd- and 2nd-order QPM SHG of a Nd:YAG laser The normalized conversion efficiency is 0.63 %/W/cm/sup 2/ in 2nd-order QPM with 4.9 nsec pulsewidth.

articleTitle: Above room temperature CW edge-emitting lasers with GaAsP/GaAs/GaAsSb active regions
abstract: We report the first demonstration of CW operation of GaAsP/GaAs/GaAsSb QW lasers above room temperatures and show that the strain compensation improves the overall device performance

articleTitle: All optical x-ray source using colliding laser and electron beams
Non resonant quasiphase-matching by Fresnel birefringence: Towards an ultrawide tunability
abstract: We present a new quasiphase matching scenario based on the Fresnel birefringence occurring at total internal reflection, Thanks to non resonant conditions on the semiconductor plate thickness, ultrawide tunability is made possible (8-13 /spl mu/m).

articleTitle: Diode-stack-pumped Yb-doped multi-core ribbon fiber laser
abstract: A ribbon fiber with an array of ten Yb-doped cores has been operated in a laser configuration pumped by a diode-stack at 940 nm. 100 W of output power for /spl sim/260 W of launched pump has been achieved.

articleTitle: Loop of the rings: amplification of the phases of counter-propagating waves by a ring resonator in a Sagnac loop
abstract: A novel phase amplification technique using a ring resonator in a Sagnac interferometer is proposed. It can be used to increase birefringence and PMD measurements sensitivity and sensitivity of fiberoptic gyroscopes. Preliminary experiments are reported.

articleTitle: Multi-watt, 1.48-2.05 /spl mu/m range CW Raman-soliton continuum generation in highly-nonlinear fibres
abstract: Up-to 15 W power, CW Raman-soliton continua were generated in conventional highly-nonlinear-fibres in the 1.48-2.05 /spl mu/m range with spectral brightness up-to 30 mW/nm and flatness <1 dB. All-fibre-integrated pumping with 20 W 1480 nm Raman and 10 W Yb/Er sources is employed.

articleTitle: Low repetition rate, visible, solid-state picosecond source
abstract: A new concept to obtain low repetition rate picosecond laser is proposed and demonstrated. It is based on non-collinear interaction by means of a frequency doubling crystal between two actively mode-locked crossed lasers.

articleTitle: Octave supercontinuum generated in tapered conventional fibres by a nanosecond 1064 nm laser
abstract: We demonstrated a 650 nm wide supercontinuum generated in tapered fibres immersed in heavy water. The pump source was a low-cost diode-pumped Nd:YAG laser with a pulse width of 0.6 ns and an output power of 40 mW.

articleTitle: Direct TEM observation of amorphous Si created by femtosecond laser irradiation
abstract: This work performs a cross-sectional TEM study of holes in Si using a femtosecond laser, and observes the structure directly. Under bright-field TEM mode, a 20 to 30 nm thick amorphous layer on the silicon surface inside the hole is observed. Furthermore, an electron dispersive X-ray study proves that this layer does not contain oxygen.

articleTitle: Plastic photonic crystal fiber as terahertz waveguide
abstract: Terahertz waveguide using plastic photonic crystal fiber has been experimentally demonstrated. The plastic waveguides of various lengths and different number of periodic cladding show polarization preserving characteristics with low-loss narrowband width.

articleTitle: Ultrafast all-optical switching at 1.55 /spl mu/m using an organic multilayer device
abstract: Ultrafast all-optical switching is carried out at optical communication wavelength by adopting a layered structure of spin-coated organic films. Signal-noise ratio more than 25 dB and a sub-picosecond response time are observed at 1.55 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Demonstration of semiconductor microring resonator coupled lasers
abstract: A microring-resonator-coupled laser is demonstrated using an EDFA and a GaInAsP-InP microring. Integrated SOA can greatly compensate the high optical loss associated with the microring resonator and reduce the threshold of a microring-resonator-coupled laser.

articleTitle: Diffraction management in 2D waveguide arrays
abstract: We report on the experimental observation of diffraction management in two-dimensional (2D) "fixed" periodic waveguide arrays in a photorefractive (PR) ferroelectric crystal.

articleTitle: A 2.4 GHz wireless-over-fibre transmitter using a photonic active integrated antenna (PhAIA)
abstract: The integration of a low cost VCSEL with a microstrip antenna results in a low cost wireless-optical transmitter. The VCSEL impedance is matched to that of the antenna and initial microwave link results are shown.

articleTitle: The effect of series resistance on the linearity and cross-talk of an SAG based broad band semiconductor optical amplifier
abstract: We investigate the effect of series resistance to carrier distribution in SAG based ultra-broadband SOAs, which determines the same device as a perfect optical amplifier or a perfect wavelength converter.

articleTitle: Measurement of two-photon absorption in AlGaInAs strained-layer multiple-quantum-well devices at communications wavelengths
abstract: Two-photon absorption was measured in AlGaInAs strained-layer multiple-quantum-well active waveguide devices at wavelengths near the 1575 nm band-gap. Values around 400 cm/GW were obtained, much larger than that predicted by a commonly used scaling law.

articleTitle: Analysis of wavelength-dependent DGD in optical components
abstract: Wavelength-dependent DGD in optical components, including fiber Bragg gratings, is investigated for both NRZ and RZ modulation formats. The worst-case penalty caused by a periodic DGD has been quantified as a function of the period

articleTitle: Quantum dot infrared photodetectors (QDIPs) by MOCVD and QDIP focal plane array
abstract: We report high temperature high detectivity MWIR quantum dot infrared photodetectors (QD1P)grown by LP-MOCVD. Record high detectivities were obtained. A 256x256 infrared FPA based on InGaAsiInCaP QDIP was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical control of droplet-based microfluidics
abstract: We have constructed a single optical system to manipulate and react small droplets, based on the thermal Marangoni effect. We have observed droplet fusion and subsequent rapid mixing, and performed a biologically relevant, absorption-based assay

articleTitle: Quantum-dot-doped waveguides produced by ion exchange
abstract: We present the first low-loss (< 0.5 dB/cm) ion-exchanged waveguides in glass doped with lead-salt quantum dots. Measurements of the waveguides' coupling losses, near-field mode profile, and index profile are presented

articleTitle: Predicting the failure modes in DPSK transmission systems
abstract: We demonstrate that importance sampling guided by variationally-optimized perturbation theory not only determines error rates in soliton-based DPSK transmission systems, but also predicts the failure modes leading to these errors.

articleTitle: Measuring spectral linewidth of highly-coherent laser using optical injection
abstract: A new method using optical injection is proposed to measure spectral linewidth of coherent single mode lasers. Theoretical model and experimental measurement of a 50 kHz full-width-half-maximum linewidth fiber laser is presented.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of photonic devices directly written in glass using femtosecond lasers
abstract: Techniques for using femtosecond lasers to directly write waveguides and integrated optical components in glass are reviewed along with the history of this field and its current state

articleTitle: Comparative study of Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ and Nd:YVO/sub 4/: laser oscillation under 808-nm and 879-nm pumping
abstract: The 80.3% of slope efficiency has been achieved in 1-/spl mu/m cw laser oscillation by Nd:GdVO/sub 4/: this is the highest efficiency in Nd/sup 3+/ lasers. Spectroscopic properties of Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ compared to those of Nd:YVO/sub 4/ were also discussed.

articleTitle: Integrated biophotonic sensor with single-molecule resolution
abstract: We present design and first demonstration of integrated optical ARROW waveguides with liquid cores. Low optical loss, wavelength selectivity and high collection efficiency make them ideal for measuring fluorescence and Raman scattering from single biomolecules.

articleTitle: 2-dimensional coherent arrays of photonic crystal vertical cavity defect lasers
abstract: We report the first coherently coupled photonic crystal vertical cavity surface-emitting 2-dimensional laser arrays. The array elements, which are defined by single photonic crystal defect apertures, exhibit out-of-phase coupling.

articleTitle: Controlled spatial orientation of birefringent microscopic particles using optical trap with polarization grating
abstract: We demonstrate that the use of polarization grating generated in a line optical tweezers can be a convenient approach for alignment of birefringent particles or for their rotation with variable speeds.

articleTitle: Modelling surface imperfection induced mode mixing in multimode microstructured fibres
abstract: Mode mixing caused by surface imperfections in the holes of microstructured fibres is theoretically modelled for highly multimode systems. Approximations for coupling, differential mode attenuation, equilibrium lengths, power distributions and loss are obtained.

articleTitle: Controlled generation and steering of spatial gap solitons
abstract: We realize fully controlled generation of slow and immobile spatial gap solitons through two-beam mutual focusing in a periodic lattice. We also predict and demonstrate the limitation of mutual beam focusing and enhanced mobility of gap solitons.

articleTitle: High energy optical parametric oscillation using 3-mm-thick periodically poled MgO:LiNbO/sub 3/
abstract: A 3-mm-thick, periodically poled 5-mol%-MgO:LiNbO/sub 3/ device was fabricated for high energy optical parametric oscillation. Total energy of 22 mJ for both 1.82-/spl mu/m-signal and 2.56-/spl mu/m-idler was obtained at input pump energy of 46 mJ.

articleTitle: Secondary energy transfer and non-participatory Yb/sup 3+/ ions in high-power Er/sup 3+/-Yb/sup 3+/ amplifier fibers
abstract: Luminescent decay measurements and modeling of high-power erbium-ytterbium amplifier fibers reveal significant ytterbium to erbium secondary energy transfer plus non-participatory ytterbium ions not coupled to the erbium. Both phenomena will lower efficiencies of erbium-ytterbium amplifiers.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave polycrystalline Cr/sup 2+/:ZnSe laser pumped by a 1.85 /spl mu/m InGaAsP/InP laser diode
abstract: We report the polycrystalline Cr/sup 2+/:ZnSe laser, pumped by the 1.85 /spl mu/m InGaAsP/InP laser diode and Er-fiber laser. The output power is 42 and 520 mW at a slope efficiency of 23 and 53 %, respectively.

articleTitle: Broadband emissions in Er/sup 3+/-Tm/sup 3+/ codoped tellurite glass fibre
abstract: In tellurite fibre EDFA, a gain-flattened amplification of 20 dB across a spectrum of 80 nm between 1530 and 1610 nm was demonstrated. By combining a tellurite fibre with Er/sup 3+/ dopant and a fluoride fibre with Tm/sup 3+/-ion dopant, the maximum gain flatness in two discrete S- and C+L bands is 113 nm. There is therefore an opportunity for developing an Er-Tm doped fibre with a seamless amplification bandwidth and flattened spectrum over 1410 nm to 1610 nm, which will be an ideal device for WDM.

articleTitle: High intensity femtosecond laser technology
abstract: The development of ultra intense titanium sapphire based femtosecond lasers shows today a dramatic expansion leading to apparition of several petawatt projects. Several bottlenecks are still to be overcome and will be reported.
