articleTitle: Dual-service wireless LAN antenna-remoting system using uncooled directly modulated DFB laser diodes
abstract: We report a fibre-optic wireless distribution system, which allows antenna-remoting of a dual-service IEEE 802.11b/g WLAN operating at 2.4 GHz up to 700 m over low-bandwidth 62.5/125 mum MMF using highly linear uncooled directly modulated laser diodes

articleTitle: Broadband self-tracking fiber interferometer with 1-GHz spectral resolution and 1-s measurement time
abstract: Broadband (100-nm) fiber interferometer is realized with extremely low phase fluctuation (0.04/spl pi/). Reflectivity and group delay of a fiber Bragg grating is measured with 1-GHz spectral resolution and 1-s measurement time.

articleTitle: Pump-to-Stokes transfer of relative intensity noise in Raman fiber lasers
abstract: We investigate the effect of pump-to-Stokes relative intensity noise transfer in Raman fiber lasers on the performance of copumped Raman amplifiers. We show that the effect can be mitigated by proper design of pump lasers.

articleTitle: Scalability of frequency-hopping time-spreading OCDMA code matrix
abstract: We analyze the scalability constraint on 2D OCDMA code matrices due to wavelength and time domain crosstalk. Code matrix size of 7000 is obtained for 100 nm total bandwidth at 2.5 Gbps

articleTitle: Correlation between the Brillouin and the structural parameters in holey optical fibers
abstract: We measure the correlation between the Brillouin characteristics and structural parameters of a holey fiber (HF). Our observations point to a means to perform high resolution non-destructive structural characterization along lengths of HF.

articleTitle: Highly linear and efficient GaInAsP-InP phase modulators
abstract: Highly linear and efficient InGaAsP phase modulators are presented. These devices show an order of magnitude higher linearity than bulk or quantum well phase modulators, while their efficiency is comparable to the best reported values.

articleTitle: Distributed and dynamic strain measurement by BOCDA with time-division pump-probe generation scheme
abstract: By a configuration of Brillouin optical correlation domain analysis simplified with time-division pump-probe generation scheme, distributed and dynamic strain sensing with 11 cm spatial-resolution and 1.7 Hz sampling-rate have been demonstrated using an ordinary DFB-LD.

articleTitle: Identification of amplitude and timing jitter in external-cavity mode-locked semiconductor lasers
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally investigate the dynamics of external-cavity mode-locked semiconductor lasers, focusing on stability properties, optimization of pulsewidth and timing jitter. A new numerical approach allows to clearly separate timing and amplitude jitter.

articleTitle: Observation of stimulated emission in short-period quasi-indirect type-II GaAs/AlAs superlattices
abstract: We have demonstrated that the type-II GaAs/AlAs superlattices can be used to greatly increase the recombination times and to achieve stimulated emission in these structures with greatly-reduced gain coefficients for applications as optical amplifiers.

articleTitle: High-brightness slab-coupled semiconductor lasers single-spatial, large-diameter mode
abstract: A high-brightness semiconductor diode laser concept, which utilizes a slab-coupled optical waveguide region to achieve several potentially important advances in performance, is described. Results on devices, which utilize this design concept, in InGaAsP/InP and AlGaAs/InGaAs/GaAs are presented.

articleTitle: Sensitive optical response of long period fiber gratings to nm-thick ionic self-assembled multilayers
abstract: Ionic self-assembled multilayers of nm-thicknesses are deposited on long period fiber gratings. We observe dramatic resonant-wavelength shifts even with nm-thick films. We demonstrate the feasibility of this highly controllable deposition-technique for fine-tuning grating properties, and for their use as biosensors

articleTitle: 1/spl times/N all-optical packet switch at 10 Gb/s
abstract: We demonstrated a 1/spl times/N all-optical packet switch with all-optical header processing and packet switching at 10 Gb/s using multi-wavelength mutual injection-locking in a single Fabry-Perot laser diode. The packet header is processed at 10 Gb/s.

articleTitle: 2.8-fs transform-limited optical-pulse generation in the monocycle region
abstract: Perfect chirp conipensation for ultrabroad-hand pulses with an over-octave-spanning bandwidth (460 - 1060 nm) was achieved using a feedback method. Consequently, 2.8-fs, 1.46 cycle transform-limited pulses were generated.

articleTitle: Bandwidth tuning in a novel hybrid fiber filter
abstract: Bandwidth tuning is reported in a novel hybrid waveguide composed of serial concatenation of single mode fiber and hollow optical fiber. Variation of the FWHM in the acousto-optic filter was achieved from 3.2 to 100 nm by changing RF frequency.

articleTitle: Novel resonant cavity TDM demodulation scheme for FBG sensing
abstract: A novel time-division-multiplexed Bragg grating interrogation system is presented, utilising a semiconductor optical amplifier within a resonating cavity. Without fast electronics, closely spaced low reflectivity gratings are interrogated with high signal power and low noise.

articleTitle: Hydrocarbon gas sensing using 3.5 micron type II interband cascade lasers
abstract: Sensitive detection of hydrocarbon gases using a type-II interband cascade laser at 3.49 microns are presented. Details of laser modulation, linewidth, and detection limits using an FM-absorption technique are described.

articleTitle: Optical coherence tomography based on an all fiber autocorrelator using probe-end reflection as reference
abstract: We demonstrate a novel optical coherence tomography (OCT) system based on an all fiber autocorrelator using probe-end reflection as reference. The advantages of low cost, and robust all fiber design promises an effective alternative technology for commercial OCT instrumentation

articleTitle: Illumination sources based on multiple light-emitting diodes
abstract: Luminous efficacies and color rendering capabilities of illumination sources based on tri- and tetra-chromatic light-emitting diodes (LEDs) are investigated. Tri-chromatic sources with a CRI of 84 and a luminous efficiency of 32 Im/W are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Small pitch vertical cavity surface emitting laser arrays
abstract: We show that mesa-isolated top emitting selectively oxidized 850 nm vertical cavity surface emitting lasers can be fabricated with 21 /spl mu/m separation with minimal thermal crosstalk.

articleTitle: Cladding pumped Nd-doped fiber laser tunable from 908 to 938 nm
abstract: A single-mode tunable aluminosilicate Nd-doped double clad fiber laser is presented with tuning range of 908 nm-938 nm and maximum power of 2.4 W at 926 nm. The influence on tuning range is investigated.

articleTitle: The dynamic range in input power for an optical signal regenerator using cascaded wavelength converters based on cross-gain modulation in semiconductor optical amplifiers
abstract: We investigated dynamic range in input light power for optical signal regenerator using cascaded wavelength converters based on cross-gain modulation, We achieved 6 dB dynamic range, and over 11 dB under optimized probe light conditions.

articleTitle: Apodized optical filters based on silicon-on-insulator waveguides with sidewall gratings
abstract: We describe the design, fabrication, and characterization of apodized integrated-optical filters based on silicon-on-insulator ridge waveguides. A sidewall grating design allows the waveguide and a variable strength Bragg-grating to be patterned in one lithographic step.

articleTitle: Condenser micro-mirrors for high speed optical modules
abstract: We have developed a gold-film condenser micro-mirror to help miniaturize optical coupling between high-speed optical chips and optical circuits. Coupling over a path length of 160 /spl mu/m results in loss of only 0.6 dB.

articleTitle: 160Gb/s high extinction ratio Raman-enhanced FWM wavelength converter with highly-nonlinear-fiber
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time 160Gb/s high extinction ratio all-opticd wavelength conversion via Raman-enhanced FWM in HigNy-Nonlinear-Fiber. Error free operation was achieved for all 16 demultiplexed 1OGb/s channels with less than 2dB power penally. 02004 Optical Society of America

articleTitle: Extremely low noise microwave signals synthesized from stable CW lasers with femtosecond laser frequency combs
abstract: A femtosecond laser frequency comb transfers the low phase and frequency noise of a cavity-stabilized CW laser to the nucrowave domam Phase noise of -115 dBc/Hz at 1 Hz offset from the1 GHz camer IS aclueved

articleTitle: Perturbative modeling of irregularities in microstructure optical fibers
abstract: Geometrical irregularities can severely restrict use of some microstructure fibers. A systematic perturbative method is demonstrated against full calculations, and allows efficient loss and effective-index estimates for large statistical samples of geometrical irregularities.

articleTitle: Measurements of non-linear noise re-distribution in an SOA
abstract: Measurements of the noise statistics after a semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) demonstrate non-linear noise re-distribution with a strong power and bandwidth dependence.

articleTitle: Efficient parametric wavelength conversion using direct-bonded QPM-ZnO-doped LiNbO/sub 3/ ridge waveguide
abstract: We fabricate a 50 mm-long direct-bonded QPM-LN ridge waveguide using ZnO-doped LN. We achieve an internal wavelength conversion efficiency of 0 dB based on a /spl chi//sup (2)/ cascading scheme in the 1550 nm wavelength band.

articleTitle: Pump-to-signal RIN transfer in fiber OPAs
abstract: Pump to signal RIN transfer in fiber OPAs is investigated theoretically and experimentally. For a 20 dB gain, signal RIN is larger than pump RIN by a factor ranging from 2 to 14.

articleTitle: SBS and nonlinearities reduction of analog optical links via polarization modulation
abstract: We propose using analog polarization modulation (PolM) to tackle SBS and nonlinearities due to amplitude modulation in analog optical links, e.g. HFC systems. Experimental results show that SBS threshold is improved compared to amplitude modulation (AM) systems.

articleTitle: Repetitively pulsed, high energy, electron beam pumped krypton fluoride (KrF) lasers
abstract: The Electra program at the Naval Research Laboratory has made considerable advances in the science and technology needed to build a high energy, repetitively pulsed, durable and efficient KrF laser.

articleTitle: Wavelength selective WDM modulator with high-Q ring resonators in deeply etched InP/InGaAsP waveguides
abstract: Electro-refractive InP/InGaAsP ring-resonators with quality factors of up to 20000 are demonstrated. A novel modified MMI-coupler is used to provide reproducible low coupling to the access waveguide. We demonstrate modulation and the first link experiments.

articleTitle: Spectral characteristics of gain and noise saturation in nonlinear InAs/InP quantum dash optical amplifiers
abstract: Gain and noise saturation spectra of quantum-dash optical amplifiers were measured to be asymmetric due to the inhomogeneous gain and their quantum wire like nature. Direct measurement of the homogeneously broadened gain bandwidth yields 15 nm.

articleTitle: Flattop mode shaping of a vertical cavity surface emitting laser using an external-cavity aspheric mirror
abstract: A square-shaped flattop mode was experimentally demonstrated in a broad-area circular-aperture VCSEL using an external-cavity aspheric mirror. The mirror was fabricated by electron-beam lithography on a curved substrate. Excellent single-mode operation was observed.

articleTitle: Self-reconstruction of ultrashort-pulse Bessel-like X-waves
abstract: Self-reconstruction of Bessel-like X-waves generated from femtosecond Ti:sapphire laser beams by thin-film microaxicons was studied for the first time in simulation and experiment. The spatio-temporal response to disturbances was analyzed with respect to potential applications

articleTitle: Silicon void nano-waveguides for guiding and confining light
abstract: We present theoretical and experimental evidence of a novel wavelength-insensitive waveguide geometry for guiding and confining light in nanometer-wide low-index materials, based on the discontinuity of the electric field at high-index-contrast interfaces.

articleTitle: Athermal L-band optical gain block using Sb-doped EDF
abstract: We report suppression of temperature dependent gain variation within /spl plusmn/1.5 dB in the L-band within -40 to +80 /spl deg/C, by novel hybrid concatenation of the antimony-doped silica EDF to conventional L-EDF.

articleTitle: Optoelectronic integration using statistical assembly and magnetic retention of heterostructure pills
abstract: Magnetically assisted statistical assembly (MASA), whereby heterostructure device pills are statistically assembled in dielectric recesses on a Si integrated circuit and retained by short-range magnetic forces, is described and demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Noise and pulse characteristics of continuum generation in microstructure fiber
abstract: The continuum generated in microstructure fiber by femtosecond pulses has many potential applications. This tutorial will cover the noise that can be concomitant with the highly nonlinear continuum generation process and its impact on applications.

articleTitle: Waveguide THz-TDS observation of thin water layers
abstract: THz-TDS study of thin water layers on a parallel metal plate waveguide is presented. The water layer shows higher absorption properties compared with bulk water, which may be caused by surface conditions of the waveguide.

articleTitle: Approaching Shannon's capacity limits of fiber optics communications channels using short LDPC codes
abstract: A soft-decision channel-capacity for different fiber-optics communications channel-models is discussed. Short low-density parity-check codes of very-high code-rates, large minimum distance, low-complexity encoding and decoding approaching the Shannon's limit within 0.7 dB at BER of 5/spl times/10/sup -7/ are presented, 2.5 dB better than turbo codes.

articleTitle: A novel optical vector spectrum analysis technique
abstract: A novel technique for measuring frequencydependent magnitude and phase information across an optical channel is presented using tunable, integrated ring-resonator-based optical filters and a detector with a small bandwidth relative to the full channel width.

articleTitle: Aqueous-core waveguides using a low-index nanoporous cladding
abstract: We have observed optical waveguiding in structures made by sandwiching an aqueous layer between two low-index nanoporous films. We report characterization of these waveguides using prism coupling and scanned fluorescence excitation.

articleTitle: Photonic bandgap VCSELs
abstract: A record-high output-power photonic-bandgap VCSEL is experimentally demonstrated. We employ nano-structuring in the VCSEL top mirror using a novel technique. Modeling and experimental results are in excellent agreement.

articleTitle: Nonlinear light generation in quantum cascade lasers
abstract: Efficient intracavity nonlinear interaction of laser modes in quantum cascade lasers with integrated resonant nonlinear optical intersubband transitions is discussed. Second-harmonic generation at 4.5 /spl mu/m with a peak power of 240 /spl mu/W has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Measurement and evaluation of chirp and linewidth enhancement factor of a 1.3 /spl mu/m quantum dot laser
abstract: We measured chirp of quantum dot lasers under 5 Gb/s direct-modulation, and the chirp was less than 2 GHz. From the results and some simulations, we can estimate small /spl alpha/ of 0.3 in the quantum dot laser.

articleTitle: Fully-integrable broadband polarization equalizer
abstract: We demonstrate a fully system-integrable apparatus that accomplishes wavelengthparallel, broadband polarization equalization. A Liquid-Clystal Modulator array is used in a double-pass style pulse-shaper to transform distorted input polarizations into a fixed state over 13.1 nm banndwidth.

articleTitle: UV-written channel waveguides in proton-exchanged lithium niobate
abstract: We report on the direct UV-writing of channel waveguides in annealed proton-exchanged (APE) and reverse proton-exchanged (RPE) layers in LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and demonstrate efficient guiding within single mode channels at telecom wavelengths

articleTitle: Fabrication of planar optical waveguides by electrical microcontact printing
abstract: We describe the fabrication by electrical microcontact printing of optical waveguides and splitters made of poly(4-vinylphenol) doped with phloxine B, permitting inexpensive, rapid prototyping over large areas and construction of integrated, multi-level devices.

articleTitle: Surface profilometry at large working distances using volume holographic optics
abstract: We present a volume holographic long range surface profilometer that exploits a priori object information to resolve up to 50 /spl mu/m surface height features at a working distance of 50 cm.

articleTitle: Investigation and solution for undesirable counter-propagating effects in nonlinear optical loop mirrors
abstract: Undesirable SPM (self-phase modulation) and XPM (cross-phase modulation) between counter-propagating lights in NOLMs (nonlinear optical loop mirror) are investigated. A solution to overcome these impairments is also proposed and experimentally validated.

articleTitle: Enhanced two-photon fluorescence excitation by resonant waveguide structures
abstract: Two photon fluorescence excitation (2PE) minimizes photobleaching and discriminates easily fluorescence from the excitation light. Novel low loss high finesse resonant polymeric nanostructures enhance 2PE, without the need for a highly focused laser excitation light.

articleTitle: Mutual injection locking of solid-state lasers
abstract: Mutual injection locking of solid-state lasers provides significant improvements over traditional, single-direction injection locking. While both methods reduce lasing threshold and improve beam quality, mutual injection locking overcomes the traditional method's limits.

articleTitle: Highly stable ultra-short pulse generation by filtering out flat optical frequency components
abstract: We propose a novel method for generating optical pulses featuring a compact and straightforward configuration. By filtering out flat optical frequency components generated using LiNbO/sub 3/ phase and intensity modulators, 1.8-ps, 10-GHz pulses are successfully obtained.

articleTitle: Cloud and aerosol lidar channel design and performance of the Geoscience Laser Altimeter System on the ICESat mission
abstract: The design of the 532 and 1064 nm wavelength atmosphere lidar channels of the Geoscience Laser Altimeter System on the ICESat spacecraft is described. The lidar channel performance per on orbit measurements data will be presented.

articleTitle: High-power single-mode VCSELs with triangular holey structure
abstract: Oxide confined 850 nm monolithic VCSELs with 2D triangular air holes etched around the oxide aperture showed single transverse mode emission with a high CW output power of 7mW, and a SMSR of over 40dB.

articleTitle: Continuous wave operation up to 350 K of Sb-based vertical cavity surface emitting laser near 2.3 /spl mu/m
abstract: We report a CW 350 K operation of a diode-pumped Sb-based surface-emitting-laser at 2.3 /spl mu/m. The structure is made of a 24.5 pairs AlAsSb/GaSb Bragg mirror, 5 type-I InGaAsSb/AlGaAsSb wells. The threshold intensity is <1 kW/cm/sup 2/.

articleTitle: Direct ultrafast laser writing of buried waveguides in Foturan glass
abstract: Femtosecond laser writing of buried waveguides was extended to Foturan glass. Thermal annealing yielded positive index changes for selective visible and infrared wavelengths.

articleTitle: Point by point FBG inscription by a focused NIR femtosecond laser
abstract: We have observed fibre Bragg gratings (FBG) inscribed point by point into standard SMF-28 fibre using a NIR femtosecond laser.

articleTitle: Measurements of intrinsic properties of high power CW single quantum well GaInNAsSb/GaAs lasers at 1.5 /spl mu/m
abstract: We present measurements of relative intensity noise (RIN) and non-radiative recombination of 1.5 /spl mu/m GaInNAsSb edge-emitting lasers. Differential gain of 4/spl times/10/sup -18/cm/sup 2/, K-factor of 0.75 ns and RIN below -150 dB/Hz at 7 mW were measured.

articleTitle: X-CPA (extreme chirped pulse amplification) - beyond the energy storage limit of semiconductor gain media
abstract: The stored energy limitation in ultrashort pulse amplification using semiconductor gain medium is overcome using the concept of X-CPA that consists of SOAs and chirped fiber Bragg gratings (CFBGs).

articleTitle: Novel polarization maintaining actively mode locked fiber ring laser
abstract: A 10 GHz polarization-maintaining actively mode-locked fiber ring laser was demonstrated. A Fabry Perot laser diode was incorporated into the ring cavity as an all-optical polarizer.

articleTitle: Accurate DOP monitoring of several WDM channels for simultaneous PMD compensation
abstract: We demonstrate averaged-DOP monitoring of WDM channels for simultaneous PMD compensation. We achieve a significant power penalty reduction > 10 dB using this scheme. The 2%-worst-case compensated performance of averaged-BER is improved by two orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Characterization of pattern dependent receivers
abstract: We present a simple procedure which allows us to correct the Q-factor in presence of pattern dependence. We are able to accurately describe the Q-factor over almost 20 dB of dynamic range.

articleTitle: 0.9 /spl sim/ 2.7 /spl mu/m over one octave spanning ultrabroad supercontinuum generation based on all fiber system
abstract: Using Er-doped fiber and polarization maintaining highly nonlinear dispersion shifted fiber, ultrabroad supercontinuum is generated. The spectrum expands from 0.9 to 2.7 /spl mu/m, and the bandwidth is over 1.8 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Effects of lightning and short-circuit discharges on WDM overhead transmission at 10 Gb/s
abstract: The reliability of WDM transmission at 10 Gb/s on overhead fiber-optic cables, in the presence of lightning and short-circuit discharge events, has been proven by repeated laboratory tests, simultaneously evaluating BER, state-of-polarization and optical path evolutions

articleTitle: Dispersion and nonlinearity tolerance of modulation formats for 160 Gb/s systems
abstract: We compare the RZ-DQPSK modulation format in 160 Gb/s single channel systems with RZ, CSRZ, RZ-DPSK and CSRZ-DPSK for the first time. We find that RZ-DQPSK offers nearly three time better dispersion tolerance than CSRZ-DPSK.

articleTitle: Red Pr 3+:YLiF 4 laser excited by 480 nm optically pumped semiconductor laser
abstract: Summary form only given. Laser oscillation in continuous wave regime in Pr/sup 3+/:YLiF/sub 4/ in the red spectral range is reported. The system is pumped at 480 nm using an optically pumped semiconductor (OPS) laser for the first time.

articleTitle: High-sensitivity high-resolution linear sampling up to 640 Gb/s using 90/spl deg/-waveguide optical hybrid
abstract: A practical and sensitive sampling setup based on linear interference of the waveform under test with a sampling pulse combined with a waveguide optical hybrid demonstrates quasi-distortion-free sampling of eye diagrams up to 640 Gb/s.

articleTitle: A 1/spl times/2 fast fiber-optic switch based on electro-optic beam scanning
abstract: We report a packaged 1times2 fiber-optic switch based on electro-optic beam scanning. The resulting optical switch exhibits an insertion loss of less than 4 dB and a rise time of 187 nsec at 1310 nm

articleTitle: Evolving FDTD into a nanophotonics design optimization tool
abstract: The initial evolution of FDTD into a tool for optimizing (not just verifying) nanophotonics device designs is described. Parallelization to multiple computers and FDTD features allowing reasonable accuracy even with coarse gridding are described.

articleTitle: High-power picosecond pulse generation from a gain-switched violet diode laser
abstract: Generation of picosecond pulses with a peak power in excess of 7 W and a duration of 24 ps from a gain-switched InGaN diode laser is demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Pilot tone modulation used for channel identification in OTDM networks
abstract: The principle of applying a pilot tone to an OTDM signal, in order to identify a specific channel, is presented. The impact on BER system performance is characterised as function of modulation index.

articleTitle: Fiber-optic tunable filters powered by in-fiber light
abstract: Tunable fiber Bragg gratings powered by in-fiber light have been demonstrated. Heated with in-fiber diode laser light leaked through fiber clad, metal-coated fiber Bragg gratings show 4.9-nm resonance wavelength tuning and 6-nm chirp tuning, respectively.

articleTitle: On the mechanisms governing the repetition rate of mode-locked semiconductor lasers
abstract: We investigate the mechanisms influencing the synchronization locking range of mode-locked lasers. We find that changes in repetition rate can be accommodated through a joint interplay of dispersion and pulse shaping effects.

articleTitle: Dynamic dispersion compensator using MEMS-actuated microdisk resonators
abstract: A novel dynamic dispersion compensator has been realized using MEMS microdisks with variable power-coupling ratio. The coupling is controlled by varying waveguide-disk spacing. A group velocity dispersion tuning range of 400 ps/nm has been achieved experimentally.

articleTitle: Adiabatic diffraction-limited beam propagation of intense self-focusing beams in multimode-core fibers
abstract: High-intensity beams propagating in multimode-core fibers stay diffraction-limited below the critical self-focusing power. Periodic beam-size variation caused by self-phase-modulation along the fiber occurs adiabatically and the beam is accurately represented by a local fundamental mode.

articleTitle: A diode-pumped single-Nd:YAG-slab laser with reciprocal dynamic holographic cavity
abstract: A self-organizing laser based on a single, diode-pumped Nd:YAG slab with reciprocal cavity completed by dynamic holographic gratings was created. The temporal dynamics, frequency spectrum and spatial characteristics of the generated beam were examined.

articleTitle: Transit-time limited response from low capacitance CMOS photodetectors
abstract: Efficient GHz silicon detectors in unmodified CMOS processes are attractive for dense optical interconnection to electronics. Using blue short pulses we demonstrate 50 ps rise time lateral P-I-N detectors in a commercial silicon-on-sapphire CMOS process.

articleTitle: 1.2 mJ, 37 ns single-moded pulses at 10 kHz repetition rate from a Q-switched ytterbium fiber laser
abstract: We have demonstrated a diode pumped 1.2 mJ, 37 ns Q-switched laser with good mode quality, operating at /spl sim/1075 nm with a repetition rate of 10 kHz, utilizing a ytterbium doped LMA fiber.

articleTitle: Noncollinear type-II second harmonic generation in a Al/sub (0.3)/Ga/sub (0.7)/As/Al/sub 2/O/sub 3/ one-dimensional photonic crystal
abstract: We demonstrate noncollinear phase-matched second harmonic generation in one-dimensional photonic crystal. This crystal was designed, fabricated, and experimentally characterized. We report a factor-four enhancement of the nonlinear coefficient.

articleTitle: Generation and amplification of ultra-short optical pulses from a mode-locked long-wavelength (1075 nm - 1085 nm) InGaAs/GaAs quantum well laser
abstract: Ultra-short pulses are generated by passively mode-locking an InGaAs/GaAs quantum well semiconductor laser incorporating a bend in the waveguide. Post-amplification of the pulses is achieved using a flared-waveguide semiconductor optical amplifier.

articleTitle: A surface-normal coupled-quantum-well modulator at 1.55 microns
abstract: We demonstrate that a surface-normal coupled-quantum-well InGaAs/InAlAs electroabsorptive modulator can provide optical modulation that is comparable to a square-well modulator at 1.55 /spl mu/m; but at much lower driving voltages.

articleTitle: Femtosecond intracavity pumped ring optical parametric oscillator: An ultra-sensitive sensor
abstract: A beat note of /spl ap/100 Hz with a bandwidth less than 10 Hz, is measured between the two outputs of a ring optical parametric oscillator, demonstrating a sensitivity to optical path differences of 10/sup -12/ m, with fs resolution.

articleTitle: Characterization of new electro-optic ceramics
abstract: Newly developed electro-optic ceramic PMN-PT has demonstrated high electro-optic coefficient, low field-induced optical scattering loss, and good optical transmission. The materials are suitable for electro-optic and fiber optic applications from visible to infrared wavelengths.

articleTitle: Avalanche photodetection at 1.3 /spl mu/m using an InGaAsN vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser
abstract: Resonant-cavity-enhanced avalanche photodetection is observed at 1.3 /spl mu/m using a vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser incorporating InGaAsN quantum wells. Detection of modulated optical waveforms at data rates up to 10 Gbs/sup -1/ is successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Remote coupling in Bragg fibers
abstract: We propose a directional coupler in Bragg fibers that allows for remote coupling and thus lossless conversion of the fundamental mode into a large-diameter annular mode. We analyze the propagation behavior and give design rules.

articleTitle: Transient control study of erbium-doped fiber amplifiers for reconfigurable DWDM networks
abstract: Transient amplifier gain excursion of surviving channels due to dynamic wavelength add-drop should be kept below 1.5 dB to maintain data quality and receiver clock synchronization. This is experimentally demonstrated with 800 km-span of field deployed fiber network.

articleTitle: Integrated SOA based add-drop multiplexer for WDM optical packet routing with reduced distortion penalty
abstract: A monolithic two-input, two-output add-drop multiplexer is demonstrated for low latency, wavelength-striped, optical packet switching applications. Multi-wavelength routing is demonstrated with mitigated distortion penalty.

articleTitle: Engineering the /spl alpha/-factor in quantum dot-in-a-well lasers
abstract: The linewidth enhancement factor in quantum dot (QD) in a quantum well (QW) laser structures was observed to decrease from 2.5 to 1 as result of controlling the QD shape and the composition of the QW.

articleTitle: 1/spl times/N/sup 2/ wavelength-selective switches with tilted 2D collimator arrays for inter-channel-response suppression
abstract: A 1/spl times/ wavelength-selective switch (WSS) with a 2-axis analog micromirror array and a tilted 2D fiber collimator array has been successfully demonstrated to suppress inter-channel response. 8.2 dB suppression is obtained at 20/spl deg/ tilting.

articleTitle: Low loss photo-bleaching induced electro-optic polymer modulator in a guest-host system
abstract: Low loss photo-bleaching (PB) induced electro-optic (EO) polymer modulators are demonstrated based on an EO guest-host material. These new devices offer major advantages in fabrication and performance.

articleTitle: Determination of the chromatic dispersion and birefringence of photonic crystal fibers using an OLCR technique
abstract: Direct measurement of chromatic dispersion and birefringence of a photonic crystal fiber is achieved using a phase-sensitive optical low-coherence reflectometer. The measurements of a short length fiber are in good agreement with the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Novel all-optical NRZ wavelength conversion employing SOA-based Sagnac interferometer
abstract: SOA-based Sagnac interferometers are traditionally regarded as optical RZ signal processing units. We first analyze and demonstrate NRZ wavelength conversion by introducing an interference bias for the Sagnac loop caused by the polarization control.

articleTitle: A high power, single-mode, erbium-doped fiber amplifier generating 30 fs pulses with 160 kW peak power
abstract: We describe generation of 400 mW average-power, highly-chirped picosecond pulses at 46 MHz repetition rate in a single-mode erbium-doped amplifier. The pulses are compressed to 30 fs with 160 kW peak power in standard-single-mode fiber.

articleTitle: Wide-band polarization-independent optical time demultiplexer based on double-pumped FWM in SOA
abstract: A new scheme for a polarization- and wavelength-transparent optical demultiplexer, based on double-pumped four-wave-mixing in a semiconductor optical amplifier, is presented. Effective 10 Gbit/s channel extraction from an optical-time-domain-multiplexed 40 Gbit/s aggregate frame is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Nanosecond >4-micron PPLN OPO pumped by a Yb fiber laser
abstract: We demonstrated the first >4-micron PPLN OPO directly pumped by a Yb fiber laser. We achieved 130 mW average output power at 4153 nm, which is the highest reported >4-/spl mu/m OPO power based on fiber laser.

articleTitle: High power (3W) GaInAs/(AI)GaAs quantum dot tapered laser arrays with high wavelength stability and low divergence
abstract: High power (3W) and low divergence (4/spl deg/ at FWHM) are demonstrated at 990 nm using arrays of index guided GaInAs/(Al)GaAs quantum dot tapered lasers. A low temperature shift (0.10 nm/K) of the wavelength is observed.

articleTitle: 2-GHz-repetition-rate resonant cavity for the enhancement of second harmonic generation
abstract: We report, for the first time, a 2-GHz-repetition-rate all-solid-state resonant cavity for the enhancement of second-harmonic-generation. Pumped by a 500-mW Ti:sapphire laser with the same repetition-rate, 60-mW femtosecond pulses at 409 nm can be generated.

articleTitle: High sensitivity silicon-based VIS/NIR photodetectors
abstract: We fabricate silicon-based photodiodes using a simple femtosecond-laser microstructuring technique. The detectors are ten times more sensitive than commercial silicon PlN photodiodes at visible wavelengths and can be used at wavelengths up to 1650 nm.
